name: Stonesaga Second Printing
creator: Open Owl Studios
description: Build a civilization across epochs in a cooperative survival crafting saga set in a persistent world shaped by your choices.

name: Beast: Ashfall
creator: Studio Midhall
description: Skies of smoke. Lands of ash. Welcome back to the Northern Expanse, where primeval Beasts have awoken and new Hunters have answered the call for help. Your home has become a battlefield and the horizon fades to gray. Can you stop it?

name: Capitals of Tactoria
creator: ArcaneArchitect
description: Build kingdoms, battle friends, and enjoy fast, clever fun in this strategic card game full of interaction.

name: Fall Dawn
creator: Dustiny Games
description:
Fall Dawn is a competitive dungeon-crawler card game featuring
exploration, combat, character building, and a strong focus
on strategy and bluffing.

The world is falling apart. Escape the cataclysm and join the Erranti.
Share the road, the fight, the food, and the fire.
Be a loyal ally… then betray them and save your life.

name: VANEA: Guardians of the Eldertree (Relaunch)
creator: Forgotten Tales
description: Welcome to VANEA. A mystical and fairytale - tower defense - game. This game takes place in the ElderForest. You are a Guardian of the ElderTree and must defend it against scary monsters, bosses and the spreading darkmoon rot. Explore the ElderForest. Collect 6 different elemental orbs to master all of these elementals. Find magical orbs to learn new abilities and collect ore to craft powerful and legendary equipment. Hunt these monsters and also get your powerful elemental companion.

name: Pasteles & Conservas: Exotic Tides
creator: SaltandPepper
description:
Pasteles is a standalone solo game (20–30 minutes) about reopening your family’s corner pastry shop. You must balance customer demands, limited money, aging equipment, and an evolving recipe book, adapting your strategy with each pastry you bake to keep the business alive one day at a time.

Conservas: Exotic Tides, on the other hand, is an expansion for Conservas. It adds a brand-new year to the original solo experience, introducing new sea flavors, changing customer expectations, and new locations that bring fresh challenges—pushing players to adapt their fishing strategy and grow their conservas business beyond familiar waters.

name: TATANKA
creator: Creardo
description:
The wind sweeps across the Great Plains. 
The buffalo are still far. 
Winter is coming. 
TATANKA is a deep strategy game about the Native peoples of the Great Plains - their spirituality, traditions, and the relentless passage of time. 

Designed by Danilo Sabia with over a decade of historical and anthropological research behind every mechanic and every symbol. Illustrated by the Master KK Deb.

name: Possess Me, Satan
creator: Falling Whale Games
description: The chaotically fun social deduction game where even your host, Satan, has a role.

name: Flockers
creator: Odd Bird
description: Fly your flock of snow geese southward in this tactical card game of shrewd hand management.

name: SYNCANITE FOUNDATION: Reprint + CRIMSON PROTOCOL Gameplay Expansion
creator: SYNCANITE GAMES GmbH
description: Discover SYNCANITE FOUNDATION as a new player or expand your experience by mastering the CRIMSON PROTOCOL expansion and immerse yourself in this unique crystal punk world with a novel, an artbook, an audiobook and a music album thats available as limited vinyl edition!

name: The 30s
creator: Darkkena
description: The 30s is a descent into horror within an old 1930s house steeped in the Lovecraftian universe. A solo or 2-player cooperative experience where modular exploration unveils forbidden secrets, and every choice increases an ever-present psychological pressure, pushing both your sanity and your health to the limit. Will you be able to find the girl and escape the house?

name: Ludicurrus
creator: Iconiq Studios
description:
Ludicurrus is a vibrant, fast-paced chariot racing board game that throws you into the chaos of the Circus Maximus!

With push-your-luck mechanics, daring manoeuvres, and more than a dash of absurdity - every turn is a gamble in the hands of the gods!

The colourful, character-packed artwork brings the hilarity to life - brace yourself for ludicrous thrills and plenty of laughs!

name: Weasel Wars
creator: dartfrog games
description:
Command ruthless weasel heroes in a living forest that fights back.

A tactical adventure board game where every decision shapes your path through Evermoss—explore, fight, and survive in a world that reacts to you.

name: Button Shy Spring Collection - International
creator: Button Shy Games
description: Choose from Astro ROVE, Jarl, Everything Machine, and Shaper, or grab them all for one low price.

name: Orbital
creator: Firmwar
description: A cooperative electronic board game where astronauts fight to keep their space station alive. Modular boards, adaptive difficulty, expandable content, and digital updates.

name: Jure Grando: The first Vampire
creator: InterHuman games
description: A Folk-Horror Cooperative board game of quiet dread and difficult choices for 1-4 players

name: Hideouts: Legends of The Forest
creator: Weasel & Wolf
description: Hideouts is a tile drafting, strategy game for 2-4 players where you play as one of four animal factions to place, explore and conquer land. Use magic item cards to advance your rolls and weaken your opponents whilst strategically placing land tiles to expand your empire. You can fight, defend and burrow your way to victory to become the ultimate Legend of The Forest!

name: Race to Mars: Lunar Edition
creator: Fur Balloon Games
description: Race to put the first human being on Mars in this strategic deck-building racing game for 1–4 players.

name: Dwarf Emberforge
creator: Mythic Ember
description: Dwarf Emberforge is a fast 2–4-player card-powered board game where dwarf smiths use embers to power zones and forge legendary weapons, racing to become Master Smith.

name: Vermines - Deck Building Game
creator: ctrlZEBRE
description: Vermines is a 2-4 players deckbuilding game where you incarnate cultists who will have to sacrifice supporters to invoke their occult gods before the others. Our first game initialy released in France in 2021, this version is fully translated in english and heavily redesigned  to be even better !

name: Kangouroute
creator: Pretexte_editions
description:
Dans Kangouroute, les animaux de la forêt voisine veulent traverser la route pour couler des jours plus
heureux. Mais la traversée n’est pas sans danger sur ces routes fréquentées !
Aidez-les à rejoindre la verte prairie, tout en évitant les...”problèmes” !

name: Fluffypede
creator: ShyFinnGames
description: Build Fluffypedes together: the longer, the better. But don't let the cuteness fool you! Only the player who puts the last piece scores it all!

name: Iron Quest: The First Ember [Print & Play]
creator: Giza Games
description: A Viking sea adventure roll-and-write for 1–4 players. As a Captain, you must complete the King’s Orders by exploring uncharted islands, recruiting skilled crew members, building settlements and surviving raider attacks. Will you rise as the Jarl of the North… or be swallowed by the frozen sea?

name: VENATOR: Heroes of the Arena
creator: Red Kingdom Games
description: A strategic board game with deckbuilding, focused on combat between gladiators, creatures, and smart resource management.

name: Project : New Earth
creator: JRR Games
description:
Project: New Earth is a narrative game that can be played solo or cooperatively, in which players take on the roles of senior officers aboard a starship tasked with traveling through the stars to find and colonize a new planet.
From managing the crew to exploring unknown worlds and making crucial decisions, every choice influences the mission’s fate, with over 350 narrative events and a dozen unique endings.

name: Cosmic Contraband
creator: CaltropGames
description:
Cosmic Contraband is a fast-paced social bluffing game of lies, suspicion, and sneaky profits.

Take on the role of a Smuggler, trying to sneak valuable cargo past inspection, or the Justicar, the self-appointed space law enforcer who decides what gets through… and what gets “confiscated” for personal gain.

As a Smuggler, you’ll promise your cargo is completely legal because of course it is… but will you risk sneaking contraband through for bigger rewards?
As the Justicar, your job isn’t to catch every lie—it’s to catch the biggest liars and take their goods for yourself.

  Bluff - Blame -  Betray  

because in the end, the player with the most credits wins…

name: Bronze Island  |  a bronze age civilization strategy
creator: Moth Games Design
description: Grow your Bronze Age civilization and struggle for limited resources while trying to exploit technological advancements and your opponents’ mistakes!

name: BARZONE Cocktail Card Game
creator: Barzone
description:
Welcome to the world of BARZONE, where you can become a master bartender by playing through a full shift behind the bar. Here, you’ll discover this unique world with everything that comes with it: great drinks, new techniques, exciting behind-the-scenes tasks, and even challenging situations that bartenders sometimes have to face.
During the game, you’ll compete against one or more rivals to earn the most mastery points. The better you craft your drinks, the more mastery points you gain and by the end, you may prove yourself as a true master bartender.
If this sounds exciting to you, don’t hesitate. Jump in, embrace the experience, and enjoy the feeling of all eyes on you as you take control of the bar.

name: Rock Hard 1977 IN ITALIANO
creator: Devir Italia
description:
Rock Hard 1977 arriva finalmente tradotto ed esclusivamente in Italiano!
Con questa campagna otterrete: 1 Rock Hard 1977 in italiano, il disco del Concerto bootleg, 1 Promo Jackie Fox e 1 Espansione Ear Candy!
Il gioco base Rock Hard 1977 (prezzo al pubblico 55€) e l'espansione Ear Candy (prezzo al pubblico 15€) verranno corredati della Promo Jackie Fox e del disco registrato dal vivo a Vaeva X Rock Hard 1977 Play 2026! I prezzi sono considerati iva inclusa. Quindi in fase di raccolta dati e indirizzi, raccoglieremo esclusivamente le spese di spedizioni, pari a 10€.
 
Attenzione: questa è una campagna di preordine. Il gioco sarà in stampa se raggiungiamo almeno le 500 copie.

name: Mythorifts: The Rise of Asgard & International Edition
creator: Mithronix Games
description: Mythorifts is an tactical and asymmetrical Fantasy & Mythological TCG for 2-4 players in which players harness the power of the Gods, summon Mythical Creatures, and cast powerful Spells.

name: FIRE RESPONSE | season · city
creator: response-boardgames
description:
Fire Response: The Ultimate Tabletop Firefighting Simulation
Take command of your own fire department and face dynamic, high-stakes emergency scenarios. Through strategic deck-building, you choose your equipment and tactics, while the innovative layering system ensures every decision carries weight—every card you play physically alters the course of the mission.

Authentic, intense, and developed directly from the real-world experience of an incident commander.

name: VEX - The Vegan Experiment
creator: VEX - The Vegan Experiment
description:
Vegans versus carnivores, two factions, one single goal: winning.
VEX – The Vegan Experiment is a card game of strategy, cooperation, and plot twists, with a touch of luck.

name: Doloir Dragon Soul Gemstone Dice – Hand-Carved, Ethically Sourced, For Gamers Who Breathe Fantasy
creator: Doloir
description: Handcrafted by gamers, Doloir Dragon Soul Gemstone Dice are ethically sourced natural gem RPG dice, forged with dragon‑themed original design. Seven premium stones, precision carved, balanced rolls, for D&D and tabletop adventures. Each set carries legendary dragon spirit, built for collectors and heroes who seek beauty, honor, and fair rolls. We craft with heart, support community, and roll for a better world.

name: Print & Crawl: The print & play dungeon crawler
creator: Anthony Hobday
description: A print-and-play tactical dungeon crawler for 1–4 players, with classic fantasy heroes, square-grid combat, and a full 12-scenario campaign.

name: [SYNSOULS] ECG - The World Is Singing
creator: Hotel Sarasa Games LLC
description:
[SYNSOULS] is a strategic Expandable Card Game with a unique Three Row battle system and a number of new and familiar mechanics!

Absolutely NO GENERATIVE AI is used in this project!

name: INSANITÀ S.p.A. 2.0: Quando il Profitto Vale più delle Persone
creator: Ciuffo
description:
Benvenuti a INSANITÀ S.p.A.: il gioco da tavolo in cui diventi uno spietato magnate della sanità! Acquista, investi e gestisci ospedali, personale e reparti in un sistema in cui la salute ha un prezzo e l'etica è facoltativa.
Se investi troppo, il tuo personale andrà in burnout. Se giochi troppo sul sicuro, il tuo impero crollerà.
Solo chi sa bilanciare cinismo, fortuna e strategia sopravviverà.

Perché nella sanità privata... chi non può permettersi il ricovero ospedaliero non fa una bella fine.

name: Car Enthusiast Chess Set
creator: cj_garz
description: Designed by petrolheads for petrolheads, this set swaps traditional figures for high-definition resin engine and performance parts. From Twin-Scroll Turbo Queens to Exhaust Header Knights, every piece is a detailed tribute to automotive engineering. Each component is precision-weighted and fitted with N52 magnets for a tactile, "snap-to-grid" feel on the board. For the ultimate setup, our Land Rover-inspired base offers a rugged, storage vault that doubles as the playing surface. It’s a clean, mechanical centerpiece built for the garage, the office, or the enthusiast's home.

name: Lithomachy: Trials of the Gods
creator: Pantheon Games
description:
Lithomachy is a mythological roll-and-write puzzle adventure inspired by the Titanomachy. 
Roll dice, place litho-forms on the sacred grid, and help the Olympian gods restore balance as Titans hurl stones across the world.

name: Brand Battles TCG
creator: DaveT9713
description:
Brand Battles – The Trading Card Game Where Your Brands Fight to Dominate

Brand Battles is a fast-paced, strategic TCG where your real-world-style brands become warriors in a battle for market supremacy.

You don’t just collect cards — you build an empire, manage wealth & influence, forge powerful synergies between brands, and then send your battle-ready forces into head-to-head combat.

name: Nemesis Retaliation: Mystery Box
creator: Awaken Realms
description: Leftover Nemesis Retaliation boxes available for U.S. customers.

name: Pacific War Games
creator: PHALANX
description: This is the pre-order page for Tora Tora Tora! and 1943 Race to Rabaul, two games that explore the Pacific War from very different angles. One delivers a fast, brutal duel of attrition, the other a deep operational struggle where logistics, air power, and timing decide everything.

name: Tales of Myth and Legend Preorder
creator: Van Ryder Games
description: In this narrative, paragraph book game about an epic struggle for power, 1-4 players will each take a hero's journey, competing against each other and/or Alexander the Great, to be the unifier of a mythological Greece.

name: SAGA: Vikings vs Anglo-Saxon
creator: PHALANX
description: Saga: Vikings vs Anglo-Saxons is a quick-playing area control and tile activation game for two players. Dive into the vicious era of Viking invasions of England (8th to 11th century AD) and command either the ruthless raiders from across the sea, or the resilient Anglo-Saxon warriors!

name: Cosmic Crowns
creator: Sumain Games
description: Cosmic Crowns is a chaotic strategy card game where you collect crowns, sabotage rivals, and embrace pure mayhem. Expect the unexpected!

name: Mixrack Wave 3
creator: Grim Rabbit Games
description: A system that unlocks new ways to enjoy the things you love.

name: Menú del día
creator: Caravan Games
description: Menú del Día is a solo or two-player cooperative game where you must survive the rush of the service and help your restaurant progress day after day.

name: Dribble 'n' Dice - Pro League
creator: Runner Games
description: A tactical football board game for two coaches – easy to learn, hard to master.

name: Dark Kingdoms - Conquer Britannia!
creator: Draco Ideas
description: Conquer 5th-century Britannia: lead your people, expand your realm, and prove who is worthy to rule the island.

name: Bloodstone
creator: Druid City Games
description:
Bloodstone throws you into Vanira’s deadly arena, where champions fight to the death and are resurrected by the cursed Bloodstone to battle again and again. Command your hero, manipulate custom dice to outwit foes, and survive monstrous bosses in a tense, ever-changing battlefield brought to life with stunning art by Blizzard veteran David Kegg.

In Bloodstone, you control one of the characters and use a custom dice mechanism to determine your attacks and movements, using your miniature to move around the arena and engage in combat. You hope someday to escape this damned place, but tonight...you fight!

name: Aeolis
creator: Meeple Pug
description: Aeolis is a fully cooperative kingdom-building and civilization game for 1–7 players set in a rich alternative Ancient Greek world. Choose unique roles, build and protect your kingdom, and face invasions, disasters, and political unrest through deep strategic gameplay.

name: A Life
creator: Skellig Games
description: In "A Life" 1-4 players play through a lifetime. From birth to old age, players choose which experiences their characters will have. In doing so, they collect resources such as knowledge, experience, dreams, and money, which they need to develop experiences. In addition, the experiences determine the inner values of the characters, which determine which resources each player receives victory points for at the end of their life. So it is not the richest, smartest, or most successful who wins, but the one who has lived their life best according to their values.

name: Growing Season Deluxe Edition
creator: Undigital
description: Turn a quiet field into a thriving farm in this cozy card game of shrewd hand management and gentle engine building.

name: They Own The Night
creator: nightcitygames
description:
They Own the Night is a strategic fantasy board game for one to four players where each player takes on the role of a wizard forging their own path through a dangerous, ever-changing world. Throughout the game, players encounter battles against orcs, rival wizards, and other enemies while collecting powerful spells to strengthen their abilities.
Every decision matters. The choices you make shape your character’s destiny—follow a path of good to become a Bright, or embrace darker actions and transform into a Dark Lord. Each choice carries weight, influencing both your powers and how the game unfolds.
To win, players must grow stronger, navigate challenges wisely, and ultimately face and defeat the Dark Lord at the end.

name: Vatrakill
creator: Le Sésame
description: Asymmetrical strategy game in which the knights must capture the dragon. The dragon must devour 5 knights.

name: Elora: Tales of the Realm
creator: New Realm Game Company
description: ELORA: TALES OF THE REALM is a classic-styled fantasy card game set in the fantastical realm of Elora. Compete against your opponents and claim your place in the realm!

name: The Council of Anderian
creator: Juggling Bear
description:
Join the Council of Anderian. Forge alliances, betray your rivals, and claim the crown. You may need allies to win… but trust is never guaranteed.

In this strategy board game of intrigue, negotiation, and roleplay, each player leads a Great House of Anderian, using asymmetric powers and sharp political decisions to shape the fate of the realm.

name: Invagocreatures
creator: Invagocreatures
description: Invagocreautres is a card game featuring 2 armies of creatures consisting of 144 cards, 72 cards for each army. It is played turn by turn, with each player holding 8 cards per round. The objective of the game is to win as many rounds as possible. To make the game even more fun, we offer the option to add booster packs for each army of creatures (28 cards) to the base game. In this crowdfunding campaign, we are offering you 2 sets of cards (base decks) + 4 Gold booster packs.

name: Altera
creator: IV Studio
description:
At the Ascension Festival, the great Houses gather to determine who will rise to the High Council.
You lead a House among rivals, sending emissaries across the city to earn Prestige and secure your place.

name: Concordia Special Edition
creator: Awaken Realms
description: Brings the beloved classic to life with new art, refined usability, and expansions.

name: Arcanixia: The Ultimate Wizard Wagering Card Game
creator: KD Entertainment
description: Arcanixia is a fast, interactive card game where every turn is a mind game. Make hidden wagers, call bluffs, unleash chaotic spells, and race to claim victory as the one true Archmage.

name: Islands of Ikaria
creator: Hellfire Games
description: An easy to learn deckbuilding card game with the charm of the 90s featuring 100% traditionally hand-painted art.

name: 1840 Age Of Lions
creator: baldassare murania
description:
Lead the legendary Florio dynasty or one of his 3 rivals in 19th-century Sicily. 
Build an industrial empire of sulfur and wine, navigate the treacherous marriage market of Palermo,
 and secure your family's prestige in this deep heavy Eurogame. 
Strategy, heritage, and ambition collide will you become the Lion of Sicily?"
*All the Picture and Video are produced with AI support, and they are not definetely in the final game that we will produce.*

name: Rules of Sacred Realm
creator: MagicIsland
description:
Choose your characters. Build your team. Fight for Victory. 
In Rules of Sacred Realm, different characters clash in a high-risk tactical card battle built around a shared deck system. Master different playstyles, combine powerful abilities, and outsmart opponents in fast, punishing combat where every decision matters.

name: Sovereign: Shōgun
creator: PHALANX
description: Cherry blossoms fall, Japan teeters on war, and five ruthless lords know the throne is up for grabs, one of them is you. Build your clan, outplay your rivals with steel and scheming, and win not just by force, but by bending alliances, trade, and the boy regent to your will.

name: Politik
creator: Black Yeti Games
description: Nations compete for military, political and corporate control of a fallen world.

name: Bullet Galaxy: Two New Expansions for Bullet!
creator: Level 99 Games
description: Two new expansions for Bullet, as well as your chance to get all the Bullet fun!  Bullet seamlessly merges the energy of fast-paced puzzle solving with free-for-all combat. Utilize one of 50 heroines in fast-paced 15 to 20 minute games for 1 to 8 players!

name: HOXFALL
creator: Teburu
description: HOXFALL is a survival horror dungeon crawler where 1-5 players try to escape a secret military facility after a failed experiment breaches containment, all while being pursued by an ever-growing horde of alien mutants in this immersive, highly replayable campaign, where every moment counts!

name: Caribbean Adventures TCG
creator: Frida Studios
description: Caribbean Adventures is a dynamic card game that blends naval strategy with classic wargame mechanics. Command your fleet, outmaneuver your enemies, and dominate the seas through tactical decision-making. Build your deck, plan your attacks, and relive the golden age of piracy in every match. A unique experience where card play meets epic maritime warfare.

name: Sword and Snow
creator: Soar Games
description:
When the throne is empty, alliances are weapons.
The Emperor is dead. The Sword Tomb refused to name a successor. Four heirs raise armies, share liquor, sign treaties — and break them. But while princes fight for the throne, something stirs in the cursed snow of Zu. The dead are walking. They do not care who wins. Sword & Snow is a game where every alliance hides a knife, and every winter forces enemies to defend the realm — together, or die alone in the snow.

name: TOWER.exe – A Solo Poker Dice Roguelike for your Pocket [Dynamic PnP of the Month & Gamebook]
creator: Beaverlicious Games
description: Turn random dice rolls into devastating tactical builds as you climb a tower filled with evolving enemies, unpredictable loot, and endlessly stacking synergies. Manipulate your fighters, optimize combos, and weaponize absurd item effects to survive increasingly impossible fights.

name: Heroes of the Hidden World
creator: Eternal Wind Games
description: A narrative adventure inspired by gamebooks, where choices, exploration, and role-playing guide a thrilling journey, playable solo, cooperatively, or with a Game Master guiding the story.

name: Magus Dominus
creator: Eternal Wind Games
description: Master forbidden magic, combine arcane ingredients, and complete powerful spells before your rivals to prove yourself worthy of becoming the next Magus Dominus in this strategic fantasy card game.

name: Depths of Cadwallon
creator: Monolith Board Games
description: Descend beneath the Free City of Cadwallon in a fantasy dungeon crawler where misfits, mercenaries and treasure hunters brave forgotten ruins, deadly creatures and buried secrets in search of glory and riches. Also, expand this journey through The Book of Aarklash, the definitive lorebook of the universe.

name: Incarnation
creator: Monolith Board Games
description: Lead Incarnated heroes and elite warriors into battle in a tactical fantasy skirmish game set in the reborn world of Aarklash. Explore its legends, peoples and forgotten history through The Book of Aarklash, the definitive lorebook of the universe.

name: Believe in me! (please)
creator: Wyrmgold
description: You are a god! Or that's what everybody else should think. That tornado? Totally you. Tsunami? Somebody must have made you angry. Use natural events to convince people you control the elements to build your flock and show up those other namby-pamby false gods that you're the one, and absolutely only really true god!

name: Stonefall [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Escape goblins, ogres, and the evil forgefiend as you lead a small band of dwarves out of their collapsing mine!

name: Spell Poker
creator: Kaaos Games
description: Poker and deckbuilding! Spell Poker is a combination of Texas Hold'em and fantasy card games. Betting and bluffing are combined to TCG-like strategy and hand management. Players play Texas Hold'em against each other using the power of the spells to modify community cards. Medium-luck, high strategy and high interaction.

name: Strike HQ - The Game of Battle Strategy
creator: Themeborne
description: A head-to-head battle card game with unique gameplay and a pixelated art style.

name: Ka'an: Cities in the Sky
creator: William Burgos
description: A mid-weight resource-management and worker-placement card game where you build a pyramidal civilization towards the sky. Use golems to construct buildings and gather resources for your critters who populate your city. Designed by Diego Burgos, illustrated by Ivan Escalante. Developed in Mexico with Mayan inspiration.

name: Ironmasters of Yorkshire
creator: Michal Jarzembowski
description: IRONMASTERS OF YORKSHIRE is a competitive economic and strategic resource management game set in 18th-century Yorkshire during the Industrial Revolution. Players take the roles of ironmasters who develop mines, produce steel, establish companies, and build infrastructure. Through careful resource management, strategic expansion, and well-timed investments, players compete to build the strongest industrial network. Steal a march on your rivals, and become the greatest industrialist of the age of machines.

name: Touristes temporels
creator: Lutra Games
description: Book your next holidays to the past. Enjoy your travel through different times but be careful of the butterfly effects that can destroy the present and keep an eye on your fellow travelers who can spoil your holidays!

name: SAPROMETE
creator: LOOMOON
description: Competitive Dungeon Crawler for 2-4 players. Set in 8000 AD, excavate a destructible board, manage your crew, and survive a setting that blends the optimism of abundance and progress with dystopian control.

name: The Thing: The Boardgame & The Cardgame
creator: Pendragon Game Studio srl
description: The official board game and card game based on the 1982 cult movie.

name: Ruin: Fallen Kingdoms
creator: Skillva Studios
description: In a world consumed by collapsing kingdoms, kings fight for survival and absolute dominion. This board game combines lethal tactical combat, dark exploration, and intense PvP raids.

name: RoS: The Board Game
creator: The Realm Of Silvanus
description: Master the forest in this fast-paced family game! Harness crystals and summon powerful Guardians of Silvanus, then outmaneuver your rivals in a tactical card-and-dice competition. A vibrant, family-friendly fantasy experience where resource management meets high-stakes multiplayer strategy. Will you be the first to secure the Temples and rule the Realm?

name: WitchHunt: Satiric Party Game
creator: Bardmistr Games
description: Become an inquisitor, seize power, and send a few “witches” — meaning inconvenient citizens — to the stake. A fast-paced card showdown awaits, packed with dark humor and soft roleplaying.

name: Scalar Core
creator: VituCraft
description:
Scalar Core is a modern tactical board game, inspired by the timeless logic of classic tabletop games but reimagined for the future. Experience a fast, ruthless duel where 27 unique artisan dice
clash for dominion!

name: Trials of MAYA
creator: Zain Memon
description: An arena-based expandable card game set in the MAYA Narrative Universe. Command champions with customizable decks across various game modes and maps. Manage your energy, chain mind-bending combos, and strike at the right moment to win.

name: Speed-Fold W40k Ruins
creator: Rayu
description: Modular and foldable wargame scenery — made in Spain with professional SLA 3D printing using ABS-like resin

name: Mykerinos - Special Edition
creator: Looping_Games
description: Excavate the past. Control the present. Win the final exhibition.

name: VALKYO TRADING CARD GAME 2026
creator: VALKYO
description:
VALKYO TCG OFFICIAL is a new trading card game launched in 2026, bringing a fresh take on strategic dueling. Each player uses both a Deck and a Strike Deck, creating a dynamic and layered gameplay experience.

From the main Deck, players can summon monsters from Rank 1 to Rank 10 and activate spells (Magic Hex and Magic Trig). Rank 1–4 monsters require no resource cost, but only one can be summoned per turn. Rank 5–10 monsters are summoned using the Magic Stage System, a unique mechanic that enhances strategy and gameplay flow.
From the Strike Deck, players can unleash four types of powerful, game-changing monsters: FUSSE Monsters, EVO Monsters, SYGMO Monsters, and RESONATE Monsters. The Strike Deck is powered by the innovative 4 Strike Deck Mechanics, adding speed, depth, and explosive plays to every match.

With dynamic mechanics and more exciting features planned in future expansions, VALKYO is built to continuously evolve.

Build your deck. Master your strategy. Strike with VALKYO!!!

name: Glory of Civilizations
creator: Kresalo
description: A 4X civilization game spanning a thousand years of medieval history. Your nation evolves through 160+ branching cultures, each era building on the last instead of replacing it.

name: IGNITION:CORE Tactical Mech Combat
creator: Ignition Core Games
description: IGNITION:CORE is a low model count, compact miniatures skirmish game featuring anime style fighting robots competing to hold ground in the desperate sci fi setting of Isalia.

name: Aeon's End: System Overload
creator: Indie Boards and Cards
description: Aeon’s End: System Overload brings you a new, five battle expedition and introduces a new mechanic - Magical Intensity - that creates new ways for mages to work together. This box is a standalone product with new mages, nemeses, supply cards, friends and foes, and treasures that will enhance anyone’s collection.

name: FlickFleet: Box of Xeno Flicks 2
creator: Eurydice Games Ltd
description: FlickFleet: Box of Xeno Flicks 2 is the seventh expansion for the FlickFleet space combat dexterity game, which is rated Must-Play by TableTop Gaming Magazine.

name: Black Rose Wars: Resonance
creator: Teburu
description: Black Rose Wars: Resonance is an adaptation of the beloved competitive game of deck-building, strategy, and combat for 1 to 6 players, redesigned for the Teburu system for accessibility and immersiveness.

name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Abyssal Echoes
creator: Teburu
description: Vampire: The Masquerade - Abyssal Echoes is a new chronicle for 1-4 players and an expansion for both VTM - Milan Uprising and VTM - Palermo Conspiracies, where players switch between cities and timelines.

name: The Bad Karmas and the Curse of Cthulhu: Volume 6 + The Curse of Competition DLC
creator: Teburu
description: The Bad Karmas return to the Curse of Cthulhu with Volume 6 and an all-new competitive game mode with the Curse of Competition DLC!  Battle against giant AI-driven monsters in this dynamic and immersive coop boss battler for 1-5 players. Featuring new hero archetypes and three new bosses from the Cthulhu Mythos, the Bad Karmas must once again fight to save humanity, without succumbing to the horror...

name: EVE: Squadrons - The Dice Game
creator: Titan Forge
description: EVE: Squadrons Dice Game is coming! Mine, Build, Loot, Upgrade, Vanquish!  Your squadron awaits!

name: Space Universalis
creator: Ludic Dragon Games
description: Space Universalis is not just an endless dungeon crawler for 1–6 players playable solo or co-op. It is a robust game system with quick setup, scalable difficulty, great tactical depth, and maximum customization. Immerse yourself in a whirlwind of exploration, tension, and combat in the far future.

name: Roll 4 MORE Rum!
creator: FlorianFiedler
description:
The tavern is louder, the sea is rougher, and the treasure is buried deeper.

Welcome back to the world of Roll4Rum. Following the incredible journey of the original game, Roll4MORERum expands the horizon with deeper mechanics, specialized crew, and a brand-new way to command your ship. This isn't just a map; it’s a career on the high seas.

name: From The Grid
creator: MageTCG
description:
From the Grid is Mage TCG's first official expansion. 

Story: Neon technomancers bend code into magic while cybernetic samurai enforce order in a city built on stolen souls—set in a bold 80’s anime-inspired future where power is limitless, and never free.

Rival elves, rogue technomancers, and iron-willed samurai clash across 
the Spire as secrets unravel and loyalties fracture. Every card reveals
a character fighting for control, survival, or truth in a system that 
demands sacrifice.

MageTCG is a post-apocalyptic dark fantasy trading card game and first person battle simulator.

name: Greedy Merchants from the Jagiellonian Trade Route
creator: Lukasz Kurlit
description: A dynamic board game full of negative interaction and unexpected twists, requiring strategic planning. Immerse yourself in the realities of the medieval Jagiellonian Trade Route, stretching for centuries between the great capitals of Poland and Lithuania—Kraków and Vilnius—and build your fortune, not always fairly.

name: Core Space: Evolution
creator: Battle Systems
description: Core Space is back, and it’s evolved… Core Space is a co-operative sci-fi dungeon crawler board game for 1-6 players, and we are returning to the galactic core in a new and improved second edition. Follow this page for all the latest news.

name: DIE Ball - A Button Shy Modular Game
creator: Button Shy Games
description: DIE Ball is a sport where two teams try to run, kick, or throw the cube shaped ball down the field, while battling their opponent along the way.

name: Total Command: 1991
creator: Total Command Games
description: Lead the war in Total Command: 1991, an alternate timeline global strategy game for 3–10 players, featuring dice-based combat, where you command one of three major factions, NATO, AFME, or the Eurasian Pact across a massive battlefield. Manage resources, fight on land, sea, and air, and invest in research to unlock technologies that shift the balance. As time progresses, nuclear weapons can reshape the conflict. Or play as the Rogue Nation, disrupting the world from the shadows.

name: Expletus
creator: AstralAbominations
description:
It's going to be a 2–4 player board game full of violence, dark humour, and a bit of nudity. If you like Warhammer, masculine men, beautiful women, and deep customization (we’ll talk about it later… for now it’s a secret), this game is for you.
WARNING: These concept arts were generated by AI only to show you my idea. Once the funds are gathered, I’m going to hire a real artists to create everything in the style of the picture below...or comic...honestly, the crowd will choose.

name: Of Wheat & Wonders - The Cozy Solitaire Civilization Game [Dynamic PnP of the Month & Gamebook]
creator: Beaverlicious Games
description: In Of Wheat & Wonders, you lead a growing civilization through ever-changing scenarios! Generate a map, gather resources, expand your settlements, and unlock powerful advancements over a 15-year reign shaped by unexpected disasters.

name: Token Terrors Battlegrounds Season 2 TERROR RISING
creator: Token Terrors
description:
Token Terrors Battlegrounds is a fast, low-luck skirmish game of clever drafting, brutal clashes, and high-stakes positioning. Build your army of dice-sized mini-monsters and outmaneuver your opponent using a clean, tactical action system that rewards foresight and bold play. Matches are quick, but every decision matters, and every faction unlocks new ways to dominate the Battlegrounds

Packed with handcrafted artwork, asymmetric factions, and a modular battleground, Token Terrors delivers big wargame energy in a compact, collectible format. Back now for exclusive content, complete faction sets, and a fully loaded founder experience.

TOKEN TERRORS - mini-monsters, BIG BATTLES!

name: MAYACO
creator: IlOa Gaming
description:
colorful jungle crawler
in the ruins of yucatán
meets a profound eurogame-ressource-management

name: Grim Era
creator: Cat In The Box Studio
description: A strategic, myth-driven board game where you become a chthonic god in a world forsaken by the divine. Summon legendary Beasts, commit unholy Atrocities, and conquer sacred lands as you carve your name into the ruins of Archaia.

name: Earth Under Siege: Warzone
creator: Dark Horizon Games
description: Earth Under Siege: Warzone is a small unit skirmish game for 1-4 players. Pick a side and get in the battle!

name: Umbral Knights
creator: Borogove Games
description:
Umbral Knights is a solo and cooperative adventure horror exploration game, where every step drifts between dread and redemption.

In death, their stories should have ended — yet the abyss whispered otherwise.
Bound in armor colder than the grave, the Umbral Knights rise once more to walk the veil between worlds.
They are neither living nor dead, wielding blades that remember every sin they’ve committed.

Across cursed forests and forsaken keeps, they hunt the echoes of their past, seeking the faint light of forgiveness in a world devoured by despair.

In the silence of the Hollow Sanctum, their vow endures:
not for glory, nor for gold… but for redemption.

name: Garden Dragons
creator: B A Games
description: The Great Migration of Dragons is coming! It's time to prepare the fields by planting the flowers they love. However, in the tall grass, you will discover dragon hatchlings in need of a new home. Take some home with you to raise as one of your own while others will have to be cared for at the Dragon Nursery. Plant beautiful gardens and collect cute dragons in…Garden Dragons!

name: Cola Wars
creator: OneMoreTurnGames
description: It's 1985.  You're in charge of marketing for a radical new cola brand.  Economic strategy, worker placement, and tableau building.  Enjoy, or else.

name: Diables
creator: SaltandPepper
description: Diables is a mid-heavy eurogame designed by Dani Garcia for 1–4 players in which you lead a colla in the spectacular Mediterranean tradition of the Ball de Diables. Manage your performers, fireworks, and events to create the most thrilling shows, impress the crowds, and earn the greatest renown.

name: SENGOKU
creator: Leo Soloviey
description:
It is the year 1551, and feudal Japan is in the midst of war - the Sengoku period. Across the land, the ambition and power of five daimyō are rising. Take on the role of one of them, overthrow the old shogunate, and unite Japan under your rule!

A new area control game for 1–5 players, the third entry in a series following Bretwalda and Principes.

name: NARCOS
creator: Smartup Games
description: Powerful cartels and law enforcement clash in a brutal war for control of Colombia.

name: Gang Wars
creator: Redzen Games
description: [COMING SUMMER 2026] Discover a brand-new game set in the world of Scarface 1920: faster, more intense, and action-packed. Fight for the streets, dominate the liquor business, and rise as the King of Chicago.

name: Exceed Skytear
creator: Skytear Games
description:
Introducing the 8th season of Exceed by Level 99, the best-selling fighting card game of all time! 
The Skytear season brings: 16 fighters from the setting of games like Onwward and Skytear Horde, a new AREA CONTROL season mechanic, and a SOLO mode by Michael Kelley (One Stop Co-Op Shop). Mix-and-match with any past season or just play it stand-alone!

name: Mindbug - Dinopunk
creator: Nerdlab Games
description: The acclaimed card battler co-designed by Richard Garfield returns with a revolutionary new game mode. All the depth and identity of deckbuilding reimagined into the fastest, most intense dueling experience ever created. Where every match is a new build.

name: The Breach: Reprint & Hellcore expansion
creator: Ludus Magnus Studio
description: Hack the Gene.sys database in this competitive net-crawler of resource management and tactical viruses. Includes the original campaign reprint and the brand-new Hellcore expansion, featuring a massive and stunning centerpiece model!

name: Heroes of Might and Magic III: The Board Game - Factory, Bulwark & Forge Expansions
creator: Archon Studio
description: Lead mighty heroes and command iconic fantasy armies in a new campaign introducing the Factory and Bulwark towns, alongside the Forge—created in collaboration with original designer Gregory Fulton. Gather all factions and expand your command to 13 unique towns!

name: Alexandria
creator: Meeple Pug
description: Relive Alexandria’s golden age as the intellectual capital of the world, in the era of the Great Library and Lighthouse, through a fully asymmetrical competitive game built on constructive, positive interaction.

name: Naruto Shippuden Battle
creator: This is a GAME
description: The first official arena board game with miniatures based on the hit anime Naruto Shippuden, adapted from the manga by Masashi Kishimoto. NARUTO SHIPPUDEN BATTLE is a tactical arena board game for 2 or 4 players, developed by This Is A Game in partnership with Don't Panic Games, featuring large miniatures and teams of 3 ninjas clashing in fast-paced, card-driven combat, unleashing powerful jutsu combos in 30-minute battles.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Ascension
creator: Stone Blade Entertainment
description:
The Lord of the Rings™: Ascension™ is a deckbuilding game for 1–4 players that takes you on an adventure through Middle-earth across three interconnected Ascension sets. It features the beloved mechanics of the Ascension Deckbuilding Game, reimagined to capture the wonder of The Lord of the Rings, from its legendary heroes and villains to the corruption of The One Ring. 

The fate of the world hangs by a thread. Will you rally the Free Peoples—Elves, Humans, Dwarves, and Hobbits—or turn toward the Shadow of Mordor? Recruit heroes, acquire powerful cards, and shape your strategy as you build your strength, all while confronting the quiet, ever-present pull of The One Ring. The game is fast to learn and difficult to master; each choice carries weight, and the path to victory is never without cost.

name: Ancient Blood: New Expansion and Limited Stock
creator: Dark Gate Games
description: Includes 3 new stories, printed Rulebook 2.1, and new cards that add variety and fresh challenges to the game.

name: Green Sonata
creator: Yaoback
description: This is a tabletop tennis game that blends strategy, entertainment, visual appeal, and strong immersion. It brings the passion of major tournaments to your table — no court or physical effort required. Start a professional match in just 3 seconds. Experience the satisfying "thump" of tennis strokes right on your table.

name: Kravestorm
creator: reedarsenhorn
description: A formation-based card battler fueled by self-destructive power. Protect your Capital, ride the nightmare, and win before you overdose. An "addictive" tactical experience designed in Poland. Follow for a launch gift!

name: FromVille
creator: Axe of Shadows
description:
Inspired by the acclaimed suspense and horror series "From," FromVille takes you to a cursed town you cannot escape, surrounded by a terrifying darkness that comes alive at night. Lead a group of brave survivors as you explore sinister locations, face immortal demons, and fight to protect the town's inhabitants. With dynamic day and night cycles, unpredictable events, and a board filled with mystery, you'll need to make strategic decisions to survive and uncover the dark secrets of the town.

But remember! Once you're in, the town won't let you leave. A board game that combines strategy, cooperation, and a touch of psychological horror. Are you ready to survive the night?

name: DEATHCHASE
creator: MTW_GAMES
description: A tactical combat racer set in a dystopian wasteland. Win the race, claim your freedom.

name: The Veiled Forest
creator: Cthonic Games
description: As you wander the shady paths of the forest, you start to feel that you were drawn here for a reason, one shrouded in mystery. Venture ever deeper into the forest, and the truth within your journey slowly begins to reveal itself. Collect rare items , manipulate dice outcomes, uncover hidden events, and master your abilities as you navigate a dark, shifting world. You are lost in The Veiled Forest, a dark fantasy board game for 2–4 players, focused on planning, resource management, strategy, and decision-making. Follow us now to stay updated and claim your free gift.

name: Reapers
creator: Peel Tower Games
description:
Are you ready to embark on an otherworldly adventure? Gather your courage, sharpen your scythe, and step into the realm of Reapers!

In the shadowy land between life and death, Reapers wage epic battles for supremacy. These spectral warriors, once mortal themselves, now wield supernatural powers to harvest souls and claim victory. But beware, the path to glory is fraught with peril, and only the cunning and brave will emerge triumphant.

name: HETMAN
creator: hetman games
description:
Looks like Ludo. Plays like 3D chess.

What if a simple board game turned into a battle of minds?

name: Pick n´Roll
creator: Akaro Dice
description: Pick n’ Roll Basketball is a tactical game that recreates the intensity of basketball on the tabletop. Control your team, execute plays, manage your players, and roll the dice to dominate the court.

name: The World in Me: 55+ Unique Countries. Endless Stories. One Deck.
creator: Kraken Tales
description:
Play. Reflect. Connect.
A multi-use affirmation card deck inspired by countries around the world. Featuring 55+ unique, high-quality hand-drawn country cards, each paired with a meaningful affirmation.

Play it as a game, use it as a daily ritual, and bring inspiration into your everyday life.

name: Going The Distance: Boxing in its Golden Age
creator: Porthosian Games
description: Players get to live the drama and excitement of boxing’s golden age. You will wince when your fighter takes a heavy blow, feel exhilaration when your boxer evades a determined flurry, and feel euphoria when your fighter knocks out what seemed to be an indestructible foe. Set in the 1930s and 1940s, players create sporting history with an ensemble cast of unique and larger than life boxers.

name: PARASITORIUM 66
creator: RPG Figures
description: A fast-paced sci-fi tabletop skirmish wargame delivered entirely as digital files (PDF & STL) for 3D printing. Command your faction, adapt to the grim world of Parasitorium 66, and fight for survival!

name: CityNova: Build Your Legacy
creator: Alex Bulanov
description: City building game, where each player controls and develops his/her own city. Resource management is one of the keys to success! Use help of unique Contractors to complete various task and quest. Construct different building with different benefits. Increase city population and income. Get VP from different sources to win the game.

name: Pirates In Peril
creator: Ludenbois
description:
Pirates in Peril: a tactical adventure game where captains and crews battle for treasure… while the Kraken turns the sea into a deadly trap.
A swashbuckling pirate showdown full of twists, in a 100% French-made game crafted entirely from wood.

name: Kemet: The Gates of Thonis
creator: Kolossal Games
description: Prepare to unleash the full might of the gods and forge a new destiny on the sands of Kemet! Kolossal Games is thrilled to announce the upcoming Gamefound campaign for Kemet: The Gates of Thonis, bringing thrilling new maps and tiles to add strategic depth to your beloved Kemet: Blood and Sand experience.

name: AetherFall - The War of Elements
creator: RanghosGames
description:
An ancient prophecy has awakened the Guardians of Etherea—powerful sorcerers determined to seize its energy for themselves. Step into a world where Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Light, and Shadow clash in a relentless struggle for dominance. Choose your Guardian, claim strategic zones, unleash devastating spells, and outwit your rivals through bold tactics and clever bluffing.
 
AetherFall is a strategic board game that combines memory, deception, and area control into a dynamic and immersive experience.

name: Imperial Twing (Second Edition)
creator: Imperial Games GmbH
description: Second Edition of the a magical card and dice dueling game, Imperial Twing. The same captivating gameplay, amazing artwork and many hours of fun, now available in more languages and at a greatly reduced price!

name: EREBUS
creator: Sakne Games
description: Expand your corporate empire on EREBUS. Deploy workers, construct industrial facilities, and strategically reshape the board to outmaneuver your rivals and secure lucrative contracts.

name: MINSEOS TREASURE
creator: Mochi Studio
description:
Minseo’s treasure is a new TCG designed for people who love Korean culture, from Kpop to Kdramas. 

Our mission is to promote  Korean culture (K-culture) through games ♥️

All characters and magical creatures are designed with love and patience. Zero use of AI !

name: Grind House the Narrative Horror Story Game - Season 3
creator: Everything Epic
description:
Grind House is a fast-paced, narrative-driven tabletop horror game that feels like playing through a lost cult horror movie. As players explore the house, they reveal rooms filled with unique story moments that must be read aloud, creating a cinematic experience where anything can happen. Characters might lose limbs, lose their heads, get horribly mutated, or even die—but death isn’t always the end. Players who die may return as ghosts, haunting the other survivors and still competing to win the game.

Each player takes on a unique persona with their own style, abilities, and attitude toward surviving the madness. The real heart of Grind House is the storytelling: every room, encounter, and event unfolds through wild, pulpy horror narratives inspired by classic grindhouse films.

Season 3 brings the carnage back bigger than ever. The Core Game is being reprinted due to popular demand, while an entire wave of brand-new Expansion Packs—created by both the original designers and some of today’s most exciting horror authors—adds even more twisted stories, terrifying creatures, and outrageous moments to experience. Season 3 means more rooms, more narratives, more chaos, and more bloody Grind House fun for everyone at the table.

name: Rift Zone: Contact
creator: Boostedreality
description: Wage epic battles where the board comes alive. The future of tabletop gaming. Real minis, smart tech, endless strategy.

name: The Last Shelter: Whispers of the Mist
creator: LuckyLion
description: The Last Shelter: Whispers of the Mist is a Worker Placement board game where 1- 5 players compete to survive the monsters in the mist by building a shelter and providing resources.

name: SeaBound: Open Oceans Expansion
creator: WeightedDiceGames
description: A casual board game of sea exploration, nautical discovery, and pirate battle that requires wits and the luck of the dice to win.

name: Batman: Gotham City Chronicles - Season 4
creator: Monolith Board Games
description: Batman™: Gotham City Chronicles returns for a new season that takes you to new heights with the critically acclaimed Absolute Universe, along with reprints of the core box and previous expansions. Join more than 100,000 players in the fight for Gotham City!

name: The Cabinet: Inauguration Edition
creator: Epilogue Games
description: 📂 Early clearance granted: Follow now to unlock your free Classified Dossier — faction intelligence previously available only in redacted form. Then read on. The Cabinet is a hidden identity game of political intrigue for 5–12 players set inside the inner circle of a rising authoritarian regime. Most of the Cabinet is loyal. But a few Skeptics have seen behind the curtain, and they're secretly voting to stop the Executive's power grab before democracy falls. Manipulate. Deceive. Save Democracy.

name: Oasis: Tactical Salvage Reclamation
creator: Collins Epic Wargames
description: Oasis: Tactical Salvage Reclamation is a 6mm science fiction tactical wargame designed by Dale Eadeh, published by Collins Epic Wargames, and produced by Death Ray Designs and Tabletop Terrain, in which you lead armed surveying parties, raiders, and mercenaries in a battle to extract artifacts.

name: Age of Pericles
creator: Apeiron Games
description:
Age of Pericles is a Euro-style strategy board game set in the Golden Age of Athens, for 1-4 players.

You play as members of the Athenian elite, competing for influence while shaping the fate of the Greek world.
Expand the Delian League, steer politics and culture, confront Spartan and Persian pressure, and help build the Parthenon as a symbol of power and legacy.

Every decision shifts the balance of Hellas.
Only one leader will earn the most Glory and define Athens’ greatest age.

name: ENLIVEN, The Quest for Resurgence
creator: Klas_Tobby
description: Venture across the vast land of Hallbrack, and fight for those who can't. Master the Fightboard and Pointboard to overcome enemies, puzzles and trials!

name: Sunlit's Eulogy
creator: Dear Euthyphro Studio
description: Sunlit's Eulogy is a highly thematic, asymmetrical, strategy board game for 3-6 people. It takes place in the moments following the death of the First Prophet and the turmoil that erupts. You play as one of the key disciples, trying to sway the faith towards your sect, through clever strategizing and diplomacy, while ultimately trying to strengthen the faith for millennia to come... or to collapse it entirely.

name: Dead by Daylight: The Board Game - 10th Anniversary
creator: Level 99 Games
description:
death is not an escape.

This is your opportunity to bring Dead by Daylight™ to your tabletop! Delve into 1 vs Many Trials as a supernatural Killer or a scrappy Survivor in this critically acclaimed tabletop adaptation.

For the 10th anniversary of Dead by Daylight, discover an exclusive new storage solution that will hold your entire collection of Killers and Survivors, and includes new maps, characters, and play modes!

Whether you're a die-hard fan, or ready to descend into The Entity's realm for the first time, now is the moment to own Dead by Daylight: The Board Game.

name: Bloodmantle: Legions & Wolves
creator: Authority XR
description:
Choose your gods. Command your men. Bleed for victory. 
A hybrid strategy board game of brutal warfare, ancient gods, and economy, set in an ancient fantasy world.

name: Duck off
creator: Bramblewoodgames
description: Duck Off is a portable party game for 2–12 players — think bumper cars, but with ducks. Roll the dice, lay down your path, and move your duck across the pond. Hit another duck and they go flying. Get shoved out of the arena and you're out. Games run about 15 minutes, just long enough to plot your comeback. Last duck standing wins.

name: Croquetalipsis Board Game
creator: Croqueta Games
description: Croquetalipsis: Quick, chaotic, and tasty: meet your new favorite card game.

name: Todai-ji
creator: giochix
description: In 710, Emperor Shomu ordered the construction of the Todai-ji Temple in Nara. It was a colossal undertaking that would consume all the Empire's resources, triggering an unprecedented economic crisis. Will you be able to find the necessary resources and meet the deadline?

name: The Crucible
creator: Nocturna
description: A dark fantasy narrative campaign game with tactical combat and miniatures.

name: Avian Realms Card Game
creator: Stonechat Games
description: Rediscover the birds of a lost Earth. Created by a solo designer and a passion project, Avian Realms is a strategic card game inspired by real birds, true to life traits and in a post apocalyptic world.

name: Tiberpunk: Streets of Rome
creator: iDventure Puzzles
description: A strategy board game for 1–4 players, set in cyberpunk Rome. Plan your moves and take risks through missions and intense encounters.

name: Pleesheez
creator: Snovid
description: A trick-taking card game of plushie tossing at a sleepover party.

name: All Cats are Beautiful
creator: Yeast Games
description:
In a city ruled by surveillance and obedience, cats organize, resist, and awaken.
All Cats Are Beautiful is an asymmetrical board game inspired by 1984, where revolution is not a moment, but a process — and where rival factions compete to lead it.

name: Six Sided Summoner
creator: Ply Games
description: Embark on RPG-inspired adventures, confront creatures in a decision-based combat system, unveil the mystery of shadow attack.

name: CAPITOLIUM
creator: YevgenART
description:
Capitolium is a Bold brand-new, deterministic Strategy Game for True Thinkers that blends the best elements of chess, checkers, and backgammon — while adding its own unique twist.
Capitolium is a truly original game that captures the elegance and depth of classic board games that have stood the test of time — but feels fresh, creative, and unpredictable.
This isn’t just another exotic chess variant. Capitolium introduces new rules, new pieces, a new board, and a completely new level of excitement!
With each turn, the tension grows as your pieces can gain new abilities when certain conditions are met. The deeper you go, the more strategic and creative the game becomes.

name: Gry Bez Prądu | Czasopismo o planszówkach, bitewniakach i grach RPG
creator: GameTroll
description: Czy ktoś dziś czyta prasę papierową? Czy taka gazeta jest potrzebna? Jakie treści się w niej znajdą? Na te i wiele innych pytań będziemy Wam odpowiadać w trakcie przygotowania do kampanii, której efektem ma być trzecie w historii pismo o grach planszowych, jakie będzie wydawane w Polsce. Jeśli jesteście zainteresowani, zaobserwujcie projekt, zgarnijcie pewny bonus i twórzcie z nami GRY BEZ PRĄDU!

name: Claws
creator: DiceCream
description: What started as a harmless séance turns into a nightmare when six friends are struck by a dark curse. Shrunken to the size of rats, they find that the family cats are now giant, prowling predators. To break the enchantment and regain their stature, they must scavenge the house for ritual objects—all while staying one step ahead of the hungry felines!

name: Nemesis Legacy
creator: Awaken Realms
description: Nemesis: Legacy is the first-ever full campaign experience set in the Nemesis universe.

name: Scoundrels
creator: Awaken Realms
description: Set in the gritty fantasy world of Lands of Evershade. Scoundrels is a fully cooperative, stealth-driven dungeon crawler where you and your crew take on the roles of thieves.

name: Battle of Souls
creator: No limits
description:
⚔️ One Box. Up to 5 Decks. Pure Strategy.

Build multiple decks from a single box and battle your way to become the King of the Immortal Realm — no boosters, no pay-to-win.

name: STIN Playing Cards
creator: STIN_R
description:
STINCARDS
Built for Community.

This project was born from a simple vision:
I want to see these cards in people’s hands.
In motion. In practice sessions. In late-night jams. In videos.

I want to build a great community.

name: Erra - Resistance (2nd campaign)
creator: OakGames
description:
Welcome to the World of Erra! Again...

The Resistance is like a Phoenix, even though there are no Phoenixes in our Universe :)

name: PnP Bundle #1
creator: FlorianFiedler
description:
The Best of the Indie Scene, In One Bundle.

A few weeks ago, Chris Backe and I put out a call to the tabletop community: Show us your best Print & Play designs. The response blew us away. We received 64 incredible submissions from passionate indie designers around the world. We played, tested, and debated until we narrowed it down to the top finalists—and then we handed the microphone over to you. The community voted, the dust settled, and the winner emerged.

Now, we’ve bundled the winning game from the contest and two of our own games into one digital package.

By backing this project, you aren't just getting three games, you are directly supporting the indie designers who poured their hearts into these designs, and you are helping fund the prize pool for the winning creators.

Zero shipping costs. Zero wait times for manufacturing. Just pure, printable fun.

name: Banana Magnate
creator: Elusive Bananas
description: Build your plantation, outsmart or crush your rivals, and harvest more bananas than anyone else. Banana Magnate is a light yet strategic euro card game for 2-4 players, where smart decisions, competition over cards, and a touch of cheeky interaction lead to victory - always wrapped in a fun, humorous tone.

name: Carpet Racing
creator: Sun, rain in life
description: Flick miniature cars across a textured track—master speed, damage, and strategy to win the race. No board, no dice, just skill.

name: Council of Serpents
creator: Wulfhorn Games
description: Three noble Houses are vying for power, but you are not one of them… You are a member of the Council of Serpents, and manipulate their attributes to ensure the Triumph or Collapse of a specific House. As soon as a single attribute reaches Triumph or Collapse the game immediately ends, and the player with that objective wins the game!

name: Dungeons of Immortal Magic
creator: Captain Hoser Inc.
description:
A dark fantasy trading card game that introduces innovative mechanics to the world of card gaming while delivering deep, immersive lore and an evolving storyline.

More information coming soon. Follow now to be part of the next great modern dark fantasy card game.

name: Bobsl(ay)eight
creator: Madoki
description:
Become a fearless warrior hungry for glory and domination on the ice.
Race through deadly bobsleigh tracks deep in the frozen north, where danger waits around every corner and fair play does not exist. Speed alone won’t guarantee victory,  your opponents will do everything they can to stop you, including smashing, sabotaging, and forcing your sled off the track.

Packed with surprises, chaos, and high-speed action, every race is a brutal battle to survive and claim victory. Only the toughest racer will reach the finish line.

name: ASPIDA CIVIL PROTECTION BOARD GAME
creator: STEFANOS FOLINAS
description:
"ASPIDA" 
Civil Protection Strategy Board Game
PRINT AND PLAY BOARD GAME 

ASPIDA is a cooperative civil protection strategy board game for 2–6 players. Players take on the roles of public services and citizens, working together to maintain a city’s Resilience against consecutive crises.

Each round escalates through Emergencies, Hazards, and social Panic, forcing the team to make difficult decisions under time pressure and limited resources. Players are not simply solving problems, but coordinating, stabilizing critical locations, and managing the long-term consequences of their choices.

name: Legends of the South: The Awakening of the Spirits
creator: Ancestral Games Studio
description: A dark-fantasy deck-building game for 2–4 players, inspired by myths and ancestral stories from the austral lands.

name: This year nobody dies
creator: oh! shocking
description:
In "This year nobody dies" you play as teenagers in an urban fantasy world inspired by classics like E.T, Stranger things, Cobra Kai and Buffy, 
If you manage to survive for the whole school year you win, but will you be able to face all the strange dangers while making friends in clubs, money in your students Job and facing familly drama?
The game is based on a huge cooperative adventure book that you will have to read in rythm with your school calendar. It bring out a nervous narrative experience where every choices is capital... (campaign in 2026 affordable price : 35 Euro)

name: City of Chaos
creator: Ares Games
description: In CITY OF CHAOS, players explore the twisting, smog-filled streets of Byronitar, the "City of Chaos." The city and its inhabitants are in the grip of strange, entropic forces threatening to rip it apart; players must uncover the clues that will lead them to the sources of Chaos and restore order to the city. A cooperative adventure game for 1 to 5 players, designed to be played as a multi-session campaign.

name: Elysium Encounters
creator: Kryphajen
description: Elysium Encounters is a tactical skirmish game players vs players, built on a refined turn-based d20 card-use combat system.

name: Gond Dabar - The Age of War (sept 2026)
creator: Pirata Games
description:
The Age of War is a tactical battle game set in the world of Gond Dabar. 
Choose your faction, build your deck of creatures, and fight on modular hex battlefields where every turn is about movement, timing, and decisive strikes. 
Play quick skirmishes or larger battles, and create your own matchups again and again.

name: Abandon Orbiter
creator: Bockholm Games
description:
Astronauts aboard an orbiting space station face malfunctions in the life support system after being struck by a cloud of asteroids. With oxygen levels shrinking, cooperation is the only way to make the Orbiter operational again. 
As time progresses, additional systems begin to fail and abandoning the Orbiter becomes more tempting all the time. When should you give up and start preparing for your own evacuation? Who can you trust when everything starts to fall apart and escape opportunities are running out?
With fewer and fewer options left, survival becomes your primary goal. You’ll have to look after yourself and make hard decisions. Will you make it out before the whole station collapses?

name: SAFARI
creator: LudarisGames
description:
Welcome to SAFARI, the game that takes you into the heart of the African savannah for a race to capture the best photo!
Players of all ages set off on a photo safari, searching for the most intriguing and rare animals to photograph.

But beware: in the savannah, nothing ever goes as planned!
An animal suddenly stepping into the frame, a faster rival, or a more impressive shot can steal the spotlight in an instant.
Get ready for a photo safari that is fun, chaotic, and totally unpredictable, where only the best picture truly matters!
But beware: the animals are settling scores… and adventurers are never ready for what’s coming!
Get ready for a safari that’s as hilarious as it is unpredictable!

name: RIVALS - 2nd Edition & Expansion
creator: Unkind Games
description:
Rivals returns in a second edition, enhanced by the feedback of all our players.

Dive into the WildTech and face off in this fast-paced, strategic Battle Royale/Deck-building game for 2 to 6 players.

Play as one of 8 Ashaks, heroes with unique powers, and evolve your playstyle throughout the game, adapting your deck to every encounter. Survive, gain the upper hand… and be the last one standing or the first to reach 5 victory points.

Whether you are discovering Rivals for the first time or were part of the first edition, this campaign is for you.

New players will enjoy a refined and balanced game, polished by our community’s feedback.

Veterans can elevate their experience with CONTAGION. Featuring amplified asymmetry and deeper strategic possibilities from the very first turn.

name: Barbaric: Crown of the Frost
creator: Hexa House
description:
A new Energy Core is discovered.
A new journey begins in the frozen north.

name: Ransack! - The Nutty Card Game of Search and Steal
creator: Rival Spirit Games
description: Ransack! is a 2-4 player card game where players lead Critters through the dangers of an endless ice age in pursuit of everlasting warmth. Search through the tundra, discover helpful items, outsmart your opponent and guide your Critters to their nutty fate!

name: Titanbound: Beyond The Rift
creator: Ludus Magnus Studio
description: Out in the Wildlands, the Titans roam without caring for mortal races.

name: Pocket Picks – 7 Micro Games in Cartridge Cases
creator: Beaverlicious Games
description: Pocket Picks is a passionate indie crowdfunding project featuring 7 cleverly designed micro board and card games, each delivering a rich, strategic or adventurous experience in a portable, pocket-sized format.

name: Eqular: Allegiance
creator: LevesqueBrothersGamesLLC
description: A strategy board game of worker placement and colony building, rich in sci-fi lore.

name: Cysmic - Second Printing and New Expansions
creator: Star Reach Games
description: Cysmic is a dynamic tactical sci-fi board game for up to 6 players set on the crumbling surface of a distant planet. Assume the role of a faction leader destined to become a Colony Ship Commander. Use cunning tactics, and strategy to ultimately build your massive 7-piece colony ship. This campaign is a follow-up to the first campaign, earning nearly $400k in funding. New Expansions, New Language Editions, and a Second Printing have been demanded!

name: Quakey's Adventure AR Board Game
creator: QuakeyCollective
description: Quakey's Adventure Augmented Reality Board Game is fun for the whole family.  Race to the finish line  in a high-energy adventure where every roll navigates a landscape of mystical portals and treacherous traps.  Scale towering ladders to leap ahead of the pack, but stay alert for slippery snakes and setbacks that can send you tumbling back down the board.  Gain a tactical edge by unleashing secret abilities to freeze your rivals, swap positions, or force opponents backward just as they reach the finish line.  To claim ultimate victory, you must time your final move with surgical precision, making every match a heart-pounding journey of luck and strategy for up to six players!  The game board is also built with an immersive Augmented Reality bringing the art to life.  Enjoy this experience with your smart glasses or your mobile camera. Licensed by Made by Apes and Powered by Quakey XR.

name: STACKUP – startegy duel to stay on top
creator: Stackup
description: Stackup is a two player abstract strategy game played on a hexagonal grid board. One player uses white pieces and the other uses black. Players place and stack pieces to form a multi level structure, aiming to have the majority of their color visible on the highest level at the end of the game.

name: Wyrmhunt
creator: Woodpecker-Games
description:
Wyrmhunt is a cooperative card game for 1-4 players. Each player takes on the role of a member of the legendary Wyrmhunt Guild. Guiding their hero through perilous adventures. The gameplay is inspired by classic JRPGs of the 90s such as Lufia, Breath of Fire and Final Fantasy. 
In tactical, turn-based battles, players must work together to prepare fo decisive boss fights within roguelike standalone adventures.

name: The Elements
creator: Elementorum Studio
description: Simple 2–5 player card game, easy to learn, dynamic elemental interactions, accessible price, and future expansion potential.

name: Save your World -The Biotech Board Game
creator: Save your World
description: Save your World – Join the Mission Against Plastic Save your World is a game for 2 to 8 players (30–90 minutes) with an important mission: proceeds fund scientific research on Galang Shield Active, a natural, plastic-free material designed to replace synthetic materials. The game is engaging: players must work together to avoid losing together, but only the best player will win. This dynamic keeps the tension high until the end. Available in 7 languages, the project also offers investors the opportunity to support concrete scientific innovation. Play with honor. Support research. Save your world.

name: Flying Gang
creator: Illuminati Games
description:
Set off and increase your reputation to become the captain of the Flying Gang.

Are you able to face the dangers of pirate life?
Raid neutral ships, collect the loot and sell it in the harbors to get the gold to upgrade your ship.
Plunder towns and place your own governor there and turn the town into a pirate stronghold.
Search and find treasures to become richer and more famous.
Complete tasks to improve your reputation as a pirate.
Attack the other players and steal a treasure map.
Become the first challenger to defeat the captain of the Flying Gang in a sea battle and become captain of the Flying Gang yourself.

The strength of the captain is different in each game as this is controlled by political events.
So it may be that the captain ends up in battle with a small but well-equipped ship.
But it can also be that the captain visits you with a ship of the line but has no additional expansions.

name: ATHEOI - VAEMPIRE PERPETUAL SOVEREIGNS
creator: Uazzo Perpetual Games
description:
39 Thousand Years of Human History
             TO BE REWRITTEN

name: RACE TEAM TCG
creator: JRAVENTURES
description: Premier TCG de gestion!! Ils se jouent de 2 à 6 avec des mécaniques jamais vues dans un autre TCG et dans l'univers du Sport-Auto!!

name: Scarab Sands
creator: Stranger Games Studio
description:
Scarabs fight inside an ancient pyramid to help you gain a spot in the Afterlife. A fast-paced, dice-chucking, area-control, programming board game set in ancient Egypt.

In Scarab Sands, you play as a soul trapped inside the Great Pyramid, fighting for Final Judgement. Your heart will be weighed against the Feather of Ma'at, Goddess of Truth and Balance, and only the soul with the lightest heart will ascend to the Afterlife.
Scarabs will help you in your quest to shed the weight of your heart.

name: The Lobbyist
creator: Dot Lab Games
description:
Forget democracy. In the real game of power, governments change, but lobbyists remain. In The Lobbyist, you are one of them. Your mission is simple, ruthless, and utterly amoral: bend nations to your will. Use every means at your disposal: political influence, slush funds, spies, and complicit states. Bring the other players to their knees by proving your leadership and global strategy. Anything goes, as long as you win.

For 2 to 4 players. One single objective: total control. Do you have enough “power” for this game?

name: Flip Chess
creator: JarnoS
description: A clever strategy game inspired by chess, where flipping cards creates new paths to victory. Perfect for families, couples, and competitive players.

name: Coffee Tycoon
creator: Babak
description: The Coffee Tycoon is a 2 to 4 player competitive strategic game. Easy to learn and quick to setup and play.  It is about how to be a successful coffee tycoon.  With addition packs the game becomes 1 to 5 player.  More fun and more challenge.

name: The Smoky Valley
creator: Fentasy Games
description:
The Smoky Valley is a demanding expert Euro, designed for players who enjoy optimizing under pressure.
Space is scarce, development is constrained, and there are no free engines here: every decision sets you on a path… and gradually locks you into its limitations.
Enter Griffintown.
Learn to master The Smoky Valley, because not every entrepreneur will leave it wealthy and powerful.

name: Siege Perilous
creator: Play to Z
description: Knights adventure through the stories of Arthur's England in pursuit of glory and renown.

name: The Warcode
creator: RedMakers
description:
The Warcode is a head-to-head tactical skirmish game that drops two players into the heart of a far-future galaxy. You’ll command squads in intense tactical skirmishes defined by shifting terrain, hidden contracts, and ruthless strategy.

This is warfare accelerated. No bloated rulebooks. No endless prep. Just clean, layered tactics that reward precision and punish hesitation.

name: Glades Emperor
creator: Zilverspar Games
description:
In the year 1910 the swamps of southern Florida were a refuge for outlaws. In this game you play an outlaw and utilize a group of Hired Hands to establish your secret economy. 

There are many challenges along  the way including sharing this space with other outlaws. Your goal is to build your specific business to be the regions economic power while not losing too much favor with the locals.

name: Vault Zero
creator: Horse Thief Games
description: Build your machine!   Hack into Vault Zero!   Spill its secrets to incite rebellion!

name: Dark Ages: Wars Of The Fallen Races
creator: SimonaDark'o
description:
Dark Ages: Wars of the Fallen Races is a premium dark fantasy strategy board game for 2–4 players.
Lead one of four fallen races, build roads and villages, gather resources, and wage brutal wars for control of a dying world.
Featuring asymmetric factions, deep strategic choices, and high-end premium components, the game delivers an immersive experience where every decision shapes the fate of the realm.

name: Throne of Etherwyn
creator: Carlos Michán
description: Throne Of Etherwyn is a card-based board game set in the fantasy kingdom of Etherwyn.

name: ANYScape RPG - First Publication
creator: ANYScape RPG
description: Play any setting, any way you like with ANYScape! Robust, modular, portable, realistic, and tactical, ANYScape is a table-top role playing game that is adaptable to any setting.

name: There Will Be Oil
creator: Northern Peak Studio
description:
Los Angeles, 1905.
Your father is dead. He left you nothing. His oil empire was deliberately broken apart and sold, ensuring his sons would inherit only rivalry and resentment.
