Now you and your brothers must claw your way up from nothing — hunting for oil, tearing it from the earth, and crushing all who stand in your way — to forge a new empire in the shadow of a man who denied you one.

name: Mobilis in Mobili
creator: Gallinello
description: Mobilis in Mobili is a 1–4 player competitive highly thematic card-driven board game (45 minutes) where players embody conflicting aspects of Captain Nemo’s mind, manipulating memories, balance, and power to seize control of his fate.

name: Tales of London
creator: Don't Panic Games
description: A dark-fantasy strategic semi-cooperative game where four powerful factions fight to seal London before the Void devours it… or to claim the city for themselves.

name: Dust in the Wind
creator: PHALANX
description: Set in the 1870s American West, Dust in the Wind is a co-op adventure where drifters chase honor, fame, or gold while making moral choices that forge a legend, or lead to oblivion.

name: STORM FEATHERS - A Worker Placement & Dungeon Crawler Hybrid
creator: GodotGames
description: Ariames needs you! 2-4 players become Descendants of the Wind & level up their skills, recruit companions out of 5 different classes & enter dungeons together for loot, enemies & experience. Fight evil bosses once & for all. At the end, only 1 can become the most famous Cloud Dweller in this unique worker placement game! 🪶

name: Chronicles of Drunagor: Aftermath
creator: Creative Games Studio
description: Chronicles of Drunagor: Aftermath is a standalone cooperative dungeon crawler for 1–5 players. Built on an innovative action-cube system refined throughout a decade of development, it features engaging tactical combat, cinematic 3D encounters, and meaningful choices that will shape the fate of the world.

name: Marco Polo Deluxe Master Set
creator: Board&Dice
description: One of the best board games is coming back in an amazing deluxe edition. Board&Dice and Hans in Gluck are teaming up to craft a remarkable edition of the Voyages of Marco Polo series!

name: 7 Wonders - Deluxe Series
creator: ReposProduction
description: Experience 7 Wonders on a level never seen before, with upgraded premium components and a deluxe storage solution by Gamegenic.

name: Save Us All
creator: SKGD-Création
description: Save Us All will immerse you in the heart of a small South Korean town ravaged by a mysterious epidemic.

name: Fox Flip
creator: Ticket Booth Games
description: Fox Flip is a quick, easy-to-learn 2-4 player game of skill, luck, and timely flips. Play special fox cards to outfox your opponent and win the pile!

name: PACT
creator: Wulfhorn Games
description: A sudden death, a kingdom on the brink. You have a rare chance to make pacts with key groups and make the future of Branchbourne yours

name: FELICITY - Solve puzzles and build a city.
creator: Piotr Kurek
description: A smart game for young and old. Think smart and play wood.

name: Gemüsegarten
creator: Board Bear Games
description: Gemüsegarten is a humorous strategy board game where brave vegetable heroes collect seeds, outsmart rivals, and fight for harvest, glory, and honor.

name: Speciation : A Narrative First Cyber Savage TTRPG
creator: Speciation
description:
A Cyber Savage Anthropomorphic Tabletop RPG about Survival and Adaptability in a world full of Danger and the telling of Tales about the poor Souls who strive to endure it.

Speciation is designed around accessible mechanics and strong world building for beginning players and GM’s, but be a deep enough experience to keep Seasoned TRPG players engaged.

name: Runecall: Battle for Runes
creator: PlayMai Games
description:
Runecall: Battle for Runes.
A competitive board game where Invokers move across a shifting battlefield, harvesting elemental runes to fuel spells and disrupt their rivals. 

Every action shapes the board — and every gain leaves a trace.

name: Gùgōng: The Imperial Architects
creator: The Gugong Legacy
description: Drawing on the refined gift-exchange system of Gùgōng, you must master strategy, timing, and resource management to surpass competing architects in constructing the Forbidden City. Now reimagined in this standalone prequel.

name: Star Empires - 10 Year Anniversary Edition
creator: Archona Games
description: Colonize planets, expand your empire, and rule the galaxy in this 1-4 player space game!

name: AnARKey: Total AnARKey Edition
creator: Nerdcraft Games
description: AnARKey: Total AnARKey Edition brings chaos to the table with over 300 cards to build your army in this fast-paced tactical card battle system from NerdCraft Games! Inside the box, you’ll find everything you need—300+ beautifully illustrated cards from artists around the world. inside you get over 300 beautifully illustrated cards, battle dice, and an easy-to-learn rule sheet. Gather your forces, unleash mayhem, and lead your army to victory in true AnARKey style!

name: Caster's Cup – The Pocket-Sized Spellslinging Game
creator: Beaverlicious Games
description: Caster’s Cup is a 1-4 player pocket-sized spellslinging game where you play as a senior student taking part in the prestigious competition of your graduating year. Adapt and use your wits to be the last one standing. Playable solo as well!

name: Room 25 : 5th edition
creator: Matagot
description: Escape a deadly maze or die trying in this new edition of a classic board game!

name: Amass 2nd Edition
creator: Dark Frontier Games
description: Amass is a competitive, worker placement, hidden movement, resource gathering, base defending, card playing dice-fest.  This is the 2nd edition, with minor improvement, tweaks and extra cards.

name: EcoLogic North America
creator: EcoLogic
description:
EcoLogic North America is the sequel to the highly acclaimed EcoLogic Europe. 
This new game features new, simpler mechanics that allow for greater player interaction and greater strategic planning opportunities. 
Above all, EcoLogic North America features five new biomes (prairie, taiga, desert, western mountain forests, eastern temperate forests) and hundreds of American species cards, including iconic species like the redwood, sagebrush, Joshua-tree, rattlesnake, blue jay, coyote, bison, and grizzly bear.

name: Grassfed: A Farm to Tabletop Game
creator: Stone Blade Entertainment
description: Grassfed is a cozy deck-building game for 1–4 players, created by a regenerative farmer and the team behind the Ascension Deckbuilding Game. Improve your soil, care for your animals, grow nutrient-rich crops, and out-farm your competition—all while restoring the ecosystem that sustains you. Grow the best farm. Build the best deck. Feed the world.

name: Austerlitz, 1805 - Un Coup de Tonnerre
creator: Les 3 Zouaves
description:
Soldiers, the hour draws near.
As at Austerlitz, everything will hinge on a flash of decision, a precise maneuver, a moment seized. Our new game is forged in the spirit of the great Napoleonic campaigns.
Join the prelaunch… and secure the heights before the enemy.

name: Dark Order
creator: Czacha Games
description:
Win through skill and unleash your commanding instinct to fight and survive in a plague-ravaged kingdom.
The Dark Order is a confrontational, tactical, strategy card duel shaped by choices, not luck.

name: Into Light: Light Well
creator: Into Light Games
description: Into Light: Light Well is a premium, small-box solo card game experience combining elegant design, intentional thematics, and interaction between art and gameplay.  Its a high tension card game focused on hand management and combo building.  Victory will require a bit of Luck on top of Memory, Planning, and Skill.  It is the planned first, in the three game series of Into Light.

name: No Escape Until Dawn
creator: Knights Creations
description:
No Escape Until Dawn is an asymmetric hidden movement and deduction board game for 2-5 players, where children move in secret, avoiding ghosts who work together to find them.
Bluffing, strategy, and deduction are key to survival and escape.

name: Propuh II: The Bevanda of Judgement
creator: InterHuman games
description: Granny is back! Grandpa has arrived! The cards are ready! The bevanda is poured! Now for 2–3 players!

name: TerraForge
creator: Adventure Together Games
description: TerraForge is an Expandable Card Game (ECG) that combines the intensity of card battlers with the strategic depth of head-to-head tactical gameplay. Built on the SOURCE system, it offers dynamic, ever-changing battlefields that make every match a unique and thrilling experience. Players assume the role of Transcendents—beings who have evolved beyond reality to influence mortal factions in a battle for dominance. By constructing faction decks from 1-2 powerful factions, players strategically corrupt enemy lands and preserve their own to emerge victorious in the cycle of destruction and rebirth.

name: Dice Tower Defenders
creator: brothersshirley
description:
Dice Tower Defenders is a fast-paced, competitive, dexterity-based, table-top game where you defend your dice tower against enemy invasion. Your dice are your warrior hoards which you command to respond in kind, to unleash devastation on the towers of your enemies! Common wooden game blocks are used to construct towers, and polyhedral dice are flicked across the table to advance and attack. DTD combines equal parts skill and strategy letting you push your luck in an exciting, easy to learn but hard to master battle game! 

Pledge just $1 to receive an electronic copy of the instructions which you can print or use online to play with your own game pieces.

name: Microcosm
creator: Microcosm Games
description:
Metabolize. Mutate. Multiply.

In Microcosm, you step into the hidden world of microbial life. Players harness the power of microbes to symbiotically recycle chemicals within a shared ecosystem. Deploy unique microbe cards to recycle chemicals, pick up mutations, and carve out your ecological niche. Strategic growth doubles your resources exponentially—but exceed the biome’s carrying capacity and risk total collapse. A medium-complexity competitive-cooperative engine builder for ages 10+.

name: Return of the Living Dead's Zombie Punk Panic (Reboot)
creator: Evil Genius Games
description:
In Zombie Punk Panic, you and your punk rock friends are partying in the graveyard when zombies start to pour out of the ground. You and your friends have until daylight to get out of the graveyard alive. Enjoy this dynamic dice roller, boss battler game from Evil Genius Games. 

Outrun the Dead. Cause Mayhem. Survive.

name: The Roundtable
creator: TanelKapp
description: Take a role of a billionaire and control the future of the mankind.

name: CATStories
creator: Bear's Workshop
description:
Inspired by the bold spirit of 80s and 90s comics, CATStories is a fast-paced party card game about chaos, creativity, and cats. Players create stories full of twists, conflicts, and humor, shaping each round through their choices and fast interactions. Easy to pick up, quick to play, and built for groups who love negative interaction, laughter, and shared experiences - CATStories turns every game night into a living comic book. 
Language versions other than English and Polish if we reach the minimum of 200 backers!

name: Junk 'n Gems
creator: Passion Project GG
description: Climb into your uncle’s attic, trade junk for gems, and race to shed your last card!

name: Arena
creator: LudarisGames
description:
Fight for glory! ⚔️
Attack, defend, move — and conquer the Colosseum.
Meet Father Niel, the witch Della, Raphius, or Sopia to shape your destiny.
A thrilling tactical game for the whole family!

name: DAVOS
creator: Marty.Games
description: Welcome to the forum, and to this meeting in particular. It is an honor to sit here with those who represent the big capital in the world through your megalomaniacal investment firms. Tonight, we'll be playing out our activities for the coming years.

name: Race to Essen
creator: Arne Lorenz
description:
🚂 From a Shipping Nightmare to a Board Game – Welcome to The Race to Essen!

This game was born out of a true story.
When my own games didn’t make it to SPIEL in Essen on time, I found myself living through a mix of stress, hope, and absurd logistics – waiting for trains, customs clearance, gauge changes, and endless border delays.
Somewhere between Shanghai, Brest, and Duisburg, the idea struck me:
Why not turn this madness into a game?

That’s how The Race to Essen was created – directly inspired by the real events and challenges I faced while trying to bring my games to Europe.
Every unexpected delay, every desperate email, every small victory over bureaucracy made its way into the game.
And believe me – there were plenty of them!

In this semi-cooperative strategy game, you are publishers trying to deliver your games to the world’s biggest board game fair in time.
You all win together if every shipment arrives before the fair starts.
But if even one train fails to make it… you all lose together!

Plan your moves wisely, manage your time, and decide:
Will you help each other to succeed – or slow your rivals down to get ahead?

And beware: if you’re the only one whose train makes it to Essen while everyone else fails, you may be the biggest loser among winners! 😄

👉 Follow this project to stay updated about development progress, playtests, behind-the-scenes stories, and new artwork –
and join the most unpredictable logistics journey ever turned into a board game!

name: Escape from Site 19 - The SCP board game
creator: Escape from Site 19
description: Survive containment breaches, face anomalies, and immerse yourself in the SCP universe in this extreme board game!

name: Crystal Echoes
creator: Knights Creations
description:
Welcome to Crystalvale! 

The creatures that inhabit this world are in need of guidance: only you can help them by harnessing the power of the Crystals!

Crystal Echoes is a competitive card game for 2–10 players, set in an extraordinary, colorful world shaken by the arrival of a magical Comet. Your task is to restore the lost harmony by gathering the creatures that dwell within it.

The game unfolds over three Eras, during which you will build two Communities: one shared with the player on your left and the other with the player on your right. The more in tune the creatures are with each other, the more points they will grant you.

Only those who find the right balance will be declared the winner!

name: Żerca: Gra Karciana
creator: Slovian Games Studio
description: Gra karciana w uniwersum "Powiernika" pióra Franciszka M. Piątkowskiego

name: The Great Escape
creator: Sound of Drums GmbH
description: A cooperative game about the escape attempt from the infamous Stalag Luft III POW Camp during WWII. Based on a true story!

name: Operation Valkyrie
creator: Sound of Drums GmbH
description: Operation Valkyrie is a solitaire game that simulates the events immediately after the attempt to assassinate Hitler on the 20th of July 1944.

name: Battles of Napoleon Vol. III Aspern-Essling 1809
creator: Sound of Drums GmbH
description: Volume 3 of the highly successful series "Battles of Napoleon" designed by Uwe Walentin

name: NAVY: Academy
creator: Michał Meiser
description:
Fast paced game of World War II naval tactics for all admirals – big and small.
12 types of ships, aircrafts, and other elements in miniature figurines.
Scenario-based gameplay – historical scenarios and a plenty of creative options in sandbox mode.

name: Monsters & Merchants
creator: Floating Forge
description:
Slay Hard. Sell Smart.
Dive into monster-filled dungeons, snatch the best treasures, and outwit your rivals when it’s time to make a deal with the ever-greedy merchant.

name: Feed the Kraken: Sea of Shadows
creator: Funtails GmbH
description: Set sail on a new, even more dangerous journey across the Sea of Shadows with this highly anticipated Feed the Kraken expansion!

name: Skarbiec Liczb
creator: Lukasz Rzepinski
description:
Gra matematyczno-przygodowa
Grupa poszukiwaczy rywalizuje o skrzynie pełne złota - ale by je otworzyć, musisz zdobyć tajemnicze kody liczbowe!
Rzucaj kostkami, planuj dodawanie lub odejmowanie na torach jedności, dziesiątek, setek i tysięcy! Zbieraj cyfry to klucze do skrzyń pełnych złota!
Zwycięży ten, kto najszybciej zgromadzi najwięcej bogactw i sprytnie wykorzysta moc liczb!
Gra zaprojektowana do wspomagania nauki działań matematycznych.

Dla kogo: dzieci 6-10 lat, ale dzięki mechanice rywalizacji rodzice także się nie nudzą. 

Gra wyewoluowała z gier edukacyjnych, które przygotowywałem dla swoich dzieci. Zauważyłem że wiele gier matematycznych dodaje element zabawy trochę na siłę, bądź mechanika wspiera głównie naukę pamięciową. Pomyślałem że można użyć mechaniki dodawania i odejmowania pisemnego to pozyskiwania żetonów otwierających skrzynie ze złotem. 

Czas gry 20 min, 2-4 osoby

name: Tenka Fubu: Card-Driven Multiplayer War Game on Sengoku Japan
creator: studiodenkagames
description: Fight a card-driven strategy game as a daimyo through the mid-16 century Japan.

name: Battle of the Knollen
creator: Pektis Studio
description:
In the war-torn lands of Tuberia, mighty potato nations clash for supremacy.
Each army, led by heroic spud champions, marches toward the sacred Mount Solanum — where the divine guardian Tuberon, Keeper of the Potato of Power, watches over the fragile balance of the world.

To claim ultimate glory, you must outwit rival tribes, recruit and empower your potato heroes, and defeat terrifying monsters that guard the mountain’s path.
But beware — even the gods themselves may turn against you when the final battle begins.

Tuberia is an epic tactical card game combining trick-taking, deck-building, and monster battles.
Forge alliances, betray your foes, and rise as the one true ruler of the Potato Realms.

Will your roots endure — or rot beneath the shadow of the gods?

name: The Voyage - Search for Yamagi
creator: XOLLOX Games
description:
The Voyage is the second part/game of the Yamagi Saga, following "The FOG - Escape from Paradise".
Many Islanders did manage to escape The FOG with their boats, in the first part of the Saga. But will they also find the mythical homeland of their ancestors Yamagi? All they have are centuries-old legends handed down over time. A long and enduring adventure awaits them in "The Voyage - Search for Yamagi". Will you be able to lead your Islanders to their new future.

This is the Card & Travel Edition. The Board Game Edition is still in the designing process and will be also on Gamefound either in 2026 or 2027.

name: 5Pairs
creator: Ummaramma
description:
5Pairs – So simple… even your granny could totally destroy you!
A fast-paced card game for 2–4 players where you snatch pairs, grab cheeky bonuses, and outplay your friends (and family). Easy to learn, impossible to master – and don’t be fooled… grandma came to win.

name: Pandaii!
creator: Baroque Games
description: It's cooperative poker, with RED PANDAS!  "CUTE!"   And you can play any regular card game that uses a standard 52-card deck   "AWESOME!"

name: BRIDIX
creator: CBGame
description: Build, Bluff, Steal – outsmart your rivals in this clever and balanced card game of bridge-building for 2–4 players!

name: Maglia Nera - The art of losing
creator: Croqueta Games
description:
In post-war Italy, glory was not about winning… but about finishing last.
In Maglia Nera you play a trick-taking game where losing with style is the goal: play your cards, twist duels with tokens, and avoid elimination to become the last hero of the peloton.

name: Dice Quest: The Tower of the Elephant + The Dunwich Horror
creator: Juegorama
description: DiceQuest is a fast-paced system that blends cards and epic dice rolls. Face thrilling challenges and race against time before defeat claims you! Play solo or with a friend as you journey through the mythical Hyborian Age created by Robert E. Howard, or wander the eerie countryside of Dunwich born from the visionary mind of H. P. Lovecraft. A quick, tense, and endlessly replayable tabletop adventure awaits!

name: Assault Red Horizon 41 - Revised Edition
creator: Sound of Drums GmbH
description:
Assault – Red Horizon 41: Revised Edition marks the relaunch of the acclaimed tactical war game that immerses players in the dramatic early stages of Operation Barbarossa (June–October 1941).
A clash of titans – the German Wehrmacht and the Soviet Red Army locked in a desperate struggle with infantry, artillery, and armoured forces.

This new edition refines the system and significantly expands the experience, combining historical depth with playability, streamlined rules, and more enhanced components.

name: SHIVER ME TIMBERS (Reprint + Brand New Expansion)
creator: Michal_Vitkovsky
description: The award-winning pirate game is back! Set sail in Shiver Me Timbers, the highly thematic sandbox game that plunges 1-5 players straight into the Golden Age of Piracy. ⚔️ With its clever Euro-inspired mechanics and a tactical, card-driven combat system, every decision matters. Plan your actions wisely, outmaneuver your rivals, and rise to become the most notorious pirate of your time! 🏴‍☠️

name: Boss Hunters & Crimson Keep
creator: Synergic Games
description: Face a dragon... or become one

name: Shadows of Authority - A Hegemony Expansion
creator: Hegemonic Project Games
description: An expansion to the award-winning Hegemony, Shadows of Authority introduces the axis of Authoritarianism vs Liberty, along with environmental challenges, new policies, and strategic dilemmas.

name: ARDEVUR: The Game of Resources
creator: Hashtag 64
description: A simulation of the modern mining and metals supply chain! Build a mining empire in an asymmetric gameplay experience where four corporations compete to gain supremacy over the world's critical resources.

name: Fireteam Zero - The Reboot
creator: SBG Editions
description: Co-op squad tactics and horror set in the last days of WW2 - revisited with new explosive content.

name: Travail
creator: Artefact Games
description: Do battle with the Fallen Heavens and rid the world of their blight.

name: Quake The Board Game
creator: Archon Studio
description: Quake: The Board Game is a fast-paced cooperative dungeon crawler with an optional Deathmatch mode.  The game is quick to learn but packed with strategic depth. To stay in the fight, you’ll need to scavenge power-ups and keep fragging enemies. Stopping is not an option—you either push forward or fall behind and perish.

name: Artalis: Dice Roll. Your Call.
creator: ProjectBoardgames
description: Looks like a dice game. Plays like a strategy game. A competitive arena for 2–5 players where you bid with polyhedral dice to seize monsters, allies, and gear. Lose a roll? You gain Karma. And Karma hits back. Win to claim, lose to gain.

name: Cloud Jumpers - The Board Game
creator: Gabriel Faint
description: Lock and load! Assemble a team of convicts. Travel through deep space and eliminate monstrous threats to earn your freedom!

name: Agemonia Expansions: Witches of Durgane & The Breach
creator: Lautapelit.fi
description: The Agemonia story deepens with two new expansions.

name: Etherlume
creator: RPG Board Game
description: Du style "Bataille royale", ETHERLUME est un succès familial assuré (que vous soyez initié ou non au jeu de rôles RPG).

name: Cokoro blitz battle
creator: 3DLIGHTGAMES
description:
Cokoros are landing ! Their mission? To decide once and for all who will rule the universe:
the furious Orange ? Or the raging Green? Their battle for domination will set fire to… your living room table!
A family strategy game for 1 or 2 players, or two teams of 2 to 4 players.

name: À VOUS DE JOUEUR (héros)
creator: RPG Board Game
description:
Dive into an adventure like no other. With Your Turn to Play! you are not just a reader; you are the hero.

Each volume draws you into a dark and fantastical world where your choices change everything: perilous explorations, fateful decisions, unexpected encounters… At every page, your destiny shifts.

Battles come to life through an innovative card game that adds strategy, chance, and intensity to every confrontation. Your literary decisions extend onto the table, where each card can either save you… or seal your fate.

Throughout the collection, you will face strange creatures, unlikely allies, and formidable enemies in a world where imagination collides with danger.

With Your Turn to Play!, every adventure is unique… and endlessly replayable.

name: Trade & Turmoil
creator: AWA Board Games
description:
Trade & Turmoil is an objective based competitive game for 2 to 6 players. A fun and easy to learn ruleset combined with fairly 'crunchy' strategic elements allows for casual players to dive right in and the expert gamer to expand their control of the waves!

Victory points are won by completing various trade, shipwright and privateering missions. Players must carefully choose their path and balance a mix of honest trading, treasure hunting and outright piracy, all while dodging enemy ships, the navy, booby traps and the seas own wrath.

Resources must be cunningly managed in order to successfully complete tasks, purchase new ships and upgrade vessels to improve cargo space, speed and firepower.

name: Mamma Mia! Syndicate
creator: MrFranz
description: Mamma Mia! Syndicate is a mafia-pizzeria card game where you draft ingredients, play shady deals, and shout “Mamma mia!” to snatch tables before your rivals. Serve tasty pizzas, score the most points, and become the true boss of the pizza syndicate.

name: CyberSiege // Strategy and Skill for aspiring IT professionals
creator: Codepalm Games
description:
Master the basics of cyber security, improve your strategic thinking and enjoy a thought-provoking team card game for 2 to 8 players.
CyberSiege is made by an IT instructor for aspiring IT professionals, with gamification and accessibility in mind. 
Perfect for classrooms or vocational training with different gamemodes: Symetric or asymmetric, fast or excessive - You decide how you want to play. 
The focus is on cybersecurity, but you don't need to know or acquire any knowledge to play CyberSiege. So specialists can play CyberSiege together with non-specialists without any problems.

name: Winged hussars and Cossacks
creator: Konrad Chojnacki
description:
Welcome to the Dnieper River!
Whether your family originates from here or the king granted you lands in this territory, one thing is certain. The Wild Fields are full of challenges you are unprepared for. You will be forced to face Tatars, Muscovites, Cossack rebellions, and the greatest enemy of every magnate – his neighbor!

name: I DARE YOU!!! Tactical Football Boardgame
creator: The Final Whistle Games
description:
⚽ Take the manager’s seat and lead your team to victory in I DARE YOU!!!
This dynamic (soccer) football-themed board game blends luck and strategy through team management, transfers, and high-stakes matches.
Perfect for fans of dice, cards, and real competition – and a great way to inspire young football lovers!
🎯 Your team, your decisions, your victory – do you accept the challenge?

name: Palooka AI
creator: Juhu-Spiele
description: Assemble your robot from space junk faster than the other aliens.

name: Arkhtide TCG
creator: Brightlance Publishing
description: Join us in creating Arkhtide, a post‑apocalyptic dark fantasy skirmish TCG for 2–5 players, where you lead powerful Seekers through a world drowned in magic and ruin, fighting for the last fragments of hope and power. Built around deep lore, multi-use cards, and asymmetric faction identities, Arkhtide offers brutal 1v1 duels, and intense free‑for‑all clashes, all driven by a unique system that rewards clever play, bold risks, and creative deckbuilding.

name: Blood and Salt: Siege
creator: Blood and Salt Studios
description: Breach-and-clear in this tactical shooter card game of back-and-forth map destruction and firefights for 2 players. Designed for those who seek immense replay value, meaningful knowledge-to-action decisions, and have an appreciation for flavorful design.

name: Uwolnij-sie
creator: GM STUDIO
description:
Wychodzisz na spotkania, domówki, dwór ze znajomymi, ale jest nudno i nie ma co robić? 😐

Mam rozwiązanie. ✅

To gra, w której musisz wykonać wyzwanie… albo się od niego uwolnić 😈

Ale to nie jest takie proste.

Żeby się uwolnić, musisz zagrać minigierkę z wybranym graczem 🎮

Jeśli wygrasz – oddajesz zadanie i to on je robi 😬

Ale jak przegrasz… wolisz nie wiedzieć, co się dzieje dalej 😵

📦jeśli zrzucicie się ze znajomymi, cena za osobę wychodzi śmiesznie niska.

UWOLNIJ SIĘ – nie będzie już nudnych wieczorów 🔥

name: This Is Not a Drill!
creator: MiniBadWolf Games
description: A fast-paced card game of bluffing and mayhem in the world’s messiest workshop. Survive the chaos, make it through the shift - and whatever you do, don’t end up with the Drill.

name: Medalion: Fantasy Tactics
creator: Artur Płonka
description: A fast and tactical, 20-minute-long skirmish wargame with next to no busy work, and simple squad building.

name: Światło i Mrok (edycja polska)
creator: kopergames
description: Skompletuj drużynę, podpisz kontakt i wyrusz w podróż pełną niebezpieczeństw, losowych lokalizacji i przypadkowych spotkań. Stawiaj czoła napotkanym wyzwaniom, walcz z potworami, zdobywaj skarby, poluj na zwierzęta, płać za usługi i handluj. Zaryzykuj i eksploruj ruiny, kopalnie, jaskinie czy podziemia.

name: Artifox
creator: Octo Push
description: A Two-Player Highly Interactive Card Game, full of Tricks and Traps! Steal recognisable art and race to become the biggest crime lord in Artifox!

name: THE FRONT
creator: Endorphin games
description: The Front is a fast-paced, strategic World War II card game where players command iconic units across historic battlefields. Deploy troops, tanks, ships, and planes with unique effects, bluff your way through hidden plays, and outmaneuver your enemies to dominate the war front. Victory goes to the clever, not just the strong.

name: Blitzkrieg: Card Battle
creator: parisiinteractivegames
description:
Relive the most intense clashes of World War II in this 2-player card game!
In Blitzkrieg: Card Battle, each player commands an army with 30 unique cards, facing off in 10 battle events that will define the course of the war.

In each round, both players deploy 3 cards against 3 cards in a direct confrontation for control of the event. Strategy, understanding your opponent, and intelligent use of your units will be key to tipping the balance in your favor. Each event won awards points, and at the end of the 10, whoever has the most points will be the winner!

With fast-paced, intense, and replayable games, Blitzkrieg is perfect for fans of tactics, history, and duels of mind and courage.

name: Battle- of the Summoner
creator: PeZeeGame
description:
Battle of the Summoner is a fast-paced collectible card game (TCG) where you build your own deck, summon powerful monsters and heroes, and unleash devastating abilities to defeat your opponent.
Summon legendary heroes and mythical creatures and fight for the glory of your kingdom!

name: Questionable Characters – A Party Game for Role-Players
creator: Deck & Dice Games LLC
description: The social game to kick off your next TTRPG session. Break the ice, roast your party, and see who knows each other best.

name: pagepunk- the dynamic print and play platform
creator: Beaverlicious Games
description: pagepunk is an online platform for endlessly customisable and randomisable print-and-play games you can configure and print at home.

name: Kronika
creator: Nothing and Beyond
description: Kronika is a tactical card game for 1 vs 1, set in a mystical world where four rival Churches clash for the power of the Stones of Iari. You will lead your Chosen One, recruit troops, and harness the might of your faction to control the battlefield. Only the player who gathers the Stones and bends the flow of destiny will claim victory.

name: Powiernicy RPG
creator: Wydawnictwo Hengal
description: Witaj w świecie, gdzie słowiańscy bogowie, demony i ludzie dzielą losy trzech splątanych rzeczywistości – Jawii, Prawii i Nawii. „Powiernicy RPG” to gra fabularna z gatunku urban fantasy, która pełnymi garściami czerpie ze słowiańskiej mitologii i kultury! Przeniesiesz się na warszawskie ulice, podwawelskie lasy i zapomniane ruiny, gdzie pod miejskim brukiem drzemią pradawne moce. Wciel się w Powiernika, Żercę lub Przebudzonego i spróbuj okiełznać chaos rozdzierający słowiańskie światy. Wesprzyj kampanię i pomóż przywrócić dawną moc słowiańskim opowieściom!

name: Gothic - A Shadow's Quest
creator: THQ Nordic
description:
Immerse yourself in the epic world of one of the most influential RPGs of all time - Gothic. 

In this newly designed board game, slip into the role of a “Shadow”, an aspiring member of the Old Camp who wants to make a name for himself in the Colony. Risky tasks and deadly opponents await you in the dangerous Valley of Mines. Alone or cooperatively with up to three other players - and an optional Game Master – fight against aggressive scavengers, sneaky minecrawlers, cruel hordes of orcs, and other bloodthirsty creatures. Explore, complete quests, and develop your character; master swordplay, unleash magical powers, or wield a bow to defeat enemies from afar. The choice is yours!

name: Dark Age
creator: Soryu
description: Turn-based tactics game! Lead the lords who have fallen into the underworld to victory!

name: STREAM: The Game
creator: Red Duke Games, LLC
description: Welcome to the Pines Hotel, where you will join in on a chilling game of stealth, strategy, and survival. Here you become one of the players, stalking unsuspecting guests through the shadowy hallways of the Pines hotel ending their lives for the glory of points and of course the Money! In this high-stakes thriller game, you will be watched by the Stream.

name: The Revelation Abyss
creator: Wurmory Studio
description: In the dark-fantasy City of Trisk, command a customizable squad in a legacy-driven RPG for 1–4 players. Explore a vast world map, complete quests, and clash in brutal PvP skirmishes. Unravel a mythic war between angels and demons—where truth breaks old ideologies.

name: Machiavellian: The City of Masks
creator: Cotswold Games
description:
A dark steampunk game of masks, politics, and ruthless ambition.
In the twisted canals of an alternate 1800s Venice, players don elaborate masks, manipulate senators, and outwit rival factions in a relentless bid to become the all-powerful Doge of Venice. Machiavellian blends strategic card play, political scheming, and gorgeous art in a world where favor is currency, loyalty is fleeting, and the only crime… is irrelevance.

name: Dungeons & Lasers VIII: Duskhollow
creator: Archon Studio
description: Explore the darkness with Castle-themed terrain, miniatures, and props—perfect for your horror fantasy RPG campaigns.

name: ARCTICA
creator: ThisWay
description: Develop your ecosystems, allow your wildlife to colonize new territories, and advance Arctic biodiversity on this card driven and engine building game!

name: Galileo's Truth
creator: Thundergryph Games
description:
Galileo’s Truth is a competitive euro game from 1 to 4 players by Virginio Gigli and Flaminia Brasini.
As scholars in the dawn of modern science, observe the sky, write persuasive treatises, and build inventions to reshape the future.
The game features worker placement, deck building, and resource management.
Pursuing knowledge may cost your freedom, even your life, but the stars remain silent without it.

name: Pivotal Roll - Rogue Lords
creator: Mapapa
description:
A SOLO tactical board game where one die controls your entire squad.
Pivot the die, change your commands, outthink every fight.

name: Era of Pioneers
creator: Steinbock-Brettspiele
description:
Gather your companions – Forge your destiny!
As the leader of an expedition, you must select a group of brave pioneers, whose skills will determine your success or failure. Your choices shape your strategy and make every game unique. Your rivals will form their own teams – who will triumph? Are you ready to play worker placement on a new level?

name: Echo of Omens
creator: Ghost Galaxy
description: Assume the role of either a fell Overlord seeking dominion, or a resolute Hero questing to foil the Overlord's schemes. Echo of Omens is a revolutionary asymmetrical trading card game for two players.

name: The Celtic Cauldron
creator: Knotted Mechanic Games
description:
Thank you for your interest in this project stemming from my passion for table-top games, Celtic folk lore, and the look on my friends’ faces when I manage to pull off a game changing bluff!
Scroll down to discover how a Celtic myth comes to life as a 2 player, asymmetric card game.

name: Amadonnia
creator: Vespucci Designer Gaming
description: AMADONNIA is a thrilling trading card game set in a rich, fantasy world where powerful empires, mystical creatures, and ancient gods clash for dominance. Players use pre-built decks or create their own to engage in epic battles, using unique abilities and tactics to outwit their opponents. With deep lore, stunning artwork, and immersive gameplay, AMADONNIA offers a one-of-a-kind experience for collectors and strategists alike. Join the war, shape your destiny, and immerse yourself in the world of AMADONNIA.

name: Ruse Second Printing (and expansions)
creator: Guime
description:
The FOX strategy board game is back!
With its unique mix of worker placement, territory exploration, resource management, and innovative dice mechanics, Ruse returns, now with brand-new expansions that take the adventure to new heights!🏔️

name: Overtake - Street Racing Board Game
creator: Asura Games
description: Stay tuned

name: Hegemon: The Struggle
creator: Ghost Chicken
description: Achieve the title of the dark lord in Hegemon: The Struggle - become the avatar of evil! Enter a cursed world to take control of the power-giving Seals of one of three hellish Factions: Plague, Lament, or Inferno. Fight with other players to seize territory in demonic domains - plot, deceive, form and break alliances. Raise an army of corrupted beings: soldiers, lords, and even gods. Tame the Hell!

name: Living Lantartia
creator: MeepleWorks
description:
Engage with the simplest rules, optimized for the unique customization, powered by the Dungeons Soul system! A true toolbox to enhance your play, plus the rich, ready to use, omniverse of Living Lantartia!
(5e and OSR systems compatible).

Make Fantasy for Real!

name: Netherworld Candle: Echoes of the Forgotten Tomb
creator: INFINITY HEX GAMES LIMITED
description:
Five years to build this trap.
No rubber masks, no illusions, just visceral, lethal Chinese folk horror. Dice won't save you here. You live or die by the Fate Deck and a Karma system that turns your own greed into physical damage.
I butchered the profit margins to offer this massive box for dirt cheap.
Willingly buy your own doom.

name: Sunrize: Mechanite
creator: BADFRIEND Games
description:
Assemble and Customize your squad of RIZERs to battle over resources in a far-flung, hyper-capitalist future.

SUNRIZE : MECHANITE Delivers dynamic, action-packed games in as little as 45 minutes with straight forward, easy to learn rules. SUNRIZE : MECHANITE provides a lean, intuitive rule set.

name: Actualize This
creator: Devotion Games
description: Welcome, spiritual seeker! We wish you luck on your search for Enlightenment. Be wary, for this incarnation is full of false gurus, predators and parasites. Navigate your way to Self-Actualization, choosing your practices, relationships and guides wisely.

name: Ante Heroes
creator: Forteller
description:
Ante Heroes is a head-to-head battle of wits, abilities, and Texas Hold'em. Pick your hero, stack your chips, and claim your victories.

Don't Like Poker? Great! Ante Heroes feels more like a trading card game. Love Poker? Even better! Ante Heroes brings poker to the board game community by adding skill trees, punching your friends and more!

name: Handymen | Fachowcy
creator: AutoMates
description: "Handymen" is a humorous, high-interaction strategy game where players take on the roles of specialists in the renovation and construction industry. During the game, players participate in tenders, execute projects, postpone deadlines, save their reputation and make life harder for the competition.

name: Rune Blade Player's Handbook English Version Second Edition
creator: blackforestpress
description: "Rune Blade" is an action-packed dark fantasy pen & paper role-playing game set in the world of Lorec, where players compete as members of the Rune Blade Order against the rule of the Dark Elves.

name: The Final Curse of Dracula
creator: Sumerian Games
description: A party game of hidden roles where you have to find out who Dracula is and kill him before he turns everyone else into Vampires.

name: KING CITY Love Zombies
creator: MileStone Studio
description: King City is a survival-style graphic adventure where every choice can mean the difference between life and death. Dive into a gripping story full of twists, dangers, and nonstop action. The real innovation? The story unfolds on the screen, playable in all languages, while your progress is tracked on a physical game board, creating a unique blend of digital and real-world experience.

name: Boardquest: Blight of Undead
creator: Ramezware
description: Boardquest is back with its first expansion – Blight of Undead – and a reprint of the original Tales of Liria.

name: Skalvenia
creator: Smart Flamingo
description: Conquer a new land, the island of Skalvenia. Manage the capital on the mainland and the settlement on the island with the help of a growing fleet and the favor of the worship-hungry gods. Every order you give has meaning and affects your development and that of other players.

name: Fungeon Crawl
creator: Do or Dice Games
description: Welcome to Fungeon Crawl! A chaotic card game where your party isn't exactly your ally. Each adventurer is looking to exit the dungeon as the richest one. You've got to lie, cheat, steal, and punch your way out - or you'll be left with nothing. Friendships will be broken in this rage-inducing game of chance and sabotage.

name: Legacy : Heroes of Asco'lah
creator: LegacyHoA
description: Legacy: Heroes of Asco'Lah is a cooperative adventure board game for 1 to 5 players, set in a richly detailed fantasy world. Build unique heroes, face challenging quests, and uncover the secrets of Asco'Lah together.

name: Vikingr
creator: Triskelion Games
description:
You are Vikingr – Fear is for the enemy! 
In a land of Fire & Ice you are driven to conquest, all for the glory of a place in the halls of Valhalla. Grow in influence, prove your worth, & forge a Kingdom of your own! Cast the runes to unlock mystic powers, helping you to shape your destiny on the seas of fate. 
Die well, live better, in Vikingr – a co-operative and competitive game for 1 to 6 players.

name: Blades of the North – A Tactical Viking Card Battler
creator: Frosthorn Games
description: Blades of the North is a tactical card battler set in a merciless world of ice, steel, and legends. Choose your hero and forge your destiny through battle. Acquire weapons, summon servants, cast powerful spells – and face your enemies with courage, cunning, and resolve. In this brutal arena, only one thing matters: survival

name: Mayflower Pilgrims
creator: Spooky Tower Games
description: An ingenious solo or co-operative card-laying game that brings the story of the Mayflower Pilgrims, Plymouth Colony and the first ever Thanksgiving to life.

name: Steam'o'cracy: Beasts of the New Era
creator: Boilerbeast Games
description: Long after the last human vanished, the world didn’t die — it evolved. From rusted factories, broken data cores and flooded archives, something stirred: instinct sharpened by intelligence, muscle clad in brass. In Ferrofauna, animals rose not as survivors, but as successors. Nations of beavers, wolves, foxes, mice and more forged new ideologies, driven by ancient machines and visions of dominion. Steam’o’cracy: Beasts of the New Era is a strategic, modular, asymmetric board game for 2-6 players set in a post-human, steampunk world ruled by evolved animal factions.

name: CivilAxis lite
creator: GSD games
description: Civil Axis is a grand strategy, turn based empire builder. Take control of your regional power, and lead them in a quest for Cultural Dominance. Through economic, scientific, military, and industrial power, build your empire. Culture points is what your after. Go ahead, the table is yours for the taking.

name: PETS'MAZE : Animals' Race for Junk-Food in the Labyrinth, But beware the Predator !!
creator: Claude LEST
description: Animals' Race for Junk-Food in the Labyrinth, but beware the Predator !!

name: Arcane Artefacts: Plastic Wargaming Bits
creator: Pete The Wargamer
description: Arcane Artefacts; 28mm heroic scale hard plastic conversion parts for wargaming miniatures.

name: Digitronic
creator: TanelKapp
description: Exciting adventure in virtual world

name: Sons of Blya*
creator: Evil Creations
description: Post apocalyptic Slasher-themed board game in which you are a killer or a Blya*

name: Roostercards
creator: RoosterCards
description:
What is Rooster Cards?

"Rooster Cards is a fast-paced, hilarious, and chaotic family card game for 2–4 players where eggs are laid, feathers fly, and only one can rule the roost.  "

Perfect for families, parties, or anyone with a healthy sense of the ridiculous.

"Roostercards is a very silly game"

name: Fungi Contest
creator: Wurmory Studio
description: A competitive dice game for 2–4 players, packed with humor, pop culture references, and tactical twists. Control your rolls, outsmart rivals, and fight for the crown of Fungiland!

name: TYRANT
creator: Steamforged Games
description:

name: Nanolith - Ultimate Edition: 2nd print + Expansion "Rise of the Resistance" + X
creator: Woodpecker-Games
description: Cyberpunk-RPG-Boardgame with 50 hours of epic campaign told in fully colored graphic novels. Reprint & New Expansion.

name: Catch / Wrestling
creator: RPG Board Game
description: Dive into the electrifying world of wrestling with our board game "Catch"! Whether you're a fan or a newcomer, excitement is guaranteed.

name: Ballgown Battleground
creator: Relik Games
description: Recruit princesses to slay dragons atop the towers to earn the most Valiant Points. Bid against your opponents to take the advantage. Battle other princesses to score points and stop their progress in the towers. Enchant your princesses with powerful spells that will set them apart from the others.

name: Trihand by CardCore Games
creator: Trihand by CardCore Games
description:
Trihand is a fast-paced, strategic card game for 2 to 4 players where Rock-Paper-Scissors meets clever combos and a few surprising twist cards. Easy to learn, hard to master.

A Trihand egy gyors ütemű, stratégiai kártyajáték 2–4 játékos számára, ahol a kő-papír-olló szabályai találkoznak az okos kombókkal és néhány meglepő csavarkártyával. Könnyű megtanulni, nehéz uralni.

name: Dale of Merchants: 10-year Anniversary
creator: Snowdale Design
description: Dale of Merchants is back and better than ever! This competitive deck-building game brings great gameplay variety with new and revised decks. 1 to 4 players with a new separate solo mode.

name: This Is My Forest!
creator: Misterna-Games
description:
This Is My Forest!’ - Are you ready to become the ruler of the forest? 

What if you were the one creating your own movement paths in the board game? In our new game, you decide for yourself how to move around the board, fight and gain an advantage over your opponent!

Every game is a new challenge!
Every turn is a new brainstorm!

A strategy and logic game in which you think spatially!

name: Orbs vs Drones
creator: Last Stand Games
description:
Risk for the post-disclosure era! 

An exploration of what is happening in our skies. Can the Drones maintain the status quo, or will the Orbs drag us into a new age?

name: Jurassic Crisis
creator: Sperling Spiele
description: Jurassic Crisis™ is a PvPvE survival game for 1-4 players with cooperative and competitive elements, drawing inspiration from the video game ARK: Survival Evolved. Fans of the video game will love this board game!

name: Swords and Stones
creator: Sword and stone studios
description: Swords and Stones is the ultimate fantasy 4X kingdom building strategy game, made on the tabletop, made for you! Just watch the video already! More at swordandstonestudios.com

name: Occultis
creator: DOGTAIL Studio
description:
Newly risen is your FIEND, fresh and hungry to do your bidding.
What path will you seek now?

name: Acor
creator: La Hoguerita Estudio
description: Acor is a tile placement and test solving game, where your ability to place the tiles correctly will be as important as your luck with the dice to win the biggest amount of gems and rise to victory.

name: FOUNDATION - Isaac Asimov
creator: Creardo
description: In a distant future, the Galactic Empire is in decline, and civilization is on the brink of chaos. Players take on the role of strategic leaders striving to preserve knowledge and build a new order. A competitive game of resource management, influence, and deck building, where every decision shapes the fate of the galaxy. Long-term planning and adaptability are essential to face unpredictable events, strengthen your deck, and counter internal and external threats.

name: Space Junkers
creator: Next Dimension Games
description: Raid a Derelict Starship in this Board Game Adventure!  2-6 players race for salvage across a 3-tier game board, featuring dice-driven action-selection gameplay, asymmetrical player abilities, secret missions and an awesome 3D board. Follow now for early-bird pricing access when we launch!

name: Fantasy Crystals
creator: ARTSUN.games
description:
Have you always wanted glory, wealth and victories? Here is your time!
Fantasy Crystals is coming, and with it comes an array of heroes you can lead to triumph in epic clashes! 
Seize the opportunity to travel to a fantastic land full of riches and irrepressible rivals. Don't hesitate. Stand up to fight! The winner takes all!

name: Outpost Kilo
creator: Lost Viking Studios
description: You and your team have been defending the outpost for months, but suddenly, communications with HQ are lost and the power to the main gate fails, allowing hordes of zombies to breach your defenses. During the night, players take turns rolling dice to try to damage the zombies and prevent them from overrunning the base. During the day, they can scavenge for resources, better weapons, and items to upgrade and repair the outpost’s defenses. With a routine resupply scheduled in five days, you and the other survivors must hold back the zombies long enough to survive until help arrives. Will you be able to survive the relentless undead?

name: Oquur: The Story of Mons
creator: FirstPerson
description: In Oquur: The Story of Mons you play a cooperative deck-building game in which death of a character may be a favourable result. Keep an eye out for enemies that may invade your deck, as they are not that easy to get rid of. Defeat the boss to win and do not let it defeat you.

name: Puzzle Hub
creator: Gamefound Puzzle
description: Don't miss out on any Gamefound Puzzles that will happen in the future - follow this page and get notified each time there is a mystery to solve!

name: Board Game Battle of the Seas
creator: Chris Malcharek
description:
A Nautical War Board Game, set in 17 Century romantic piracy era.
Enjoy the thrill of taking 10 ships on a mission to get your transport vessel into the enemy port. there are no historical connections to this, only the excitement of waging battle on the high seas with strategy and a little luck spinning the wheel.

name: Gauntlets of Glory
creator: Knight Watch Games
description: Gauntlets of Glory is a Fantasy Battle Royale skirmish game with strategic, tactical, and role-playing dynamics.

name: Agricola: Dead Harvest
creator: Awaken Realms
description: Standalone take on Agricola, where farming meets survival in a post-apocalyptic world.

name: Croterra
creator: Shore Strategies
description: Croterra is a 1-6 player competitive strategy board game set in a dark medieval realm. The War to End All Wars is ignited as powerful Arcane artifacts are introduced to this Dark Age battlefield...

name: The Horror Possession
creator: BFS Production
description: A cooperative horror board game where players must face a terrifying demonic possession and work together to save a young girl before the darkness takes over.

name: Wardens - 5v5 Team-Fighting Tactics
creator: Level 99 Games
description: Welcome to Wardens, a fast-paced team brawl featuring deep tactics and surprising strategies. Build a team of Wardens—large figures with their own unique abilities, maneuvers, and attacks—to participate in thrilling tabletop duels of skill and cunning. Wardens is quick, flexible, and iconic, with an emphasis on big plays and surprise reversals. It's not your average war game!

name: Red Alert new World order
creator: Wolf Storm Entertainment
description:
A world reborn, a war renewed.
The old alliances have fractured, and a new conflict has begun. In this deep-strategy board game, players take command of rising factions in an alternate history where the balance of power is up for grabs. Through military conquest, political maneuvering, and technological advancements, only the most cunning leader will survive the chaos and forge a new world order.

name: The Legacy of Cthulhu - The Board Game
creator: Mind's Vision
description: The Great Old Ones destroyed civilization, and now the few remaining survivors must find shelter and resources to fight back! The cult RPG now returns as an action-driven board game with an exciting cast of characters and many of its mechanics adapted for quicker play.

name: Dice For Ever
creator: RodriGameZ
description:
La mort est notre destin à tous, après une ou plusieurs longue(s) vie(s) de misère et de problèmes, enfin vient, la mort. Ni paradis ni enfer, juste la mort. L’au delà égale pour tous. Pour certains c’est une surprise, (bon, ça c’est la première fois...) pour d’autres, c’est à nouveau un soulagement. 

 1 fois par éternité, l’afflux d’âmes est trop important, et on procède à une purge : Quelques milliards d’âmes sont renvoyées sur le plancher des vaches... Et parfois même DANS une vache... A la fin, d’entre vous il n’en restera plus qu’un bel et bien mort, qui pourra profiter d’une nouvelle éternité sereinement.

Dans DIcE FOR EVER, luttez pour rester mort.
Lancez vos dés de destin, jouez des pouvoirs fourbes pour renvoyer à la vie vos adversaires et être le dernier à poursuivre la digestion des pissenlits par la racine !

name: Hydro Soakers
creator: Upsize_Fun
description: Totally rad water blaster skirmish game for 2 players. Strategize your movement, upgrade your hydropack, and refill your water guns in this fast paced action hydration!

name: Sub-Zero
creator: Dawn Town Games
description: You are a faction of Arctic animals taking over territories and stockpiling food to survive the winter. Fight the cold, avoid humans, and escape the polar bears!

name: PlotWeaver: Cards of Creation
creator: Mod Hob Games
description: PlotWeaver is a modular storytelling card game that lets you craft unique narratives using imaginative prompts and familiar plot patterns. It's a joyful creative game for casual gamers, writers, DMs, creators, teachers, students, advertisers, families... and YOU

name: Zeme Homecoming
creator: Cinecore Gaming
description: Zeme Homecoming is a refined way to wargame. Think wargaming but with chess type strategy. You command a scout team of 10 wonderfully crafted miniatures, painted or left mono colored. Win by eliminating opposing forces and playing to the objective.

name: 4x Warlord: Thaumaturge
creator: Monkey B.
description:
4x Warlord: Thaumaturge – A Dark Fantasy Chess Variant of War and Magic
Welcome to 4x Warlord: Thaumaturge, a brutal and savage reimagining of chess where strategy meets the dark world of arcane power. This 4-player chess variant plunges you into a realm of bloodthirsty warlords, ancient magic, and chaotic battles. The game is steeped in a grim fantasy setting, where every choice could lead to domination—or destruction.

In 4x Warlord: Thaumaturge, each player commands a unique warlord, drawn from variable classes, with no two warlords alike. These warlords aren't just military commanders—they are masters of ancient spells, drawing their powers from customizable spell books. As you fight for control, you’ll build and defend Variable Fortresses while leading your armies with Variable Knight Captains, each bringing their own tactical edge.

The game offers two paths to victory: crush your enemies with raw military power, or harness the secrets of the arcane to outwit your foes. The Variable Turn Order keeps the game unpredictable, forcing players to adapt their strategies in real time. The grim nature of the setting, from the warlords to the battlefields, adds layers of dark, thematic depth that make every game feel intense and ruthless.

name: Starcide: Promethean Crusade
creator: Archon Studio
description: In this strategic game, players assemble their fleet by selecting units and commanders, deploying them wisely based on their strategy. Tactical deployment, fleet composition, and command dials system add layers of depth as players balance speed, firepower, and timing to secure victory.

name: Star Heroes - Eternium (4X TCG)
creator: The Space Collective
description:
From the team that has launched five payloads to the International Space Station comes a trading card game unlike any other—featuring cards embedded with genuine spaceflight materials. 

Star Heroes is a sci-fi trading card game filled with galactic conquest and exploration, blending the epic scale of 4X board games with the strategic card play of a TCG. Set 500 years into a post-apocalyptic future, every card showcases cinematic 3D sci-fi artwork made exclusively by human artists and designed to immerse players in dark, distant galaxies.

name: Unikerium, save the weird unicorns: card game
creator: Unikerium project
description: Prepare yourself to save an entire species from extinction in this funny collectable card game.

name: Prime Flux
creator: Falling_Rock_Studios
description: Prime Flux is a custom deck that allows for several different modes of gameplay, for 2-6 players.

name: Night of the Dead
creator: Carte Noire
description: During a game of Carte Noire: The Night of the Dead, your goal will be to survive an entire night in Erika’s village. You must devise strategies to see the dawn after an unrelenting onslaught of numerous creatures. All your resources must be shared and utilized to survive the night. Be ready to face these deadly enemies who will stop at nothing to destroy you before daylight fully breaks...

name: XIL the boardgame
creator: MB
description: In XIL, you take command of a mighty army on the battlefield. Command the disciplined forces of order or unleash the brutal swarms of chaos. On a square-based battlefield, two or more players engage in an epic struggle, competing for control of the essential resource: Xil.

name: Junk Yard Dog
creator: GGProdX LLC
description: You are an aspiring mechanic, and you want to start your own mechanics shop, or open your own garage. The problem is you don't have enough money for the parts you need for your bench stock. You also found out that there are others going through the same thing as you, and you know that whoever gets their shop opened first will be successful and the others will likely fail. There is an automotive junk yard nearby and it has all the parts you need. One problem, it is guarded by several junk yard dogs. You and your competitors have to sneak in at night and try to steal a part each day until you have at least one of every part in your garage. The first mechanic to fill up their shop will win. But be warned, if the Junk Yard Dog catches you, you won't be opening your eyes, much less your garage.

name: Assault on Doomrock: Party Hard Expansion
creator: BD Games
description: An Expansion to a Fantasy Roguelike Boss Battler of Dooom.

name: Towers of Yoma - A Mazing Tower Defense Game
creator: HYBR Games
description:
The factions of Yoma unite to save their magical valley from the machine invasion.
Towers of Yoma is a cooperative tower defense game, inspired by its video game heritage.
Together, one to four players build a maze, upgrade towers and create amazing decks. Explore powerful synergies and save Yoma.

name: Night Parade: A Yokai Cleansing Word Game | Relaunch
creator: IndianWolf Studios LLC
description: A word-building game about clever word choice, dice management, and set collection. It’s Obon at the Onsen! You are a new-hire for a yokai bathhouse. Your assignment: to cleanse yokai. Greet your guests, manage your tub, build clever words, and become Employee of the Year!

name: Where am I? Alice in a Mad Tea Party... Expanded!
creator: Japanime Games
description: Uncover hidden identities in Where Am I? Alice in a Mad Tea Party, a whimsical social deduction game featuring a stunning porcelain tea set and unforgettable characters!

name: Timeline: The Board Game
creator: Wagging Tales
description: Roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark fantasy world inspired by early medieval slavic lands with exciting exploration and very tactical combat system.

name: Hunter vs Prey
creator: Wolf Storm Entertainment
description:
A cinematic survival-horror board game of deadly exploration, hidden loot, and relentless alien threats.
Play solo, co-op, or competitive inside a shifting alien temple.

name: What The Ghost?! - Paranormal Investigations
creator: WTG
description: Gather evidence, discover cursed objects, identify the ghost, and perform exorcisms in a strategic, paranormal tabletop game.

name: Shoot-out in the Bardo
creator: Monkey B.
description: Welcome to "Shootout in the Bardo," an enthralling wargame where players compete for supremacy of the mind of creation. Prepare to witness the emergence of existence from nothingness. Engage in an epic shootout as gods clash, while simultaneously commanding ancient houses led by immortal god-kings in their quest for dominance over Gaia. Brace yourself for the extended strategic depth, as turns within Gaia unfold across ages, adding a unique dimension to the gameplay.

name: The Lord of the Ice Garden - Anniversary Edition
creator: REDIMP GAMES
description:
WELCOME TO MIDGAARD -- the battlefield of those from Earth consumed by the alluring pull of magic and power.
Players will use their influence and units to battle and dominate the regions of Midgaard. They do this with the intent to collect resources, score points and complete their own asymmetric win conditions. However, because of limited magic, full-frontal conflict will not always be your best option. Withdrawals at key moments, resource management, strategic deception, and tactical timing are all important elements of the game.

name: The Chronicles of BERG
creator: Rybysel Games
description: The Chronicles of Berg are yet unwritten and it is up to you to capture the mystical mountain's many tales. In a game for 2-5 players with elements of deck building and worker placement, you make history. There are tales of gems as big as houses, grand feasts, feisty beasts, the fearsome Krampus and many more. Will your story become history?

name: Veni Vidi Vici
creator: LaRondaFinal
description:
"Veni Vidi Vici" will be a game for two players in which players must create their decks with 40 cards to destroy the opponent's wonder.
In Veni Vidi Vici, decks are created using 3 distinct resources (6 coming soon): Apple, Grape, and Lettuce. Each resource will provide units with different mechanics and unique abilities that will be detailed later.
The main game will consist of 120 different cards with which you can create very diverse synergies. You can combine the 3 resources in a single deck, but keep in mind that the maximum number of resources per deck is 12.
Additionally, there will be cards for Buildings, Military Tactics, Elite Units, and Leaders, each with its own mechanics and theme.

name: Panopticon
creator: Pick 'N' Roll Games Lab Srl
description:
A frantic quest for freedom regardless of all risks.

A cooperative and immersive adventure in which you must coordinate as best you can by taking advantage of every glimpse from the lines of sight and overhearing every bit of information. 

The perception of control will be defeated: run away from the Panopticon!

name: Republic of Rome Remastered
creator: Masqueoca
description: The Republic of Rome Remastered is a game of negotiation, power and betrayal that simulates the 250 years of history between the First Punic War (264 B.C.) and the Civil War that followed the assassination of Julius Caesar (44 B.C.)

name: Hybris - Twilight in Olympus
creator: Aurora Game Studio
description: Discover the second act of the Hybris trilogy with Hybris - Twilight in Olympus. 200 years after the Cataclysm, the city of Troy is at the heart of a conflict between 3 factions with different goals but above all 3 radically different ways of playing.

name: Takkure, Cybertalia
creator: Ramperdesign
description:
New team for the Takkure universe. A team of hackers who get caught up in a criminal plot and end up playing Takkure almost unexpectedly.

Join this campaign to help make this new team a reality, with lots of surprises and new features.

name: Valhalla Awaits
creator: Frontier Games
description: In Valhalla Awaits: 1-6 players assume the role of a Feigur; a brave warrior destined for death. To achieve the ultimate victory each Feigur must defeat hordes of monsters, powerful elites, and deadly bosses in this tile-based, viking-themed, adventure game.

name: Azteca AD 1521 - The Battle for the Empire
creator: Azteca AD 1521
description: AZTECA AD 1521 is a multiplayer, first to finish, fast paced board game with a unique mix of luck, skill and knowledge. From 2 to 4 single players or 4 teams with 2 player in each team.

name: Destinium
creator: theccl97
description: Trust me, because as a passionate gamer, I know what you're looking for in a card game. Destinium stands out from the rest by putting the community at the center of every decision; your opinion will be heard and valued. We're not a big corporation, we're gamers like you, committed to creating the game we've always wanted, full of innovation, interaction, and constant improvements. Our focus is not just to offer another TCG, but to build together a unique and constantly evolving experience. Supporting Destinium is supporting a game made with passion, creativity, and above all, respect for the players.

name: Monster Rock by Martin Wallace and Amanda Milne
creator: SchilMil Games
description:
Monster Rock is a rollicking game of music and adventure set in a modern fantasy world.
Write songs, train hard, upskill your band.  You must rock your audience to gain followers and lead them onward to the Revolution against mad King Richard.

name: Cthulhu 1920
creator: TOP1US
description:
Step into the eerie world of Cthulhu 1920, a strategic card game where sanity is your lifeline. 

Players navigate a grid-based playfield, battling enemies, collecting items, and using weapons to survive. Each player starts with a hero card, representing their character with unique abilities. The goal is to maintain your sanity while outmaneuvering opponents and defeating the horrors that lurk in the shadows. 

With simple rules but deep strategic potential, Cthulhu 1920 offers a thrilling and immersive experience in the Lovecraftian universe.

name: No More Kings
creator: Frontier Games
description: It is August 1914, Europe is about to be engulfed in war for the next four grueling years. Take command of France, Great Britain, the German Empire, and the Austro-Hungarian Empire in a fight for victory.

name: Sea & Steel: Columbus' Voyages
creator: Neva Wargames
description: Pre-order (P-300) nevawargames.com

name: Zoo-ography Extended Edition - 2nd Edition Reprint with Connections and World Exhibits Expansions
creator: Doomsday Robots Game Company
description: Build a beautiful zoo!  Use tiles to lay out the zoo’s habitats, populate them with diverse animals, build attractions, and bring in lots of visitors.  If you build the zoo that best meets the city’s needs, you win. || Features tile-laying, animeeples, drafting, variable objectives, and simultaneous play for 1-4 players!

name: Pilsna: A Drink To The Past
creator: Ephyrean Games
description: Join the Fabled Four Pack in Pilsna: A Drink to the Past! Team up to battle foes, uncover treasures, and defeat the evil Lady Dunkel in this thrilling co-op adventure!

name: Shattered Divinity: The 7 Fragments - JRPG Anime Board Game
creator: Cyber Wizard Games
description: An epic turn-based anime JRPG campaign board game for 1 to 4 players.

name: Lords of Worlds
creator: Mojito Studios
description: 2 to 4 players compete to create the most valuable world by purchasing various types of terrain tiles and adding them to their personal planet.

name: Shut up and plant!
creator: Jimlampereur
description: This game is a humorous card game based on the life of a typical treeplanter, or as we like to call ourselves: dirtbags. Inspired by my own real life experiences as a planter and those of my surroundings. Jump in the bush world and be the best planter, don’t just sit there at the cache, shut up and plant!

name: Werewolf On The Moon
creator: Rock Solid Games
description: You're a crew member of a large freighter making an unscheduled detour to the moon. No problem, except you happen to also be a werewolf. What could possibly go wrong?

name: Graam Worlds Rift Walker: RTS Tabletop
creator: Rift Walker
description: Our tabletop war game features fast-paced gameplay with a unique leveling and recruitment system, hand-drawn artwork, and self-produced 3D miniatures. Launching with 2-3 factions, it includes 1vs1 and battle royale modes, with plans for solo/co-op options.

name: The Thinning Veil - Red Mist
creator: Triskelion Games
description: Red Mist is a skirmish game set in the world of the Thinning Veil for 1 to 10 players. Develop your warband over a campaign, test your mettle, bring honour to your name! Hero or villain? You decide!

name: WarBonds: Battle For Vitoria
creator: Punk This Studios
description: A strategy board game of medieval fantasy warfare; where leadership influences the loyalty of ally and enemy units. Units without loyalty are susceptible to leaving your army; or worse, be persuaded to join the enemy.

name: Pizza Faction
creator: Wolf-Boy Entertainment Group
description: Introducing Pizza Faction, the ultimate take-that style deck-builder where kindness won't cut it! Can you rise to the challenge and claim your spot at the top? Get ready to assert dominance and REIGN SUPREME.

name: Heroes of Thargos Card Game - The Starter Deck
creator: SBG Editions
description: Start your Thargos adventure or add more expansions to your Heroes of Thargos Core Card Game Sets and take the adventure ever deeper for your Hero Party. Delve into the dark gritty world of Thargos based on the Cursed Empire TTRPG. Play in Campaign Mode or create your own adventures! Solo, Vs. and Team Play.

name: Dune: Kwisatz Haderach Edition
creator: GF9
description: Discover Arrakis like you've never seen it before!

name: Feed & Breed: Risky Rabbit Rivalry
creator: Scattershot Games
description:
Welcome to the Old Wood, an ideal place for a growing warren of rabbits to call home. You are not the only one to think so though, so you will need to compete to forage the most carrots and grow your warren the largest! Be careful foraging too deep into the Old Woods as a hungry skulk of foxes prowl these trees, always on the lookout for their next meal!

Feed & Breed is a competitive push your luck card game where 1-4 players will compete to grow the largest warren of rabbit by gathering food and trying to avoid foxes!

name: VERSUS 42
creator: Paradigma Games
description: Let the tournament begin! Enter the ever-shifting arena of VERSUS for a summoning deathmatch. Enjoy a minimalist gameplay with rich tactics and infinite synergies. Experience a skill-based yet unpredictable system, where creative talent prevails.

name: The Thinning Veil
creator: Triskelion Games
description: Explore the Land of the Quick, the Land of the Dead and the Other Side of Midnight, in this unique world-crawler. Inspired by Celtic mythology, and the legend and folklore of the British Isles, the Thinning Veil provides a deeply immersive, narrative campaign that evolves with the decisions you make, and also includes several short 'three act play' adventures. The game scales seamlessly, for 1 to 4 players, in a co-operative experience which promises no down time. Don't spend too long in the Twilight, life is for living! Triskelion Games presents 'The Thinning Veil'.

name: WiseWars
creator: Teider Games
description: On the veiled threshold between the mundane and the arcane, two powerful sorcerers cast a spell capable of changing their fate. However, they soon discover that only one future is possible. Thus begins a mystical battle where each sorcerer will try to impose his vision on that of the adversary. In this clash of wills and magic, The fight for control of destiny has begun, and only one can claim the future.

name: Warpgrit
creator: Svärd
description: Warp into a Space Station filled with powerful gear, secrets and ethereal horrors. for 2-6 players. Experience a claustrophobic journey where tactical movements shape your destiny. Encounter mysterious events, face mutants, and strategic boss fights. Your every choice matters in this adrenaline-fueled quest for powerful loot and survival. Will you come out victorious?"

name: Dog, Cat, Bunny, Bear - Fun Family Card Game About Cute Animals!
creator: Cute Cub Games
description:
Welcome to our new card game called Dog, Cat, Bunny, Bear! It's a cute colorful card game about animals and their food that is fun to play with the whole family! Playable from 2 - 4 players that will keep you engaged for sure!

This card game is the PURRfect (Sorry for the pun!) card game to play with as it's competitive, simple, casual and overall fun! You will have a deck of cards that contain a dog, cat, bunny, bear and their foods - bone, fish, carrot and honey. You will need to match them, and the first to be without a pile of cards wins!

You can become a support and get your own PET drawn into the deck of cards as well!

name: Forest Rush
creator: rpgfigures.com
description: A fantasy adventure game full of quests, unexpected alliances and magical chaos. Complete objectives, outsmart your rivals and adapt to ever-changing rules in FOREST RUSH.

name: Icons of Kyiv
creator: Risiivr
description:
Icons of Kyiv is a dice placement game in which 2 - 4 players take on the roles of gifted monks. They carry on their shoulders the weight of a near-impossible deadline to create not only the best icon, but also a new fresco for a freshly built cathedral. They will have to fight their own physical degradation, exhaustion, and laziness. 

The net profit from this game will be donated toward restoration of damaged Ukrainians icons.

name: Stones of Nuria
creator: Taverna Ludica Games
description: Stones of Nuria is a fantasy adventure. It is an immersive dungeon crawler that quickly draws players into its spell.

name: Traders and Raiders: Vikings!
creator: Traiders and Raiders: Vikings!
description: Embark on an epic journey with 'Traders and Raiders: Vikings'. Explore the uncharted map, survive treacherous waters, and thrive in the Viking Age of 846 AD. As a Gaelic-Norse chieftain, you have the freedom to raid settlements, challenge fellow players in raids, engage in trade with settlements, and negotiate trade agreements with one another. It's a world where the goals are clear: EXPLORE, SURVIVE, and THRIVE as you amass wealth and strive to become the ultimate Viking chieftain.

name: Behemoth: Rise of Shadow
creator: Llamascape Games
description:
Explore Earth, rescue wild animals and protect the Behemoth from the shadow bio-sphere.

Behemoth is an immersive co-operative adventure game set in 2265. It has an engaging gameplay thanks to intuitive AI mechanics that adapt to players actions.

It supports 1 to 5 players, and release is currently planned for 2026

name: Koschei the Deathless
creator: JJRock
description: Deckbuilding adventure wrapped in Slavic folklore

name: Amrtaka -The Battle For Immortality
creator: UNDERTREEGAMES
description:
Welcome to the World of AMRTAKA (The Battle for Eternal Life).
In this game, you will be a mighty warrior battling for a magical potion known as AMRTAKA. This game is designed for 2-4 players. Each player has their own kingdom with just a few possessions and soldiers. Your goal is to take control of islands in a vast cosmic ocean and fight for your people to grant them immortality. This will enable you to rule over those islands forever as an immortal leader.

name: Tribulation
creator: Jack Dunbar
description: Hold the forces of evil at bay in this dark, biblically-inspired fantasy setting for 1-2 players.

name: Dawn of Breya
creator: SurajGames
description: Experience an epic journey in Dawn of Breya, an immersive high fantasy area control game that transports you to the captivating origins of the magnificent continent of Breya.

name: Catacombs
creator: Elzra
description: Catacombs is a dungeon crawler with a focus on flicking to resolve combat and move around the map. This next iteration serves as a sequel to the first edition of Catacombs with a more serious tone and new features. An optional system for resolving movement and combat without flicking will also be included.

name: ULTIMEDIATION
creator: Ultimediation SARL
description: ULTIMEDIATION is a deeply cooperative strategy experience where players unite as human mediators and extraterrestrials to end a devastating world war on Earth and lay the groundwork for lasting peace. Every decision matters as you evacuate populations, prevent escalating attacks, and negotiate peace.before the final collapse.

name: InvestigationBG
creator: Investigation
description: This RPG board game, developed by two authors, is one of a kind. This adventure is meant to be immersive and simple. For 1-6 players.

name: IDOLS CLASH
creator: 42GamesProject
description:
Idols Clash is the first strategic cardgame about the K-Pop industry phenomenon that combines deck building and deduction elements with the pleasure of collecting fanart illustrations of K-Pop Idols. 
Get ready for an epic battle between K-Pop entertainment agencies.

name: BarbeCubes
creator: Mind's Vision
description: Barbecubes is a cooperative dice game about barbecue for the whole family!

name: Toerkk
creator: MindBrushers
description: Play as one of the dwarven warlords and find a mythical torc to rule the world! Or simply eliminate your opponents using your warriors, abilities and spells. But beware, land of Bokvyst is a mysterious place, every turn you will face the powers which rule this land.

name: Forsaken : Dante's inferno
creator: Top Decker LLC
description: Forsaken : Dante's inferno is an adaptation of the famous book from Dante Alighieri

name: Global Mining
creator: GlobalMining
