description: A strategic, economic game based on the actual resources of the Earth, created by real Miners and Geologists.

name: Dragons, Dragons, Dragons!
creator: DaDaDing
description:
This game is a trick-based game for families.
Mechanics of classic games like Hearts or Bridge are woven into a narrative of a great dragon tournament.

Dragons, Dragons, Dragons! is not only a great game in itself it is also a playful and engaging way to guide kids to play the games their (grand) parents love.

name: SHANGHAI The Nevernight City
creator: Pandemic Production
description: An interactive detective crime board game.

name: Demon Castle Mononoke
creator: Cardboard Revolution
description: A cooperative survival game where 1-4 players struggle to survive in a ruined castle as it is besieged by a powerful Mononoke and Yōkai from Japanese mythology! Can be played solo, co-op or all vs. one with a 5th player acting as the powerful Mononoke.

name: The Malice of Light Adventures Pledge Manager
creator: Twin Tale Studios
description: A cooperative roguelike boss-battler by the Sadler Bros. set in The Malice of Light.

name: Crystal Age
creator: Gravita Games
description: Embark on an epic journey to the center of the Crater. Venture into different biomes, defeat their creatures, absorb their powers, and strengthen your hero to either dominate or defeat the Corruption!

name: MegaGame Library
creator: Level 99 Games
description: 5 unique and easy to Learn games from Level 99 Games!  Great for game nights and family fun. Games for solo to large groups.

name: I Agree Hells Terms
creator: AmadeusGames
description:
"Welcome to Hell! You agreed to the terms without reading the fine print like everyone else... and now your soul is mine.
Still, I'm feeling generous (or just bored), so I'll give you one last chance to get your soul back by playing Hell's Bingo!

I Agree Hell's Terms leverages a traditional game to implement new mechanics, such as the "Soulless" health being generated based on the player's actual age, or for example, curses will play with factors external to the game itself, such as whether it's raining that day, or even the number of players in the game!
And remember, the Devil always has the advantage... 
Will you be able to get your soul back?

name: RADIOACTIVE BEES DUEL
creator: INEVITABLE IDEAS
description: A tile-stacking game in which mutant bees build 3-D radioactive honeycombs.

name: DIECATHLON
creator: Waterbear Workshop
description: DIECATHLON is the supreme cooperative deck-building dice crafter about escaping death, not destiny, in neon-lit Atlantis.

name: Bloodwork: The Reckoning
creator: I Demo Games
description: Bloodwork is a dark fantasy co‑op board game for 1-4 players, where you lead a party of Guild Mercenaries through a branching dual‑faction campaign of perilous journeys and tactical battles in a world shattered by the death of its Goddess, and the cosmic corruption unleashed in her wake.

name: The Cats of New Orleans
creator: Raybox Games
description: The Cats of New Orleans - A feline adventure set in 1868.

name: Company of Heroes - Desert Warfare Expansion + Reprint
creator: Bad Crow Games
description: Experience the fast-paced, tactical WWII combat of the hit video game. As a commander, seize vital territory, manage resources, and build your army from the ground up. Master flanking, cover, and unique abilities in a desperate battle of strategy and attrition to dominate the battlefield.

name: 20 Strong: Nemesis, Tainted Grail, & Etherfields
creator: Chip Theory Games
description: Three new 20 Strong decks, set in three incredible universes from Awaken Realms!

name: Goa
creator: Quined Games
description: A modern classic reborn: first released in 2004, Goa by Rüdiger Dorn became a cornerstone eurogame, celebrated for its elegant mix of auctions, resource management, and strategy, and remains highly rated to this day. Now, over two decades later, it returns as a Master Print Edition with reimagined artwork, a new solo mode, and refined gameplay—offering the definitive version of this timeless favorite.

name: The Lord of the Rings: Foes of Middle-earth
creator: D20 Culture
description:
In this cooperative cinematic game, you and your friends take on the roles of legendary heroes like Frodo, Aragorn, Legolas, and Gimli to face the greatest dangers of Middle-earth.

Players will embark on a dungeon crawler rich in strategy, cooperation and immersion, divided into three intense phases: exploration, mini-boss challenges, and a thrilling final boss battle.

name: Vora Gamefound edition
creator: Bluebird on Fire
description: A cutely brutal strategy game of pushing blocks and breaking friendships.

name: Onward: MOBA Board Game (Reprint & Solo Co-Op Expansion)
creator: Skytear Games
description: Onward is a streamlined 1-hour board game for 1 to 4 players that gives you the feeling of playing MOBA video games like DOTA 2 and League of Legends. Twisted is the new expansion introducing a solo and co-op mode compatible with all existing contents. Back now, pay in 5 interest-free monthly installments, and play it this December!

name: Hidden Realms: The Mummy's Tomb
creator: Tabletop for World
description: Hidden Realms: The Mummy’s Tomb is a single-page, Print & Play, Roll & Write dungeon crawl inspired by classic D&D maps. Draw polyomino shapes to map a new dungeon every game. Uncover treasure in the form of coins, keys, and magic items. Face deadly guardians, like oozes, skeletons, zombies, golems, mimics, and the Mummy itself. Plan carefully, because defeating it is not for the faint of heart. Are you up for the challenge?

name: Forest Fellowship: First Settlement
creator: Costavolcano
description: An Immersive, Fast-paced, and Fun Card Game. Explore the Forest, find Resources, get Help & help others // 2 to 6 Players + SOLO // + Add-Ons: 1000pcs Puzzles

name: PARIAH CARD GAME
creator: Pariah Games Studio
description: A card game that plays like a wargame. Do you have what it takes to survive? Welcome to PARIAH

name: Neopia Quest
creator: Ghostfire Gaming
description: Neopia Quest is a highly replayable tabletop journey for 1-4 players, designed to capture the core exploration, collecting, and charm of the classic online world. Players will choose their favorite Neopet and loyal Petpet companion to travel across iconic Neopian lands as they take on a host of challenges.

name: Witch Hunter [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Witch Hunter is a boss-battling card game where you step into a land choked by curses, crawling with monsters, and abandoned by hope. As a Witch Hunter, driven by grim resolve, you take on contracts no one else survives.

name: Animalcatraz — Late Pledge
creator: Zeronimo Games
description:
Compete solo or team up in pairs in this sandbox prison brawler for 2–8 players. Escape… or rise to become the Kingpin.

Affrontez vos rivaux en solo ou en équipe de deux dans ce sandbox carcéral pour 2 à 8 joueurs. Évade-toi… ou deviens le Kingpin.

name: Cloud War Tales: Nuvitrum
creator: PIF Games
description: Cloud War Tales: Nuvitrum is a tactical, asymmetrical deck-building game for 1 to 4 players, playable competitively, cooperatively, or even solo through a narrative campaign that reveals the world’s forgotten history.

name: Go Viking
creator: Crackling Creations
description: Raid • Roll • Glory. Go Viking is a fast, push-your-luck dice game steeped in Norse mythology. Unleash mythic powers, risk it all in daring raids, and seize Loot to earn eternal glory.

name: Furruits
creator: All Or None Games
description: A snappy and sweet push-your-luck card game about collecting furry fruit critters, and selling them for maximum profit!

name: Hexblem: Beating the Unbeatable
creator: Unbeatable Games
description:
A roguelite board game with co-op, competitive, and solo modes, optional app support, and one mission: defeat the Unbeatable.
The more you play, the more content you unlock: no scripted sessions, no safe routes, and interactive cards that evolve in every game.

New Adventures and Final Bosses will arrive free over time, without forcing you to buy a new game every year.

Only on Gamefound.

name: Brass: Pittsburgh
creator: Roxley Games
description: Built on Martin Wallace's acclaimed Brass system, this brand new sequel introduces innovative new mechanics and content, while maintaining the overall structure and strategic depth that Brass has become known for.

name: Ravohria
creator: Ninety-One Games
description: You've been hired to disrupt the Ravohria family's control and successfully captured a capsule and its blueprints from their research lab. Now, escape through their huge restricted area, cause chaos, and deliver the capsule to your leader, all the while advancing his secret personal agenda. Will you succeed?

name: Laužas
creator: Amblys
description: A cozy cooperative game about seeing who knows their friends the best.

name: SUPER
creator: Square Moon
description: Lead a powerful agency of Supers in a race to reach 50 million followers! Recruit, strategize and pull off spectacular combos to complete epic missions and claim the top spot !

name: Whistlewood Express
creator: Pihari Games
description: Build the shared train wisely. Time your deliveries. Outsmart your rival on a new map every game.

name: Gods & Mortals
creator: Wolffdesigna
description: Step into the sandals of an ancient Greek god. As Zeus, Athena, Ares, and other deities, raise armies, spark conflicts, erect temples, and unleash unique special powers — all to outmaneuver your divine rivals. Mortals are your pawns, their devotion to you is a commodity, and betrayal is divine tradition. The throne of Olympus is yours... if you can seize it.

name: BYTE:SHIFT – A Competitive Hacking Game [Dynamic PnP of the Month & Gamebook]
creator: Beaverlicious Games
description: BYTE:SHIFT is a competitive hacking game where one or two players design the most effective routines by drafting modular elements onto their floppy disks. When execution begins, smart combinations and chained effects turn good code into high-scoring plays.

name: Here to Slay DUNGEONS
creator: Unstable Games
description: A cooperative dungeon-crawling adventure based on the hit game, Here to Slay ⚔️

name: Arrival
creator: ION
description: Arrival -Third in the High Frontier Saga

name: Artefacts
creator: fabulist-factory
description: Build your Artefact and prove its worth in the Arena !

name: Voidfall: Resurgence Expansion and Galactic Box reprint (Pledge Manager)
creator: Mindclash Games
description: Unleash psionic powers and turn the tide of the war - Voidfall is returning with new expansions and Galactic Box reprint.

name: Fate of Venterra
creator: Korrosive Games
description: The strategic game of empire building and expansion. Easy to learn, six asymmetric factions, and multiple paths to victory.

name: Colosseum: The Grand Spectacle
creator: Fantasia Games
description:
Fantasia Games is bringing back the beloved classic "Colosseum" with a beautifully crafted Deluxe Edition. Designed by Wolfgang Kramer & Markus Lübke, this new edition features Jonny Pac as the lead developer and stunning artwork from The Mico & Ian O'Toole!
A fresh take on a timeless game, elevated in every way. 
Step into the arena and create a spectacle worthy of the Emperor! 🏟️✨

name: Sky Empire - New Dawn
creator: Greymarsh Games
description: Sky Empire is a truly unique 4X game for 1-4 players, set in a richly detailed steampunk universe. Each player takes on the role of a Doppler - a unique being with one mind and two bodies - on a quest to become Emperor of the planet Dopheus!

name: Apex: Carnivore
creator: OneStone Studios
description: A fast-paced deckbuilding battle for survival, where every dice roll mirrors the chaos of evolution, but it’s your strategy that defines its course.

name: We Played God - A Survival Miniatures Game
creator: Black Site Studios
description:
We Played God is a solo / coop, tabletop miniatures skirmish game set in a near future where dinosaurs have been genetically reconstructed. 

Eden was intended to be a scientific haven for the observation and study of prehistoric creatures, but it becomes a nightmare when the facility goes dark, and the fences begin to fail. 

Sneak, run, hide, and fight your way through an intense narrative campaign where you must survive against all odds. Collect supplies, recruit survivors, and work your way through Eden’s hidden secrets in a desperate attempt to escape the island.

name: Heroes of the Shire: Light & Shadow
creator: Senior Games
description: Prepare to embark on a new, stand-alone adventure in the Heroes of the Shire universe! Light & Shadow introduces thrilling gameplay features and expands the experience, taking your epic journeys to unparalleled heights. Includes 15 acrylic standees.

name: Beetle Battle
creator: Wurmory Studio
description: In Buglandia, glory means betrayal. Build beetle chains, slap fast, and dump your failures on others. A ruthless, chaotic card game where every move stings – and only the dirtiest Buglord survives.

name: CARNIVORE
creator: Buer Games
description: CARNIVORE is a cataclysmic dinosaur skirmish game where predators battle for survival in the shadow of extinction. Built on a fast, visceral D10 system, it delivers combat that is tactically deep but accessible—easy to learn, brutal to master. Unlike other skirmish games, players compete over prey driven by instinct rules—objectives that move, react, and fight back. Designed with a commitment to paleo-accuracy, every miniature and mechanic reinforces the raw, prehistoric struggle. With high-quality miniatures and a boutique, art-driven rulebook, CARNIVORE is as immersive on the table as it is on the page.

name: Vampire Lords
creator: Couple of Games
description:
As the fires of war burn across XVth-century Romania, the vampires emerge from the shadows, ready to claim dominion over the realm of mortals. Will you rise to rival the legend of Vlad Dracula?
Sink your teeth into this strategic board game combining area control and deck-building mechanics.

name: Storm Weavers STRONGHOLD
creator: OtherWorlds
description: Story driven adventure game. A mix of TRPG, Board Game and Gamebook for one to four players.

name: The Old King's Crown Second Printing & New Songs of Home Expansion
creator: Eerie Idol Games
description:
The Old King’s Crown is a 1-4 player, large-scale strategy board game of skill and intrigue, set in an ancient, crumbling kingdom, where every card is a window into a fantastical land. Clash with your opponents’ forces across the map, vie for control of political councils and journey to wild sites of power.

The kingdom welcomes you once more with a second printing of The Old King’s Crown, as well as an expansive new expansion that introduces new factions, neutral kingdom cards and exciting ways to help you claim the throne.

name: Small Time Heroes Reprint and Expansion [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: In this cooperative deck builder, you’ll take on the role of one of the Small-Time Heroes and work together to defend the town. With each battle, you’ll build up your deck of cards, choosing from a variety of cards that represent your hero’s unique abilities. As your power builds, you will defeat waves of minions and end with a final boss battle. Defeat the boss before they defeat you!

name: Crystallo [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Collect sets of crystals by laying cards to liberate fantastic beasts from a dragon!

name: Astra Imperium [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Lead your empire to victory with industry, conquest, and glorious monuments -- all in less than 10 minutes.

name: Spellrift Legends
creator: Dragori Games
description: Command legendary heroes in a thrilling adventure to save the planes! Heroes with thematic and unique decks and enemies that adapt to your choices.

name: The Hunters A. D. 1492 2nd Edition and Borderlands Expansion
creator: Officina Monstrorum
description: The Hunters AD 1492 is a cooperative board game for 1-4 players. Become a hunter and face enemies in a renaissance post-apocalyptic world.

name: Queen Alice
creator: Combo Games
description:
Queen Alice is a Mid-Heavy Eurogame all about building engines to improve your actions. 
In Queen Alice you will activate the different actions using chess pieces and their well-known movements with a card-driven system.

name: Tinctura
creator: Skellig Games
description: Tinctura is a strategic worker placement game where players run competing 18th/19th century pharmacies. During every round of the game you will secretly plan your day, gather ingredients in the forest, train in the village to upgrade skills, hire apprentices, and craft medicines for patients to earn the most victory points and win.

name: The Hunters A. D. 1492 2 edycja i dodatek Borderlands (edycja polska)
creator: Officina Monstrorum
description: The Hunters AD 1492 to gra kooperacyjna przeznaczona dla 1 do 4 graczy. Wciel się w łowcę i stań oko w oko z wrogami w alternatywnym, postapokaliptycznym świecie przełomu średniowiecza i renesansu.

name: Dice Tower Pledge Drive 2026
creator: Dice Tower
description: Support the Dice Tower for our 2026 season!  The Dice Tower is a group of board game enthusiasts who review board and card games.  We also produce top ten lists, a board game podcast, crowdfunding shows, board game news, and much more!

name: Diceocracy: Power to the Pips
creator: All Or None Games
description: New unruly candidates enter the dicey world of politics along with new opportunities, schemes, advertising, and 5-player support!

name: Hubworld: Aidalon
creator: Earthborne Games
description: On the hubworld of Aidalon there is no problem that a fistful of shards can't solve. Build out your sphere of influence and race to keep your foothold through cunning and subterfuge in this sustainably produced, competitive, expandable card game for 2 – 4 players.

name: Dark Omen
creator: Dark Omen
description: Tired of your average dungeon crawler? Add something different to your collection for a change. Join a band of misfits to take on a great evil in a dark Nordic past.

name: Statecraft
creator: doitgames
description: Statecraft offers a highly interactive experience, simulating key moments from recent history within a political board game format. With four rounds and a final bonus points round, players vie for power, with the highest score determining the ultimate winner.

name: Inferno 1348 Deluxe & Inferno Deluxe Reprint
creator: Red Mojo Games
description: The Plague devours Florence, where ambition is gained only with suffering.

name: Galactic Invaders
creator: La Hoguerita Estudio
description: Galactic Invaders takes us back to the arcade era of the 90s. Survive waves of minions to defeat the Final Boss using a combination of Cards and Dices in a unique Shoot'em Up experience. Choose between collaborative or competitive mode.

name: Paws
creator: Wild Ventures
description: Rescue endangered animals and grow a thriving sanctuary in this dice-placement game with engine-building and open drafting. One follow protects 10 m² of habitat.

name: Flatout Games - 2026 Releases
creator: FLATOUT GAMES
description: Get all the Flatout Games Kickstarter Edition games including late pledges for new releases Cascadia: Alpine Lakes, Forage, and Honeypot, and past games Calico, Knitting Circle, Cascadia, Cascadia: Landmarks, Cascadia: Rolling, Verdant, Fit to Print, Nocturne, Point Salad, Point City, Point Galaxy, Propolis, and Deep Dive! **Special bundle prices, FREE promos, and discounts on all games!**

name: Sheol 2.0 - Midnight Odyssey
creator: Lunar Oak Studio
description: Sheol 2.0 is the new edition of the critically acclaimed sci-fi game Sheol. Sheol is a SOLO/CO-OP 1-4 player campaign game, set in a unique sci-fi world shrouded in an eternal night.

name: Space Qubes Relaunch
creator: Kagu Spiele
description: Find spare parts to repair your stranded spaceship, while defending against aliens.

name: Quest & Request
creator: QDSS
description:
Quest & Request is a strategic arena dungeon crawler for up to 5 players, set in a twisted and ironic fantasy world.

Four players take on the role of ruthless (anti)heroes, while a fifth becomes Ciarman, the good wizard who controls traps, monsters, and the arena itself.

Each game alternates between map exploration phases and tactical combat inside a custom-built arena, combining easy-to-learn mechanics with deep replayability.

name: Badgers
creator: InterHuman games
description: Lead your badgers to their favorite snacks!

name: ERA TCG
creator: WOF
description:
ERA is a tactical trading card game (TCG), inspired by the intensity of football and the depth of competitive card play.
You’re no longer a spectator, you’re the Coach.

In ERA, you play as a Coach inside a virtual stadium, commanding a team of 4 star Players.
Level up your team, build your plays, chain passes, take shots, and make the key decisions that can change the outcome of the match.

Three goals. One winner.
20 to 30 minutes of pure tension, across the greatest eras of modern football

name: Fighting Fantasy Quest - The Warlock of Firetop Mountain
creator: Ulisses Spiele
description: For forty years the Warlock has been waiting for you… Do you still have what it takes to brave Firetop Mountain? Face the perils of the Warlock together with 1-4 players in this richly illustrated true board-game experience!

name: Of Popes and Plagues
creator: Hillary's Toy Box
description:
A card game of 14th Century Europe and the outbreak of the Bubonic Plague.  He who dies last wins!!!
Adding Spanish, German and French Rules!

name: Ancient Empires
creator: Archona Games
description:
From humble tribe to towering cities and breakthrough technologies - lead your people to glory in this competitive 4X game for 1–4 players by Milan Tasevski.

A compact game of empires, cities, discovery, and conquest - small in size, vast in ambition.

name: Pirouette: Figure Skating Solitaire Game
creator: WeightedDiceGames
description: In this single player puzzle solitaire game, you take the role of an aspiring figure skater on the World stage, trying to claim their place in history while avoiding a disastrous slip up. Can you take home the Gold Medal with a flawless performance? Or will your nerves get the best of you?

name: Heroes of Might & Magic: The Card Game
creator: Archon Studio
description: This tactical, expandable card game is based on the epic world of Might and Magic. The game allows players to take the role of iconic heroes and use familiar armies to engage in strategic 1v1 battles. The game features various mechanics such as spell casting, resource management, stacking units, and much more, taken straight from the video game.

name: The Void Unveiled: Echoes of Arkham
creator: Dark Gate Games
description: A story-driven Lovecraftian board game where every monster plays by its own rules, and knowledge may be your only weapon, or your downfall.

name: Comber Cat
creator: Gamedolf Limited
description: A Strategic Card Game Collecting Cute Cats!

name: Earth Siege: Arrival
creator: Plague Island Games
description: The skies are no longer ours. Battle as alien invaders or Earth’s defenders in a tense, asymmetric 1-2 player game of politics, technology, and survival.

name: PRINCIPES
creator: Leo Soloviey
description:
Year 1202, the last Senior Prince - the old lion - dies. The Realm has been divided for 64 years. The feuding princes from the Piast dynasty fight among themselves. Each of them strives to win the crown. Can you unite the shattered land?

A 1-4 player medieval area control game set in the 13th-century, divided Kingdom of Poland.

name: Exactly As Planned
creator: No Sharks
description: Will everything go Exactly As Planned?  Find out in this 5-minute, real-time, cooperative heist.

name: Gateway
creator: Tentacula
description:
Step into the enchanting alleys of Gateway, a city where shadows whisper secrets and power is seized in the flicker of a gas lamp.

In this thrilling deck builder for 2-4 players you´ll recruit a motley crew of infamous characters and rely on the power of runestones to conquer the city´s guarded districts.

Immerse yourself in a world where victorian elegance meets fantastical whimsy, and every decision could tip the balance of power.

Will you dominate the dark alleys and opulent parlors, weaving your influence through cunning schemes? Or will your rivals outwit you in this game of strategy and rising infamy?

Dare to play in the city of Gateway.

name: Jump Masters!
creator: Chip Theory Games
description: A cute, cutthroat, hyper-tactical twist on Chinese checkers from Manny Trembley!

name: The Witcher: Legacy
creator: Go On Board
description: Become a witcher and uncover the plot behind sacking the School of the Wolf. History is being written. Make sure it bears your mark.

name: Náttúruval: A Game of Unexpected Competition
creator: Bespoke Games
description: Animals compete using their real-life statistics in this fun card game. The winner might surprise you!

name: YOKAI FOREST DUEL - A Quick & Dirty Tournament Game
creator: GodotGames
description: Grab your slingshot! 2-8 players duel each other, build their decks within a mystical tournament & try to win with strategy, mind games & deduction: Quick & dirty! 😈🌳

name: Rurik Second Edition
creator: Fantasia Games
description: Claim your father's throne! Build, tax, & fight through unique “auction programming.”

name: DeckHand: Race for Infamy
creator: Tidale Games
description: A pirate card game of Crew-building and Infamy-grabbing, where players act simultaneously and chase shared goals across 5 tense rounds.

name: Mythwind: Herbalist & Shepherd Expansions
creator: Open Owl Studios
description: New expansion characters designed by the creators of Sagrada and Mansions of Madness join the Mythwind universe!

name: Boktor: Explore, Fight, Evolve
creator: Fox Troll Games
description: Tired of epic games gathering dust on your shelf? So are we. Boktor is a fast-paced dungeon crawler with quick setup, intuitive rules, and real strategic depth. For 1–6 players, this cooperative adventure lets you explore modular dungeons, upgrade evolving heroes, and take down terrifying Tyrants before the Vortex consumes it all. All in 60 minutes.

name: Dunkelstein - An AR Tabletop Murder Mystery | Escape Game
creator: Make a Break
description:
Dunkelstein blends a physical tabletop game with augmented reality into a cinematic, story-driven murder mystery set in 1914.
Investigate a mysterious villa, examine clues in AR, and combine a physical game board, cards, and miniatures to uncover secrets and solve the crime together.
One villa, multiple stories to play and discover.

name: Europa Universalis Deluxe Deutsche Version
creator: Sound of Drums GmbH
description: Europa Universalis: Der Preis der Macht - Entspricht der Englischen Deluxe Ausgabe

name: Invincible: Aftermath - Season 2
creator: Indie Boards and Cards
description: The second season comes alive in this stand alone sequel to  this critically successful Invincible game. Become the young superheroes from the show as they defend the earth. Based on, and fully compatible with, Astro Knights!

name: Timeless Journeys: The Italian Grand Tour
creator: Lirius Games
description: Timeless Journeys: The Italian Grand Tour is a board game inspired by the historic Grand Tour, where players travel across Italy in search of knowledge, art, and meaningful encounters. Through card play and thoughtful planning, you will shape your journey and record your discoveries in your Travel Journal.

name: Colt Express: The Complete Collection
creator: Tycoon Games
description: Get absolutely EVERYTHING Colt Express, with a few new surprises, in a slick storage solution with The Complete Collection!

name: Marches & Batailles
creator: Sapper & Vet
description: Marches & Batailles is an operational-level Napoleonic wargame played on historical canvas maps with wooden counters. No dice rolling is required: the game play, outcome of battles and morale effects are determined by the drawing of colored tokens ... All components are handcrafted in France.

name: Aurigae
creator: LudarisGames
description:
Aurigae — Race for Glory in the Heart of Ancient Rome!
Step into the sandals of a fearless charioteer and thunder across the Roman Circus! Be the first to cross the finish line and claim eternal glory. Available in English and French

name: Radiance [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Become a Luminary and embark on an epic quest to defeat the Shade and protect the last of the Bright Cities. Upgrade your deck, learn new skills, master the elements, and discover explosive combos as you explore and fight your way through this highly modular and endlessly replayable adventure game.

name: Deck of Wonders: The Master of Dungeons
creator: Furia Games
description: A solo/co-op tactical card game where Fate herself has stacked the deck against you, now expanded with a new Villain and card type!

name: Black Hats: The Tactical Card Game with a Hackable Board
creator: Dice Or Death Games
description: A fully customizable, cyberpunk-themed, tactical card game. Hire your unique crew of net runners, hack your way into the heart of your enemy's network, then make off with their data... or achieve victory by disconnecting your opponent's runners with brute force attacks.

name: AVGhost Paranormal Investigation: Second edition
creator: Juegorama
description: AVGhost: Paranormal Investigation is a cooperative game for 1 to 4 players, where you will take control of a team of paranormal investigators. All of them are part of a specialized agency that investigates and solves paranormal events and poltergeists. In the game, you will be hired by several people with issues, who will request you to cleanse their homes from troublesome ghosts and spirits. The game is designed to be played in the dark, with a digital APP that will reveal clues, add background music and will startle you with the sounds and voices from different paranormal events.

name: Survive Nuclear Apocalypse: A 30-min Game of Brutal Survival
creator: Board Collie Games
description: A strategic survival game of shifting alliances and brutal choices in a nuclear wasteland.

name: Dicey Devices: Mad Ambition
creator: Origami Whale Games
description: As a mad scientist, use your laboratory, robots, and trusty assistant Igor to annihilate your pesky peers!

name: Legends of the Seas
creator: Arkada Studio
description: All aboard the ship, sailor! Turbulent seas and Kraken attacks await you in this fast-paced cooperative hybrid game for 1-4 players.

name: Last Week of Summer
creator: AlliesOrEnemies
description: It’s 1986, you just finished high school, and there’s one last week of summer before you join the real world. Last Week of Summer combines action selection with modular locations. Visit the video store, music shop, skate park, fast food, arcade, and convenience store, all while you complete goals, make friends with the cool kids, get invited to parties, and make a mixtape of summer memories.

name: 1793: Patriotas y Traidores
creator: Headquarter Games
description: 1793: Patriotas y Traidores recrea el caos que desgarró Francia en los años 1792-1794 como nunca antes se había hecho. EDICIÓN COMPLETAMENTE EN ESPAÑOL.

name: Borderlands: Mister Torgue's Arena of Badassery 2
creator: Monster Fight Club
description: Back to the arena Vault Hunters with an all new boss-battler, standalone expansion – Invincible Arena! But the carnage doesn't stop there, with all new campaign expansions, skirmish battles, new gameplay modes, and more loot that you can carry!

name: Vampire Survivors - The Board Game
creator: Grey Fox Games
description:
The award winning video game hits your tabletop in this thrilling co-op experience.

Up to 4 brave survivors must battle against wave after wave of enemies hell bent on their destruction.

In this fast paced game from designer Emerson Matsuuchi, survival is your only goal, because Red Death comes for us all...

name: Snowdonia: Grand Tour + Special Edition
creator: Naylor Games Ltd
description: The highly acclaimed scenario-based Eurogame is back! Explore a new mega-expansion alongside a refreshed and updated base game. A new board system introduces gorgeous all-new art, superior usability and the best gameplay yet!

name: Rove: Anchorpoint + Rove Reprint
creator: Addax Games
description: Rove: Anchorpoint is a compact and affordable campaign game built on the challenging and tactical system from the original Rove. It features a 25-encounter cooperative campaign, twelve all-new characters, and deep progression and leveling choices. Designed for both seasoned Rove veterans and newcomers alike, Anchorpoint delivers an epic experience in a small, content-rich package.

name: Dragon Eclipse: The Grand Quest
creator: Awaken Realms
description: Standalone sequel to the acclaimed Dragon Eclipse game with tactical combat and story-driven play.

name: Garage Rock
creator: Mariposa Games
description:
Time to rise from garage jam band to teenage legends!

It’s the summer of 1986. The neighborhood is alive with BMX bikes, cassette tapes, and pirate radio blasting from treehouses. In the middle of it all, your garage band is born.

DJ Johnny Law is hosting his infamous Battle of the Bands, a show so revered that the winners become local rock heroes and soon a band of legend! To claim the crown, you’ll need great songs, amazing skills, and tons of swagger. You’ll plaster your poster on gig walls, make t-shirts and flyers, upgrade your gear, and get ready to rock because fame, fortune, and eternal neighborhood bragging rights await!

Garage Rock is a mid-weight worker placement game that needs you to crank it to 11!

name: The Great Harbor
creator: Archona Games
description: Draft & send dice workers to the harbor, expand your colony, construct ships, trade across the Mediterranean, and engage the pirates!

name: Grifoni - Blades for Hire
creator: Ludus Magnus Studio
description: Tactical eurogame with story-driven gameplay for 2 to 4 players. Build your Band and shape the fate of the Grifoni Company.

name: Heropolis - Hero of the day!
creator: Spielpraxis.ch
description: Heropolis is a "4X-inspired" strategic building and adventure game, where 2-4 funny "Everyday-Heroes" try to win their citizens favor with heroic deeds. The rondel mechanism ensures strategic depth, unique NEWS cards (drawn tasks - for everyone to solve) keep the entertainment high, and the detailed 3D city with buildings and characters maximizes immersion. Are you ready to be the next Hero?

name: HexTerrain - printable gaming board -
creator: Tabletop-Modellbau
description: The modular game board for Battletech and other hex-based tabletop games.

name: Restless
creator: Restless Designs
description: Restless is a fantasy adventure game where you and up to three other players lose yourselves in a vast open world brimming with dangers, treasures, and excitement. Each session is packed with gripping events that culminate in an epic boss fight.

name: Fetching Feathers & D.O.T
creator: Chris Priscott - Unfringed
description: Attract fancy flocks to your seasonal sanctuaries in Fetching Feathers & Duel with a Difference in D.O.T.

name: HOOD: Troubles in Sherwood
creator: PHALANX
description: A wildly asymmetric board game of rebellion, power, and unholy ambition.

name: Joyride: Full Throttle
creator: Rebellion Unplugged
description: Joyride: Full Throttle is a high-octane racing game for 2–6 players. Choose your racing line through a crowded city, trade paint on tight corners, and smash opponents into buildings, barriers, and each other! Featuring an expanded team mode, portals, and new cars, items, and maps.

name: Song of Silveranth
creator: Red Raven Games
description: Venture through a massive, open-world fairy tale land, searching for money on wild adventures to free your father from debtor's prison. From the designer of Sleeping Gods.

name: Eternitium - Race through time !
creator: Haumea Games
description: In this unique deckbuilding game, race through time to find the Eternitium gem that will grant you eternal life!

name: APEX CLASH - The Game
creator: Gysar Studios
description:
A legendary board game to challenge your friends in supreme battles.
Build your team. Win with strategy. Reach the Apex in the ultimate Clash! 
Are you ready to fight?

name: B.E.L.O.W.: The Asylum
creator: Awaken Realms
description: Action-horror board game where elite agents battle threats in a haunted Asylum.

name: Micro Architects: Big City Vacation
creator: Thistroy Games
description: Skyscrapers, cruise ships, and tropical escapes await in Big City Vacation - the exciting new expansion for Micro Architects!

name: Super Lucha!
creator: Steve Resk
description:
Introducing Super Lucha, the exciting crossover between Supershow the Game and Eddie Mort, the creator of the beloved cartoons Mucha Lucha! and Los Campeones de la Lucha Libre. 

This unique dice and card game brings together the wrestling expertise of SRG Universe and the iconic artistry of Eddie Mort, offering a one-of-a-kind gaming experience!

name: Arydia: The Paths We Dare Tread - Second Printing
creator: Far Off Games
description: Arydia: The Paths We Dare Tread is an open world, campaign-based, co-operative, fantasy-based, "green legacy" role-playing board game.

name: X-ODUS, Rise of the Corruption - Second Edition
creator: Bored Game Ink
description:
A fully revised sci-fi cooperative game for 1–4 players.
Explore a decaying galaxy, confront an unstoppable force, and rebuild the only weapon that can stop it. X-ODUS: Second Edition features streamlined mechanics, faster setup, stunning new visuals, and deeper narrative immersion—everything you loved, now rebuilt from the ground up!

name: Kavango & Lodges Expansion
creator: Mazaza Games
description: Build ecotourism lodges to keep your nature reserve thriving! New card placement mechanics add strategic depth and crucial bonuses!

name: SHADOWS DEEP
creator: themoongrel
description: Control Vampires against Hunters in a strategy game featuring deck building, combat, feeding, and thematic, emergent gameplay.

name: Far Far Out - Late Pledge & Pledge Manager
creator: Studio Infinitus
description: Far Far Out is a space exploration game where you can win in three different ways. You will discover planets, asteroids and star systems. Your spaceship and your crewmembers go on a Cosmic Odyssey where no one has ever gone before. Encounter strange lifeforms on planets, dig for items on asteroids or find quests that help you achieve your goal in this competitive galactic journey. During the game you might help or frustrate other players in your hunt for reputation, wealth and exploration. Gather more and more dice while moving your ships through up to 11 different star systems and increase your chances at winning encounters with strange beings or players on one of the more than 30 planets, asteroids and anomalies.

name: VoidRoll - A Year-Long Voyage
creator: FlorianFiedler
description: VoidRoll is a sci-fi dice-assignment game of ship management and exploration. Roll 5 dice to power your systems, deploy drones, and navigate a dangerous galaxy. Will you be a lawful trader or a feared outlaw? Features a full Year-Long-Adventure with new maps released monthly throughout 2026. Launching late November!

name: Hidden Ark: Wild Oceans
creator: All Or None Games
description: Experience Hidden Ark with thematic events, exploration, and immersive campaign play!

name: Threshold
creator: Open Owl Studios
description: Threshold is a solo & cooperative game of epic proportions, deep character customization and strategic combat set in an immersive world.

name: Below: The Bunker
creator: AmadeusGames
description:
You suffered an air raid during World War I.
When you wake up, you find yourself alone and unarmed in the depths of a dangerous underground bunker. 
Soldier! Fight for your life and find your way out.

A solitaire hand management game with only 25 cards. 
Inspired in Palm Island & Amnesia Games

name: The Mix
creator: Guime
description: Are you ready to become the best mixologist? As a young recruit at the Foxtrot Bar, you must create delicious cocktails to satisfy your customers. Get your shakers ready and show off your mixology skills! The Mix is the cocktail-based theme strategy board game! 🍸🍹🥃

name: Theocratia - Reboot
creator: Mojito Studios
description:
Manipulate the civilizations of a remote island, shaping their growth and destiny—all to become the most worshiped God!  🛸
Brand new T-Game, by Daniele Tascini & Daniel Marinangeli. Illustrated by Andrew Bosley.

name: Dungeon Twister 20th Anniversary Edition
creator: ludically
description: Unleash your inner strategist in a twisting dungeon! Dive into an ever-changing dungeon with deep strategic gameplay, stunning miniatures, and quick setup. Experience the ultimate two-player adventure that scales for more! Available in French, English and German.

name: Gone to Gaia
creator: Rose Gauntlet Entertainment
description: Safeguard the last remnants of humanity in Gone to Gaia, a sprawling cooperative roguelite campaign for 1 or 2 players.

name: UPRISING | LEGENDARY BIG BOX & TRUE SOLO MODE
creator: NemesisGames
description: The epic 4X co-op returns - now with a True Solo Mode & the Legendary Big Box!

name: Escape the Dark Castle (2nd Edition) & Escape the Dark Forest
creator: Themeborne
description: Second Edition of the cult classic, plus a new standalone game joins this multi-award-winning series.

name: AracKhan Wars: The Song of Destiny (S1E2)
creator: Nothing But Games
description: Lead a faction and its hero represented by a deck of 23 cards. Outsmart your opponents throughout epic adventures on the battlefields. AracKhan Wars delivers strong & varied game experiences to 2, 3 or 4 players, thanks to its unique & easy-to-learn system based on bluffing, card placement & interactions and deck-construction.

name: Goddess: the Convergence TCG - 1st Expansion - DEMONIA
creator: 4Play
description: The hottest Goddess universe and collectible card game is back with its 1st expansion: Demonia.

name: Raas: A Dance of Love
creator: Arcane Wonders
description: Step into Raas: A Dance of Love, where color, rhythm, and tradition come to life in this new game from Arcane Wonders, designers Mihir Shah & Shaleen Harlalka and part of the Dice Tower Essentials line!

name: PRIMAL HEX
creator: Smart Flamingo
description: In a land where ancient tribes fought for survival against hunger, frost, and vengeful gods, only the strongest could claim the fertile paradise. Join the epic battle and prove your worth to thrive in this unforgiving world.

name: Cretaceous Rails Reprint and Cretaceous Seas Expansion
creator: Spielcraft Games
description:
Travel back in time to the Cretaceous era, build a rail network into the jungle, take time-traveling tourists on safari to see their favorite dinosaurs in the wild, and build a resort full of attractions to customize your strategy with exciting abilities.

Cretaceous Rails features an innovative dual-action worker placement system, route building, tableau building, and resource management. Utilize the resources of the Cretaceous jungle to build the optimal combination of attractions for abilities and scoring.

name: Totenstadt - Schöne neue Welt
creator: Blood 'n Brain
description: Totenstadt ist ein kooperatives Horror Hack & Slay Kartenspiel für 1 - 6 Spieler!

name: Netherwatch
creator: mjdesigns
description: A cooperative horror deduction board game with escalating supernatural tension.

name: hexploreit - Store
creator: mjdesigns
description: Welcome to the HEXplore It store, your gateway to all things HEXplore It! Here, you'll find our modular adventure games, expansions, accessories, and more to enhance your journey into the HEXplore It system.

name: Dark Rituals: Veins of Neemoss
creator: Maki Games
description:
Dark Rituals: Malleus Maleficarum is best played as an asymmetric “One vs Many” game for 2 to 5 players but it also includes a solo mode (the Witch Master battling game-controlled Heroes). A small band of Heroes defends villagers from a coven of Witches. One player, the Witch Master, controls the Legion of Darkness. With two players, the second player plays the Heroes in a strictly competitive game and up to three more players may join in, each taking a Hero to fight the Witch Master cooperatively. A solo mode is also available.
This campaign is meant to fund the second print for this game, which is also going to be the last chance to get the game before the molds become unusable.

name: Rook & Ruin
creator: FlorianFiedler
description: Can you outwit a dungeon that thinks like a grandmaster? Enter a labyrinth of crumbling halls and rogue chess pieces, where every single move could be your last. In this purely solo Print & Play adventure, you don't just play a hero—you embody the legendary style of a chess grandmaster, each with their own unique starting moves and a brilliancy ability.

name: Captain's Log New Horizons
creator: PIF Games
description: Captain's Log: New Horizons brings two exciting expansions. China and Portugal delves into colonial history with new upgrades and roles, while Myths and Legends adds fantasy to the game with mythical creatures and actions full of unexpected consequences. A historical and fantastical adventure awaits you!

name: Imperial Twing: Dragons and Languages
creator: Imperial Games GmbH
description:
Imperial Twing is an exciting 2-4 Player fantasy themed, strategic-tactical card and dice game. Cast spells, recruit creatures and battle your opponents for powerful Magical objects, on your way to victory. 

Unleash powerful Dragons on your opponents using bribery or by recruiting Dragon Riders, with the new Dragon's Demand expansion.

English and German versions are already included in the base game set. This campaign adds key cards in French and Spanish for both the base game and the Dragon's Demand expansion.

name: The Elder Scrolls: Heroes of Tamriel
creator: Chip Theory Games
description: Five new expansions (and more surprises!) for the critically acclaimed The Elder Scrolls: Betrayal of the Second Era!

name: Pink Soup Game
creator: Kraken Tales
description:
Pink Soup Game – a crazy cooking battle for parties and family time!
Dive into kitchen chaos with 2–5 players. Gather ingredients, cook the strangest Lithuanian recipes, and outsmart rival chefs. But beware – your opponents might slip a chili pepper into your pot!

A fast, hilarious card game full of sabotage, laughter, and delicious competition – perfect for friends and families alike.

name: The Wandmaker's Apprentice: Asymmetrical 2-Player Game
creator: SweaterBear Games
description: Craft genuine wands as the Wandmaker, or refine the art of persuasion as the Apprentice in this 2-player game of Master vs. Apprentice.

name: Moonlight Brewers Triple Fermentation
creator: Yeast Games
description: Monks brewing fantastic beer and hunting it's secret ingredient... non-cooperatives were-animals.

name: Era of Atlantis
creator: Channing Jones (Seajay Games)
description: A unique area-control board game with overlapping partnerships set in the antediluvian age.

name: Hellbringer: Bestiary & Forbidden Spells
creator: Maxime Gauthier
description:
Hellbringer is a SOLO/CO-OP Dark Fantasy card and dice game where you play as a hero venturing into the darkness of a dungeon to slay its mighty demon.

You will be able to get your copy of the core game, first and second expansions with the new and third expansion!

Late Pledge will begin November 15th.

Language available:
English 🇺🇸, Français 🇫🇷, Deutsch 🇩🇪, Español 🇪🇸, Polski 🇵🇱

name: The Monarchs of Lithuania — Late Pledge
creator: MonarchsLT
description: A stunning deck of illustrated playing cards honoring the rulers who shaped Lithuania’s rise from forest tribes to a medieval empire

name: Cat Packs: Purrstock Festival
creator: All Or None Games
description: Take your cats to Purrstock Festival for new experiences and groovy tunes!

name: Arcanite - A Strategic Battle Card Game
creator: Tobias Richter
description: ARCANITE is a strategic physical card game where magic and strategy collide. Harness the power of Arcanites, craft your deck, and turn the tide of battle with innovative Life Decking and Void mechanics that keep every game fresh and exciting. Join the journey and master the art of ARCANITE!

name: Khromanima - Deck-Building Game
creator: HatHouseStudios
description: Fusion, strategy, and combat in a Super Sentai-style deck-building game.

name: BattleForge: Berserker
creator: Creative Games Studio
description: The roar of Fenrir echoes through the Nine Realms. You awaken in Valhalla, not in search of glory, but vengeance. The fate of the world rests in your hands: rally your allies, face iron-born gods and biomechanical monstrosities, and unleash your fury to set Ragnarök back on course. Join the battle. Forge the legend.

name: The Gilded Realms: International Print & Expansion
creator: Sandtime
description:
Forge your empire in this captivating Euro-style kingdom builder for 1–4 players. The Gilded Realms: International Print is the second-wave release, now available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, and Polish.

Play as two new factions and stand against the relentless Sarrukar in the all-new cooperative expansion. Rule wisely, defend the wall, and rise as the Serpens Champion!

name: Detectives Vs Criminals
creator: Dam Things
description:
Join the Criminals or the Detectives and travel across early 1900s Europe, chasing priceless treasures to steal… or to protect.
The Sherlock Holmes and Dracula expansions add legendary characters and brand-new game modes, making every match even more unique and thrilling.

name: Dogs of War
creator: Play to Z
description: A shattered realm. Six feuding Houses. You, a Dog of War, shift battles, forge betrayals, and seize glory to rise as the ultimate victor.

name: TEKKEN - The Board Game
creator: Go On Board
description: A fighting tabletop game that brings the dynamic, tactical experience of the TEKKEN series to your table. Step into the fight as one of the iconic characters, strategize on various stages, and claim victory in THE KING OF IRON FIST TOURNAMENT.

name: TITAN ZERO
creator: King Racoon
description: Fight huge Kaijus from outer space to protect earth in this innovative co-op/solo campaign boss battle game for 1-4 players.

name: Ascendancy Underworld
creator: OneMoreTurnGames
description: The Mega Edition of The Ultimate 4x Inspired Worker Placement Board Game

name: Blood Rage: Valhalla
creator: Tycoon Games
description: Blood Rage: Valhalla is a standalone sequel to 2015's Blood Rage. Designed by Eric Lang, players will rage beyond Ragnarök and battle to earn the Gods' favor.

name: No More Dead: New York
creator: Pendragon Game Studio srl
description: The fate of New York is in your hands. Will you ensure your community's survival, find a cure, or succumb to the chaos?

name: Mobile Arms - Mecha Wargaming in the Worlds of Tomorrow
creator: Black Site Studios
description: Pilot advanced Frametech in a 32mm scale tabletop wargame of tactical battles, deep customization, and cinematic action. Every mission is a fight for control in a war-torn future in the Worlds of Tomorrow.

name: EcoLogic expansion (rare species and nocturnal animals) + base game reprint
creator: EcoLogic
description: EcoLogic is a beautiful logical game whose mechanics were created to show the relationships between plants, fungi, and animals. Players create complex ecosystems using cards representing hundreds of living organisms from different habitats. The expansion adds over 180 species cards (mostly rare animals and plants) and a new nocturnal animal mechanics.

name: Cysmic
creator: Star Reach Games
description:
Cysmic is a dynamic tactical sci-fi board game for up to 6 players (with expansion) set on the crumbling surface of a distant planet.

Assume the role of a faction leader destined to become a Colony Ship Commander. Use cunning, tactics, and strategy to ultimately build your massive 7-piece colony ship.

Pledge now to be the first to launch your colony ship and win!

name: Machina Arcana ~ Vivarium
creator: Adreama Games
description: A cooperative tactical horror adventure for 1-4 players, where survival is never guaranteed. Explore dreadful halls, face unspeakable horrors, and unravel chilling stories..only to discover that true terror lies beyond your darkest expectations.

name: Goats and Goblins
creator: B A Games
description:
Goats & Goblins is a push your luck game where you attempt to collect treasures, goats, and goblins from the mysterious cave before it collapses. You take turns leading expeditions below the surface, inviting other players to join you or stay behind.

Goats & Goblins - a quick, fun game of greedy goblins 2-6 player card game of discovering lost goats and treasures as you search an unstable cave, get too greedy and you may lose it all!

name: Buckanjär
creator: Buckanjär
description:
Ahoy, Pirates! Embark on an epic adventure with Buckanjär – A pirate strategy boardgame!

Prepare to set sail on an unforgettable adventure! In Buckanjär, players take on the role of a pirate, merchant, or naval fleet, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and goals. The seas are yours to explore, and the choices you make will shape your journey. Every game is different, making each playthrough a fresh, thrilling experience.

name: Bonnie and Clyde, a Roadmap Through History
creator: Yeast Games
description: Relive the duo's final journey and shape their fate on a detailed, story-driven historical map.

name: Black Rose Wars - Revised Edition
creator: Ludus Magnus Studio
description: The Black Rose is coming back! Get the Revised Edition of one of the most exciting card games of the last years, with updated spells and components!

name: RoboMon | The Tabletop Adventure!
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: RoboMon is an exploration-focused, story-driven, open-world game of robot combat for 1-2 players.

name: Brushstroke Mayhem
creator: Physical Mind
description: Brushstroke Mayhem is a vibrant 2-5 player set-collection card game where art meets strategy. With three levels of play, it offers a smooth entry for casual players and exciting challenges for those who love competition. Create abstract compositions and outmaneuver your opponents in this fast-paced, colorful showdown!

name: Armed Conflict
creator: Bockholm Games
description:
Armed Conflict is a wargame for 2–6 players that lets you command military units of different types and sizes in a conflict between two alliances: the Lions and the Eagles.

The game is based on modern warfare, loosely set in a post-WWII world, but not tied to any specific historical event or location. It simulates warfare in a credible way without adding unnecessary complexity, making it suitable for both casual board gamers and seasoned wargamers.

name: Singularity.exe
creator: Octothorpe
description: Welcome to a vibrant, digital universe where humans have abandoned physical reality and fight for control of a legendary program called the Singularity. Singularity.exe is a deterministic card game that empowers endless creativity with absolutely no randomness.

name: ANTgravity
creator: Lucrum Studio
description: In space no one can hear... ants fighting! Do you remember the classic video games about teams of funny creatures battling? Now they are ants, and they are in space! And they use hilariously deadly weapons in a clash where no Earth’s gravity rules have power! In ANTgravity, you will move your ants, jump on asteroids, try to capture flags and bring them safely to your base.

name: Catharsis: Holidays - Christmas and Easter - Board Game
creator: Cyber Wizard Games
description: The Ice Elves beseech mortals to aid in defeating a lich, crafted by a deranged wizard in ancient times known as Santa to spread joy.

name: Historica Arcanum: Cults of London
creator: Metis Creative
description: Historica Arcanum: Cults of London is a cut-throat strategy game where players take control of occult cabals vying for the control of Victorian Era London. Conduct Rituals, Slay Eldritch Horrors, and Plot Assassinations!

name: Echoes of the Sundering
creator: The Wilderforge
description:
A 1-5 player, cooperative, open-world, deck-construction adventure. Create a party of heroes, and explore a beautifully illustrated Map Book over a 40-hour campaign. 

Along the way, you will face dynamic, narrative-driven encounters, grow in power, and gain new abilities and items to complement your play style. 

The story reacts to players' decisions, and no two playthroughs will be the same.

name: Light in the Dark + Fires of Thokaia Expansion
creator: Archona Games
description:
Step into the mask of a brave plague doctor in this solo dungeon crawler. Battle monstrous foes, heal the sick, and complete perilous quests to restore hope to a plague-ridden land. Darkness awaits - will you be the light?

The flames of Thokaia burn bright and deadly. This expansion adds new quests, enemies, and abilities as you travel to a region threatened by a dark cult and rising chaos. Can you withstand the heat?

name: POLAND'39
creator: Trafalgar Editions
description:
La campaña de Polonia en 1939. Operación Fall Weiss
The campaign in Poland 1939, Operation Fall Weiss

name: Italia 1497 : Le jeu de plateau historique
creator: DTDA Games
description:
Italia 1497 est un jeu de stratégie, mais pas seulement : c’est une véritable porte d’entrée vers le XVIe siècle. J'ai fait de mon mieux pour vous faire revivre cette époque pendant votre partie !

Au travers de l'univers, des scénarios et des évènements, vous pourrez explorer les guerres d'Italie et leurs enjeux, mais aussi toutes les grandes tendances du siècle : la Réforme, les Grandes Découvertes, les barbaresques, etc...

name: Temple of Horrors: Divine Favor
creator: giochix
description: The first expansion for Temple of Horrors is here: new bosses to fight, new miniatures and standees, new difficulty modulation, and much more!

name: Star Realms Conquest
creator: Wise Wizard Games
description:
Conquest is a new stand-alone expansion for the incredibly popular, award-winning Star Realms Digital Deckbuilding Game. Perfect for new players and veterans alike, Conquest features new “Planet” cards that give you bonuses when you conquer them from the trade row using combat.  
This campaign also has five new Legendary Commanders, new expansion packs, and TONS of awesome Promo Cards!

name: UNDERTREEGAMES - Store
creator: UNDERTREEGAMES
description: Mad Match-Up is to be the first player to rid yourself of all your cards. This might sound straightforward, but the game’s design introduces a dynamic and engaging challenge through its strategic depth and varied components. The game is played over multiple rounds with escalating difficulty as more Location Cards are added to the board.

name: SSO: Travellers
creator: Man O Kent Games
description: SSO is a card driven game of co-ordination, planning and action management in a world of brutal sci-fi survival.  It will place from one to six players into a narrative driven world of tension and desperation telling stories of knife-edge escapes pulled from sources ranging from 2001: A Space Odyssey to Star Trek: The Wrath of Khan.

name: Agricola Special Edition
creator: Awaken Realms
description: Brings the farming classic to life with new art, refined usability, and expansions.

name: There was a Scout... Dual Edition PNP
creator: Mirage Maps
description: Scoutmasters weave chilling tales by the campfire. Print and play party and casual clean version. It's Story Time!

name: Roblins!
