creator: Ludus Magnus Studio
description: Black Rose Wars: Rebirth is a competitive fantasy game of deck-building, strategy, and combat set in the hectic universe of Nova Aetas in Italy, for 1-6 players. Each player is one of the powerful mages of the Black Rose Order, who aspires to become the new Great Magister, in order to acquire the mighty power of the Black Rose Artifact and the Forgotten Magic.

name: Spirit Fire
creator: Orange Nebula
description: A non-linear, open-world game system in which you explore unique fantasy realms on an introspective journey of discovery, wonder, and mystery. Your choices matter because you're not following a story, you ARE the story. Great solo, but playable alongside others as well.

name: Hidden Ark: Deep Sea Expedition Expansion
creator: All Or None Games
description: Explore the ocean depths with new opportunities to help deep sea species!

name: U-BOOT: The Board Game - Collector's Edition
creator: PHALANX
description: U-BOOT: The Board Game, the legendary game of WW2 submarine warfare.

name: SIGIL
creator: Pine Island Games
description:
Sigil is the two player abstract strategy dueling game preferred by archmages everywhere. Take turns placing stones to surround your opponent's pieces. Claim control of any of nine random spells to cast them for powerful effects. 

Do you have what it takes to control the Sigil?

name: Colonial 1700-1800
creator: Juegos_Mosquete
description: Colonial 1700-1800 is a strategic game for 1 to 5 players that recreates the clash between European powers to preserve and increase their colonial empires during the 18th century.

name: Fall of Lumen
creator: Twoidgames
description: The Keepers are back to overthrow Lumen. A deck-building and area movement tabletop game set in the lands of Legends of Void.

name: Secrets of the Lost Tomb - Epic Remastered Edition - 10 Year Anniversary
creator: Everything Epic
description: After Ten long years, Secrets of the Lost Tomb is back in an all new Remastered Epic Edition! This Epic Cooperative game is the ultimate thematic game similar to games like Mansions of Madness meets Betrayal at House on the Hill, with thematic inspirations from the worlds of H.P. Lovecraft, and of course Indiana Jones!

name: Aethermon: Collect
creator: Aethermon Studios
description: Join Rika, Haru, BEB0, and Followoof on a set-collecting adventure with ‘Aethermon: Collect’. This easy-to-learn and fast-paced game features both competitive and co-operative modes, making it a perfect fit for any gaming group. Behind every card, players will uncover the mysteries and rich lore of the 48 beautifully-illustrated Aethermon. The World of Aethermon awaits you!

name: Aeon Trespass: Odyssey Second Printing and Twelve Sins of Herakles
creator: Into the Unknown Studio
description: Aeon Trespass is an epic narrative campaign game with a compelling, mature story, full of heart-wrenching choices and devastating consequences. It's a game of adventure, exploration, civilization building and boss battles with giant monsters It's a fully cooperative experience played over multiple sessions. Each core game offers 3 distinct campaigns with over 300 hours of worth of unique, ever-evolving content. Aeon Trespass: Odyssey Core Game is almost sold out. Aeon Trespass: Twelve Sins of Herakles arrives soon!

name: Betwixt and Between: The Faery Queen's Whim
creator: All Or None Games
description: The final expansion for Betwixt and Between and a last chance to get this unique adventure board game based upon European folklore!

name: Tales of Evil Final Chapter
creator: Escape Studios Games
description: Tales of Evil Final Chapter is the adventure that will lead us to the final showdown against the Demon-Puppet-Mistress!

name: Loam
creator: Cardboard Revolution
description: Loam is a set-matching strategy game about building healthy soils. You are a plant, who for obvious reasons is into that sort of thing. You also have a lot more power and agency over your environment than humans often give you credit for. Sculpt the soil’s weird and wonderful biodiversity to assemble vibrant ecological communities and build the healthiest soil of all!

name: Tolerance
creator: Dragon Dawn Productions
description: Tolerance is an asymmetric set collection game with variable player goals and a deeply embedded theme. Three to five players engage in the conflict between Protestants and Catholics in 16th Century England. Tolerance uses a trick-taking mechanic, where the winner of each trick must perform the played cards' actions, whether beneficial or not.

name: 3KSES
creator: BOHEMIARIS
description: With Trikses, written shortly as 3KSES, you are getting a lot of fun for two to six players, set of three exciting and battery-free games. Players train their minds, learn about famous world locations, and enjoy playing the game at the same time. The game can be played on any flat surface, does not need a game board. It's compact size allows you to play anywhere, even on a train, during a lunch break in the office, in a tent while camping or at a small table in a pub. The rules are short and quick to learn.

name: Intergalactic Ace
creator: Art of Steel
description: In the simple, strategy/chance game, Intergalactic Ace, players compete to be the first to shoot down 5 enemy ships.  Upgrade your ship to prepare for battle, take your chances in dogfights against enemy cards, and go head-to-head with other players to steal their hard-earned kills.  Each game comes with 6 beautiful laser-cut wooden spaceships to keep track of each players stats and Kill count.

name: StarCraft: Tabletop Miniatures Game Pre-order
creator: Archon Studio
description: Bring the legendary RTS to your table with fast, tactical gameplay and stunning new miniatures.

name: Dune: War for Arrakis - Desert War
creator: CMON
description: Bring new forces to your side of the struggle between Atreides and Harkonnen with the new Desert War expansion. And don't miss out on a last chance to pick up the crowdfunding exclusive content from the original campaign!

name: The Dead Keep
creator: CMON
description: Embark on an adventure with The Dead Keep, a cooperative dungeon diving campaign game designed for 1-6 players. Immerse yourself in the fantastical artwork, crafted from the original designs of renowned artist Paul Bonner.

name: Super Fantasy Brawl: Reborn
creator: CMON
description: Super Fantasy Brawl is REBORN into an all-new edition! Dive into the fast-paced, competitive miniatures board game where players draft a team of three unique Champions and combine their powerful action cards for ultimate synergy. Outsmart opponents with clever tactics and bold strategies in thrilling arena battles. Easy to learn, hard to master — victory awaits in the reborn fantasy showdown!

name: 6: Siege - The Board Game Pre-order | Steamforged
creator: Steamforged Games
description: Experience the intense, tactical action of the acclaimed 6: Siege board game in this Gamefound exclusive reprint, including two brand new expansions

name: Final Girl Summer Releases!
creator: Van Ryder Games
description:
New products are coming for Final Girl this summer! Guarantee you get yours by preordering. 
NOTE! Some products in this project will release at GEN CON first.

name: Marvel United: Witching Hour
creator: CMON
description: Witching Hour is a special character pack that not only adds two new characters to Marvel United: Agatha Harkness as an Anti-Hero and Scarlet Witch, for the first time as a solo Villain, but also includes the four alternate Heroes that were previously available mainly at conventions: Grey Hulk, Juggernaut, Mister Sinister, and Deadpool (X-Force).

name: Anastyr Chronicles
creator: Don't Panic Games
description: Anastyr Chronicles is a cooperative board game for 1 to 4 players that blends the fast-paced action of classic beat ’em ups with an epic dark fantasy adventure.

name: The Adventurers
creator: CMON
description: Return to the Temple of Chac and Pyramid of Horus with updated gameplay, or explore the latest and an all-new expedition for the series: the Tomb of the Pirate Queen! Three standalone adventures unified by a single cross-compatible system. Navigate deadly traps, collapsing ruins, and rival adventurers as you race to escape with priceless artifacts.

name: Chicago 1875: City of the Big Shoulders
creator: Quined Games
description: Chicago 1875: City of the Big Shoulders is finally back with popular demand. this critically-acclaimed board game combines 18xx-style stock manipulation with Euro-style gameplay. Set in the aftermath of the Great Chicago Fire of 1871, players assume the roles of entrepreneurs and investors striving to rebuild Chicago into an economic powerhouse. Over five decades, players will manage companies, trade shares, hire employees, produce goods, and navigate the bustling marketplace. With strategic depth and a focus on economic growth, City of the Big Shoulders offers a rich, immersive experience in a shorter playtime compared to traditional heavy economic games.

name: Black Rose Wars: Duel - Void
creator: Ludus Magnus Studio
description:
A new adventure in the world of Black Rose Wars!
In the dark rooms of an eldritch building, challenge your opponent and acquire new powers from the Great Old Ones! Play fast and exciting two-player mage fights: choose spells from a common deck, plan actions, manage evocations and resources, to achieve the ultimate victory!

name: Marvel Multiverse RPG - Deluxe Starter Set
creator: CMON
description: This Starter Set is the best way to discover the Marvel Multiverse Role-Playing Game. It contains everything you need to dive into the game and experience the thrilling lives of Super Heroes firsthand!

name: Detective: Heists and Heartbreak
creator: Van Ryder Games
description:
This is a preorder for the all-new expansion for Detective: City of Angels... Detective: Heists and Heartbreak.

Detective: City of Angels is an epic narrative-driven mystery-solving board game set in the dark and violent world of 1940's Los Angeles. Most players will step into the shoes of LAPD Homicide detectives that will do whatever it takes to solve the case, but one player will take on the role of The Chisel whose goal is to stall and misdirect the detectives at every turn.

name: A Wild Venture
creator: PIKA Games
description: A fast-paced, strategic 2-player game where you don’t just build engines… you dismantle them too! With 108 unique cards, a double-sided adventuring board, and two themed sets for endless variety, no two games feel the same. It’s strategic. It’s deep. It’s delightfully wild!

name: Evil Dead 2 1%
creator: Iconiq Studios
description: From the cult horror movie Evil Dead 2 comes a new groovy take on 1%!

name: Push Push Penguin & More Wacky Wizard Games
creator: Wise Wizard Games
description:
Award winning Party, Family, and Kids fun from Wacky Wizard Games!
Select from Push Push Penguin, Caution Signs, Star Realms Academy, and Pack the Essentials.
No long wait: these games are finished, in our warehouse, and ready to ship to you NOW!

name: Wilderness - A Game of Survival (2nd Edition)
creator: FryxGames
description: In Wilderness, players drift ashore on an island after a horrible shipwreck, and need to find their way through deep jungles and over high mountains to reach the civilization and survive. They need to avoid wild animals and sicknesses, while managing their thirst, hunger, and exhaustion. The first one to reach the village - or the last survivor - has won over the Wilderness.

name: PANDORA CELESTE: Pirates & Salvage
creator: Guntower Games
description: PANDORA CELESTE: PIRATES & SALVAGE takes the winning formula of Action Cards, Agendas and Emergency Protocols that made the original so much fun and adds yet another chaotic twist as an anarchic team of Pirates board the Ship to pursue their own Missions in this expansion to Pandora Celeste.

name: LONG DARK SEA
creator: DELUSIO GAMES
description: Long Dark Sea is a cooperative adventure card game for 1-4 players focused on exploration and combat where deckbuilding and resource management are their main mechanics. Venture into the unknown with your pirate crew in search of ancient relics in a Sci-fi universe.

name: Colleagues
creator: Creardo
description:
Welcome to the office. Your real job is to avoid it. 
Play cards, drink coffee, fake sick days. 
Slack off just enough… without getting caught.

name: The Glasgow Train Robbery
creator: SaltandPepper
description: The Glasgow Train Robber is a cooperative game for 2 players, inspired by one of the most infamous crimes in British history. Set in 1960s Scotland, you and your partner take on the roles of two key members of a criminal crew determined to intercept and rob a high-value train—without getting caught.

name: Dicequest
creator: Skytear Games
description: Gather your party for an epic quest! Hire heroes, unlock powerful abilities, and use clever combos to bend the dice to your will. Play competitive or cooperative in games for 1–4 players, 45 minutes, ages 10+. Join the adventure today for just three easy monthly installments of $12!

name: 1809: Talavera
creator: Tactical Workshop
description: "1809: Talavera" is the second volume in the"Fix Bayonets!" series of Napoleonic tactical wargames. It covers, at the battalion level, the two days of the battle with one player in charge of the Anglo-Spanish armies and the other leading the French forces. It can be played solo, playing both sides.

name: WordWeaver Adventures
creator: jbirdgames
description: WordWeaver Adventures is a family friendly, co-op word building game where adventurers travel to beautifully depicted regions around the world. In each of these regions, they will be challenged by teachers to channel their energy through spelling words. Meet the goal and move to the next challenge with the teacher's praise. Fail and the teacher will make things more difficult. WordWeaver Adventures is highly modular and difficulty of play can be scaled to accommodate a wide variety of play groups and styles. A playthrough can be a breezy 15 minutes or a strategic 60+ minutes. Adventure awaits!

name: Final Girl Series 4
creator: Van Ryder Games
description: Final Girl is back with Series 4! Tons of new content awaits you in this critically acclaimed solo game.

name: Teburu Dungeon: Sword & Sorcery
creator: Teburu
description:
Teburu Dungeon: Sword & Sorcery is an adaptation of the beloved fantasy game for the Teburu System.
This coop dungeon crawler for 1-5 players features the return of the original cast of Immortal Souls' characters in a brand new campaign, tailored for the Teburu system.

name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Palermo Conspiracies
creator: Teburu
description: Vampire: The Masquerade - Palermo Conspiracies is a narrative-driven semi-cooperative game for 1-4 players set in the World of Darkness, exclusive for the Teburu System. Take the role of Camarilla Archons in this standalone module in the Teburu VTM collection.

name: Labyrinth Chronicles
creator: Awaken Realms
description: New take on the all-time classic. Explore the 3D Labyrinth, and help the villagers!

name: Jano - A Pawsome Adventure
creator: aszaki
description: Jano is a heartwarming, nature-themed board game where players join a curious Hungarian Vizsla on an enchanting journey through farms, forests, and lakesides. By collecting resources, forming friendships with animals, gathering flowers, and completing secret missions, players earn victory points and create their own unique adventure. The player who embraces nature and friendship most skillfully becomes the happiest explorer of all!

name: Cassette Crush
creator: Talon Strikes Studios
description: Mix Genres, Match Tempos, and Capture Hearts in this Nostalgic Engine-Building Card Game for 1-4 players. LATE PLEDGES OPEN NOW!

name: THE LAST IN THE WOODS
creator: Blackthorn
description: A competitive card game about surviving in the forest, where each day brings a new challenge. So... can you be the last one in the woods?

name: Mercurial: Alchemia
creator: Hyperlixir
description: Cultivate flora & brew elixirs in this new stand-alone game with deck-building & worker placement for 1-4 alchemists!

name: Blood Economy [A Solo Vampire Card Game]
creator: MoD Games
description:
Manage thralls for abilities or devour them for blood.
36 cards. 5 vampires. 30 scenarios. 20 minutes of strategic decisions.

name: Andromeda's Edge: Genesis
creator: Cardboard Alchemy
description: Brace yourself, Andromeda’s Edge: Genesis is approaching and it brings forth change in the galaxy! As you battle new raiders, discover uncharted regions and command unique factions, do you have what it takes to thrive at the Edge?

name: Mage Noir - Black & Gold Edition
creator: Double Combo Games
description: All 3 Seasons of Mage Noir in an exclusive Black & Gold limited edition

name: Gamusinos Board Game
creator: Croqueta Games
description: Gamusinos: strategic, fun and oh-so-cute. A filler that mixes drafting and hidden roles.

name: Rolling in Wonderland
creator: Bellows Intent
description: 😼 Enlist Alice’s companions, 🍄 manage mushrooms and 🔮 reshape Wonderland in this 🎲 dice-drafting game for 1-5 players.

name: Lost Games 2025
creator: Carlos Michán
description:
Discover Lost Games new games of 2025.

Wishland: The card game, Medieval Realms: The card game and Dreamwood.

name: Drawing Dead [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: After meeting an untimely end in a saloon poker game turned deadly, you awake in Purgatory. Imbued with new powers, and a set of poker cards made from your very soul, you must play your way through the three gates of Purgatory and into the afterlife.

name: Night Race
creator: RPG Board Game
description:
Night Race – Dive into the blazing world of nighttime street racing!

In this fast-paced, strategic card game for 2 to 6 players, be the first to win 10 races by combining your cards, launching bold challenges… or stealing victory from your opponents. But beware of the police — they can bring everything crashing down!

Easy to pick up from age 7 and up, Night Race delivers 20 to 25-minute games full of tension, tactics, and thrilling twists.

Start the race. Outsmart your rivals. Own the night.

name: NEXUS: Alone In Your Room Expansion
creator: D-Verse Publishing, LLC
description: It’s the ultimate solo arena combat experience that keeps you coming back for more, providing satisfaction that’s hard to beat.

name: Jack: Shadows in the Fog
creator: The Old Paper Tigers
description:
Jack: Shadows in the Fog is a solo maze-themed, print-and-play, roll-and-write game.

Button your detective coat tight and explore the gaslit streets of Victorian London. Follow the Clues to track down the fearsome Jack the Ripper and stop him before he strikes again. Collect Trinkets to aid in your investigation, catch the Criminals who stand in your way, and act quickly: every second counts, and the fate of the city is in your hands!

name: Nexus Card Game
creator: Redzen Games
description: Nexus is a fast paced 1vs1 card game set in an epic fantasy world where powerful factions fight to survive the cataclysm. You must combine two unique factions, develop your own strategies, and destroy the rival nexus to claim victory.

name: Christmas Union
creator: Playful Anarchy (Fagner Lima)
description: Christmas time is coming and as ALWAYS Santa Claus takes all the credits for your hard work. It’s time for the elves to organize themselves for better working conditions. Let’s unionize!

name: Mission: Drive [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Race through crowded streets as an elite spy, taking down enemy agents without crashing, harming civilians, or running out of time. Gain upgrades, face the final boss, and escape in style!

name: Boaromia Festival
creator: Tureluurs Games
description:
Welcome to Boaromia, the cooperative festival game full of amazing acts and questionable choices! |
NL: Nederlandse versie beschikbaar | EN: English version available

name: Behind the Trenches
creator: behindthetrenches
description: WW1--Resource Management--Deck Builder.

name: Story of Many
creator: Haunted Mill Games
description:
Story of Many is a cooperative fantasy adventure board game for 1-4 players .
With over 400,000 words of adventure text, and limitless possibilities for creating and advancing your own character, brave a world filled with profound lore and hard choices.

              CREATE YOUR HERO. EXPLORE THE LAND. CHOOSE WISELY.

name: The Great Library by Vital Lacerda with Art by Ian O'Toole
creator: Eagle-Gryphon Games
description: As players step into the sandals of Librarians in the Great Library, you take on the crucial responsibilities of leading the institution within the Mouseion, navigating the challenges and opportunities presented by this legendary center of knowledge. Amidst the relics, diverse minds, and bustling port activity, the Librarians became the primary custodians of knowledge, shaping the legacy of the Great Library and contributing to the rich tapestry of ancient history.

name: Queen of Spies
creator: SaltandPepper
description: Queen of Spies is a solo, story-driven board game of espionage and daring missions set in occupied Belgium during the First World War.

name: Micro Pirates
creator: Thistroy Games
description: Complete quests, plunder ships and hunt treasures to become a legend of the high seas!

name: Das Schwarze Auge - Kirchen Alverans
creator: Ulisses Spiele
description:
Mit diesem Crowdfunding widmen wir uns den Kirchen der Zwölfgötter. Wie ist die Rondrakirche aufgebaut? Welche Hierarchien herrschen unter den Anhängern Hesindes? Wo liegen die wichtigsten Tempelbauten der Boronkirche? Das und noch viel mehr wird in dem Band "Kirchen Alverans" enthalten sein.
Doch dabei wird es nicht bleiben - mit Mysterienband, Abenteuer-Anthologien und weiteren Büchern wird dieses Crowdfunding noch viel mehr bieten.

name: Brandywine 1777 - A Time for Heroes
creator: Les 3 Zouaves
description:
When American History Already Spoke French…

Imagine: The Continental and British armies face off, the river in the background, and a daring manoeuvre that could change the course of war…
Do you have what it takes to be a commander? Are you an astute tactician?  It is time to face a formidable opponent in Brandywine, 1777: A Time for Heroes!

name: Button Shy Reprint Campaign - Late 2025
creator: Button Shy Games
description: Reprinting some out of print games and bringing back old favorites. Additional games added via backer votes.

name: Byzantion
creator: Meeple Pug
description: Byzantion is a competitive, event-driven board game where players lead powerful factions to shape the fate of the Byzantine Empire through political intrigue, careful planning, and dynamic engine building.

name: Staked! - The Next Evolution in Social Deduction
creator: Will deManbey
description:
In the depths of Victorian Europe, a chilling presence looms — vampires are on the prowl! 

In Staked!, you and up to 9 friends play as members of a legendary vampire hunter's guild, forming the last line of defense against an encroaching undead menace. But as the night creeps on, you must determine which of your fellow guild members can be trusted, and which are secretly vampires in disguise!

name: SIRENS: The Deep Sea
creator: Forgotten Tales
description: A full coop adventure and exploration board game. Explore the deep sea, collect resource, construct buildings, build supply chains, develop your Sirens and fight against different cultures, monsters and bosses. Choose between scenarios and freemode.

name: Donning the Sacred Heart, Limits of Glory campaign V
creator: Form Square Games
description: This is a standalone game using the Limits of Glory system to examine the impact of events on the Civil War in the Vendée in 1793. Will you fight for the Republic or fight for God and the King with the Catholic and Royal Army? Take the side of the Blue or the White.

name: All Time Wrestling - Women's Edition
creator: Cation Arts
description: An expansion to the critically acclaimed game All Time Wrestling featuring 9 Women Wrestlers, a new solo campaign and new match modes!

name: Ikusa 40th Anniversary Edition
creator: Renegade Game Studios
description: This 40th Anniversary Edition of Ikusa Samurai Swords will transform a classic into a true collector’s piece. Upgraded components, striking new art, premium-quality pieces, and more. Available only through this campaign.

name: Time Troopers
creator: Molinarius Games Ltd
description: New solo deck management campaign. Build a squad to travel back in time to find artefacts needed to save humanities future. Battle armies of past civilizations and sneak into ancient monuments. Manage Time as a resource and make choices which define the future timeline in this immersive solo campaign game.

name: Exceed: Seventh Cross
creator: Level 99 Games
description: The legendary dueling card game from Level 99 Games, in its most epic season ever! Featuring echo fighters and a free gift for followers!

name: Movers & Shakers
creator: Quined Games
description: Compete as ambitious railway magnates in 19th-century Bengal, racing to transport goods, secure contracts, and outwit rivals on the booming rail network. Sharp planning and bold moves will decide who shapes the future of Bengal’s railways.

name: Super Team Tactical Football Board Game
creator: Roomiz Games
description: Control unique teams and captains, using powerful cards and strategic resource management in this fast-paced, tactical football game!

name: 7 Ages Collectors Edition
creator: Australian Design Group
description:
7 Ages® is Australian Design Group's ground-breaking game covering 6000 years of human history from 4000 bce to today. It plays 1-7 players and can run from 77 minutes to 20+ hours depending on how many ages your group decides to play. 

Will you be immortalised throughout history?

name: Immediate Murder Professionals: A Helluva Boss Official Game
creator: Creatist Games
description: Take control of your favorite Helluva Boss characters in this fast-paced, cutthroat game of soul-claiming interdimensional mayhem.

name: Dukes Of Nukes V2 - The Party Game Of Nuclear Thievery
creator: Falling Whale Games
description: The card game where 3-10 players fight for control of the Nuke Codes through trade and thievery. Just be the one player with the Nuke Codes card by the time the game suddenly ends and nuke your friends to be victorious!

name: DECKO
creator: GEM games
description: Poker meets deckbuilding in an intense race to create the strongest deck. Each player starts with a basic poker deck they will transform throughout the game by acquiring magical cards and powerful jokers. Raise, fold and call bets while building your deck to amass the most poker chips and claim victory!

name: Monster Warriors Firestorm
creator: BoldKeep
description: Monster Warriors is a competitive expandable card game that mashes the best elements of monster-taming and fighting games into one! Choose your monster handler and form the ultimate three-monster-team. Unleash your monster into a 1 vs 1 battle and experience the destructive mayhem!

name: Akuma Shielding Season 2
creator: Akuma Shielding
description:
Las mejores fundas Premium para cartas del mercado.

The best Premiun Sleeves in the market.

name: Northgard: Uncharted Horizons - Expansion
creator: Open Sesame Games
description: Expand your experience for the original viking 4X board game with new game modes (incl. solo play), new clans, new creatures… and more!

name: Rise of Myths: Cthulhu
creator: Synergic Games
description: Play a cooperative roguelite deck-building game in which you will improve your deck after each attempt, as you face the Great Old Ones and their minions, while they try to destroy your body and sanity.

name: Tabletop Inc: Crowdfunding Revolution
creator: Cotswold Games
description: In Tabletop Inc, you run a fledgling board game publishing company packed with quirky employees, exciting prototypes, and ruthless competition. Hire the right team, develop your games, and publish titles that capture the market and the most victory points. Now, with The Crowdfunding Revolution expansion, you can launch your games through crowdfunding campaigns for powerful bonuses and prestige. Invest in marketing, upgrade your staff with unique new abilities, and outsmart your rivals in a race to become the most successful publisher in the business. Packed with charm, strategy, and tongue-in-cheek humour, Tabletop Inc is a love letter to the board game industry and this expansion takes it to the next level.

name: Terrorscape 2
creator: Ice Makes
description: Terrorscape returns with a standalone chapter packed with new features.  Outwit, outplay, or strike back....whether you're the killer or the prey, be the protagonist of the horror movie!

name: Altered - Seeds of Unity
creator: Equinox
description: The most crowdfunded TCG in history returns with Seeds of Unity, a unique set that will never be reprinted, filled with exclusive cards and brand-new mechanics. Preorder, play, collect, and help us write the next chapter of the Altered adventure.

name: SCP The Boardgame: Confidential Crisis
creator: DigDeep_Gaming
description: Dive into an exhilarating boardgame crafted for 2-4 players, drawn from the SCP Foundation universe. Take command of your journey as you level up your security level and sharpen your character’s skills to against powerful SCPs.

name: Spiders The Game
creator: Surprisingly Fun Productions
description: Spiders - a card game from down under. This game's the ant's pants, a real ripper, whether you're a Brainiac or one stubby short of a six pack, you'll be stoked to play!!

name: King Arthur's Curse
creator: Amatilis
description:
Dark forces stir in King Arthur’s realm. Can you solve the puzzles, uncover the truth, and save the kingdom?

King Arthur's Curse is an escape game with maximum freedom and fun.

You can combine any cards, carve your own path, and choose your own ending. The puzzles are logical, the game mechanics are unique, and the stakes couldn't be higher!

name: Air Raid 36/46-Expansion: The Aces!
creator: Babek Amelizadeh
description: An expansion with elite pilots and 17+ new miniatures for our easy-to-learn WWII aircraft game.

name: Drag & Dusted
creator: Tiamat Studio
description: A game for 2-4 players. Choose your drag character, create your outfit and get ready to compete to be the only star to perform at Glitterati Palace. Boycott your rivals' looks and perform in front of your fans, influencers and celebrities to gain fame and win the game.

name: Berserk: The Board Game
creator: Monolith Board Games
description: The first official board game based on Kentaro Miura's iconic manga Berserk. In this cooperative game with miniatures, play as Guts and his companions as they battle their way through a very hostile world.

name: Storybook Saga [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Build a team of classic heroes to take on classic villains in this combo-building dice manipulation game!

name: SandCastle
creator: BRO GAMES EDITION
description:
It's holiday time! The beach is packed and the tourist office has decided to organise a sandcastle-building competition. Like any self-respecting child, you rush to sign up. The winner is the one who accumulates the most points by building the most beautiful castle.

Sand Castle is a strategic game for 2 to 4 players aged 10 and over.
Use your action points wisely, and watch out for the waves at the end of the round that could tip the contest.

name: Snorkeling
creator: Haumea Games
description: A fast, clever, and slightly cheeky card game where you dive deep… and make the others resurface!

name: Mystic Moon
creator: Unstable Games
description: A competitive game of potions and puzzles from the creators of Here to Slay and Casting Shadows!

name: Mojito Trio | Sinister Institute + Lords of Worlds + Tropicalia
creator: Mojito Studios
description: Mojito Trio brings together three exciting family games designed by renowned creators: Sinister Institute, Lords of Worlds, and Tropicalia.

name: Tatsumi
creator: Adams Apple Games
description: Resource drafting and tile placement is reimagined in this asymmetric 1-4 player board game.

name: CRAZY MUSEUM - The First "Arcade Series" Board Game
creator: Trencadaus
description: Unleash chaos in this competitive 1-4 player, arcade-inspired game, full of action management, puzzle-solving and epic friend sabotage!

name: Singularity Hex
creator: Tripolar_dan
description: A sci-fi horror survival game where 4 characters work together to escape an ever-changing ship.

name: KeyForge: Draconian Measures
creator: Ghost Galaxy
description: From slumber, it stirs... The latest set from the world's first unique deck game brings with it a new house, new cards, and new powers for Archons to use to challenge for the vaults.

name: The Lord of the Rings: The Confrontation Ultimate Edition
creator: Ghost Galaxy
description:
The classic board game, designed by Reiner Knizia, is one of the most critically-acclaimed games set in the world of J.R.R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings. This "Ultimate Edition" of the Lord of the Rings: The Confrontation is the most comprehensive version yet.  

What is more: the "Ultimate Collector's Edition" version of the game, available below, may be the most amazing The Lord of the Rings gaming artifact that the world has ever seen.

name: ELDEN RING: Rot & Sorcery
creator: Steamforged Games
description: Rise, Tarnished, and let grace guide you on a new tabletop journey

name: Dice Fights: Heal or Steal
creator: Woodstock Games
description: Level up your game! Woodstock Games proudly unveils a brand-new expansion and an upgraded 2nd edition!

name: Chicago Grand Slam
creator: Dos Caramellos
description: Chicago Grand Slam, a brand new take on a classic Scandinavian card game transformed into a strategic and super thrilling board game.

name: Distilled: Cocktails
creator: Paverson Games
description: Craft cocktails and fine spirits to gain international renown in this spirited expansion to the hit game, Distilled

name: Under our Sun 2nd edition & miniature expansion
creator: TABLETOPPER GAMES
description: This campaign not only brings the long-awaited enemy MINIATURES, the updated BASE GAME - SECOND EDITION, the UPGRADE KIT (first edition to second edition) and all previously released expansions (delivery approximately November 2025), but will also feature the first CONTENT PACK, consisting of a bunch of exciting new missions and useful new items (delivery approximately Q1/Q2 - 2026).

name: BLAST: Operation Paradox
creator: DBB Games
description:
Reality is cracking, and the timeline is infected with deadly anomalies. Your mission? Dive into the chaos of history, hunt down the source of corruption, and restore the timeline before it collapses for good.
Join an elite Time Commando unit in this 1–3 player retro, tactical-arcade sci-fi game.

name: Ascendia - Seasons of Thargos
creator: SBG Editions
description:
It’s time for valor and renown! Ascendia needs a champion as the dreaded winter looms ever closer. 
Earn the trust of your future subjects by undertaking epic exploits as you craft, gather, explore and fight your way to the throne of Ascendia!

name: Fintastic Sea
creator: Pektis Studio
description:
Think Deep. Play Smart.
In Fintastic Sea, players take on the role of marine biologists build thriving marine ecosystems by placing, catching, and combining fish species. 
Strategic card placement, timing, and combo-building lie at the heart of this thinky, dynamic underwater challenge.

name: Dice Commandos [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Dice Commandos is a tactical dice puzzle game where you control a team of elite operatives completing objectives through stealth, combat, and clever use of abilities.

name: ION CORE
creator: Magister Games
description: Enter Ion Core, a thematic sandbox game set in a post-apocalyptic dystopian world. Humanity has been driven to piracy to secure a brighter future and it's up to you to guide your faction to victory!

name: Scratch Island
creator: Garlock Games
description:
Go get your treasure map and your shovel and start your adventure now! 
Roll dice and scratch your way on this tropical island searching for hidden treasures. But beware, other players may be the first to claim treasure, so you have to be smart about it. Also beware of snakes! Are you ready to embark on a journey for 2-4 players and become the greatest treasure hunter?

name: Chonker Party: Team Play & Drunken Chonker
creator: Chonker Games
description:
✨ Follow now to get a FREE gift! ✨

🎉 Chonker Party is a fun and fast-paced trick-taking party game for 2-6 players with two versions! 🃏
🤝 Team Play – Work together in teams to outsmart your opponents!
🍹 Drunken Chonker – An after-dark edition for some tipsy game night!

Which one will you play first? 😺🎲

name: Ascension 15th Anniversary
creator: Stone Blade Entertainment
description: Celebrate 15 years of Ascension with a special edition that honors its iconic legacy! This campaign brings exclusive new promos, access to a stunning new collector’s edition, which includes updated original Ascension set and the newly updated, never-before-seen, Return of the Fallen set. Plus, enjoy a wealth of exciting surprises to mark this monumental milestone in deckbuilding history. Join us as we commemorate a decade and a half of strategic gameplay, epic battles, and thrilling expansions!

name: LIBERATION
creator: PLATYPUS GAME
description: An intense asymmetric game where Resistance and Occupier clash in a shadow war of ruthless tactics and decisive choices.

name: Chaosphere: Etonak Vanguard
creator: Ora Games Legends
description:
Chaosphere: Etonak Vanguard is a solo or cooperative strategy game where you take command of a ship and travel through various sectors, upgrading your gear before facing powerful enemies.
Challenging and highly replayable, Etonak Vanguard draws inspiration from roguelike mechanics to deliver fast-paced, tactical progression full of surprises.
The new game from Franz Couderc!

name: Europa Universalis: TPoP | Defying Destiny Expansion + Reprint
creator: Aegir Games
description: Europa Universalis: The Price of Power is an epic grand strategy game, where the players will compete to build the most successful empire of the early modern era. Now comes a Brand New Expansion called Defying Destiny, giving players a chance to explore a vast array of new featured Realms, Events and Scenarios. A Reprint of the Deluxe Edition will also be available as a campaign reward.

name: The Voynich Puzzle
creator: SaltandPepper
description: The Voynich Puzzle is a eurogame where players unravel the secrets of the infamous Voynich manuscript. Explore its cryptic pages, decipher unknown symbols, and piece together hidden clues to uncover its true meaning. Every choice leads you deeper into a world of alchemy, botany, and ancient secrets. Will you solve history’s greatest enigma, or will the manuscript keep its secrets forever?

name: Spokes
creator: Radical 8 Games
description: Spokes is a fast-paced cycling game for 1-6 players, age 14 and up, running at about 30 minutes per playthrough. Build beautiful routes, slipstream other bikes and manage your stamina to be the first to the finish line... or enable someone to rush by at the last minute. All of this in an incredibly elegant and original game design by Bert Hardeman.

name: Diktat
creator: Sethmes Editions
description:
Earth is encompassed by the Artifact.
In the shadows, several factions continue their death struggle for supremacy. 
Will you succeed in imposing your diktat?

name: The Other Side of the Hill Reprint
creator: Masqueoca
description: The Other Side of the Hill is a boardgame that simulates the effects that this struggle for power within the German High Command had on the development of the Second World War. Up to four players represent military leaders cooperating and competing as they manage Germany's wartime strategy. To win, they must vie for Prestige by advancing the careers of their favored Army and Army Group commanders, grabbing their share of victories while the early-war pickings are easy, then avoiding responsibility for battlefield disasters as the Soviets and the Western Allies solidify and push back.

name: Shrine - Duel of Light
creator: Bright Horizon Games
description: Outshine your rival in a fast-paced, tactical 2-player duel powered by LED lighting.

name: 1906 San Francisco (2nd Edition)
creator: Looping_Games
description: New edition of one of the best-rated games in the 1900 Series: 1906 San Francisco. Be a Property Developer for the rapid reconstruction of San Francisco during the nine years after the large-scale destruction.

name: Good Dog, Bad Zombie: A Cooperative Board Game (2nd Edition)
creator: TESA Collective
description: Bark, sniff, and lick your way through the apocalypse to save the humans you love! This second edition has new art, new playable dogs, and upgraded components! You can even play as your own dog! 1 - 4 players, 60 minutes to play. It will have you howling for joy.

name: Aeon's End: Beyond the Breach
creator: Indie Boards and Cards
description: Aeon’s End: Beyond the Breach expands on the beloved expedition system with a brand new FIGHT FIVE. This means a brand new tier of nemesis difficulty and a brand new type of treasure cards players can earn for surviving this gauntlet of challenges. This box is a standalone product with new mages, nemeses, supply cards, friends and foes, and treasures that will enhance anyone’s collection.

name: World Stitchers, Phanerozoic and Heroes of Tenefyr
creator: Broken Mill
description: Build a new world, simulate the evolution of life or battle through dungeons in these 3 unique games by the same designer.

name: SolForge Fusion: Shadows Over Solis
creator: Stone Blade Entertainment
description: SolForge Fusion: Shadows Over Solis brings the next chapter of the unique hybrid-TCG saga to life with brand-new physical booster packs. Discover powerful new cards, mechanics, and strategies—all fully compatible with your existing SolForge Fusion physical and digital collection. Plus, the best deals ever offered on previous SolForge Fusion products!

name: Mesopotamia
creator: Meeple Pug
description: Carve your legacy in stone by leading humanity during its birth in Mesopotamia. Choose your Civilization and explore an ever-changing map, expand your empire, exploit its resources, and exterminate your rivals. The Cradle of Civilization awaits you!

name: Syncanite Foundation: A Strategic Cutthroat Conspiracy Game
creator: SYNCANITE GAMES GmbH
description: Each crisis is an opportunity. Will you seize it? 💀👑 Be the villain in this highly asymmetric area control game, based on a novel 📖

name: Coexist
creator: Matagot
description: In this streamlined card and resource management game deeply rooted in its theme, lead an organization and mobilize your caretakers to safeguard endangered species. Featuring stunning artwork by a French street artist and developed in collaboration with HISA, a real-life organization committed to protecting biodiversity.

name: Mighty Shot!
creator: This is a GAME
description: The Ultimate Blend of Tactics & Dexterity in a MOBA Inspired Board Game.

name: Shred of Redemption [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Shred of Redemption follows the journey of a corrupt medieval noble, who decides to make amends towards the end of his life and challenges the player to answer: What can make up for a life full of violence and betrayal? The design mixes bag building with dice rolling/placement in a tight 15 minute playtime.

name: Onward: the MOBA Board Game
creator: Skytear Games
description: Onward is a competitive board game for 2-4 players, distilling the strategy and thrill of MOBA video games like DOTA 2 and League of Legends into a streamlined 1-hour board game. As the spiritual sequel to our hit 2020 release Skytear, the design of Onward is based on feedback from over 10,000 players.

name: Yinzi: Ming
creator: Fentasy Games
description:
Yinzi: Ming is a new edition of the euro-style worker placement game Yinzi, originally published by Spielworxx in 2019. This beautifully reimagined edition features revamped artwork, refined iconography, and completely revised rules.
Step into the role of a powerful merchant clan and establish your dominance at the heart of the Ming dynasty in this deep and challenging strategy game.

name: Travelers Tokyo
creator: Keep Exploring Games
description: Explore cyberpunk Tokyo in a weekend and do, eat, buy and see as much as you can!

name: Sinners
creator: The Grinning Frog
description: With a dark sense of humour, this solo play card game sees you battle evil priests, mercenaries, common thugs and crazed cultists, and of course the legendary cannibal Bob!

name: Regulus High-Fantasy Arena-Sports
creator: The Prince of Games
description:
Humans, Orcs, Vampires and Dwarfs of the world of Regulus have gathered for an epic clash of arena combat to prove the prowess of their champions!

Victory will only be scored if you master your positioning and the timing of attacks.

Will you master the arena and overcome your rivals?


✅ Asymmetrical Teams
✅ Highly-Tactical
✅ No Luck
✅ Character Customization

name: Agile Unicorn Card Game
creator: agile-unicorn
description:
Das Kartenspiel für IT-Geschädigte. 
Du liebst Satire und taktische Duelle, in denen Du Deine Kollegen ärgern kannst? Gründe bei Agile Unicorn ein agiles Tech-Startup und führe es zum Sieg! This game is only available in German language (for now)

name: Muster: Raise the Banners
creator: Play Monkey Games
description: Step into the enchanting realms of Muster, where players compete to Raise the Banners and seize control of five majestic castles. Strategic planning and bold tactics will determine who emerges victorious in this fast-paced, two-player duel!

name: Dare The Unknown
creator: Space Delirium
description: A journey through NASA’s legacy in a strategic and competitive board game where you take command of iconic spacecraft in a race through space.

name: Aerodome: Rising Horizons Vol 2
creator: Ephyrean Games
description: Rise to the skies with us for Aerodome: Rising Horizons Vol. 2. The launch of two expansions for Aerodome.

name: Guess Chess
creator: Nero
description: Guess Chess is an unique mix of chess, guessing and memory. It takes less than a minute to learn, but offers surprisingly many layers of strategy to explore! Plus it's super portable and accessible to everyone.

name: Tanares Expeditions: Central Sea
creator: Dragori Games
description: Uncover an ancient mystery in the Central Sea and battle through one of the most addictive dungeon-crawling experiences.

name: Qu'arz
creator: till5am
description:
QUARZ brings Capture the Flag to the board game table like it should be. Our miniatures look sweet, but there's no compromise on intense action.

Join a mob of monsters battling for the Crystal Idol in this high-energy, competitive game for 2-4 players. Outmaneuver rivals, snatch the Crystal Idol from the altar, and race it to your base to claim instant victory.

name: Gold Hustle
creator: SquareDevil
description: Gold is flowing down the river! Smuggle, gamble and steal your way to fortune in this fast-paced card game for 2-5 players.

name: Company of Heroes 2nd Edition - Tariff Payment
creator: Bad Crow Games
description: This is a campaign to help collect a portion of the tariff payments from US backers.

name: Sniper Elite: Operation Kraken & Reprint
creator: Rebellion Unplugged
description: Sniper Elite returns with a brand-new expansion that introduces two new maps, defender vehicles, and a host of new challenges. Explore the open Norman Village or the claustrophobic bowels of the "Super Carrier" in exciting new missions!

name: Champions of Rokugan
creator: Monolith Board Games
description: Enter together in a realm of heroism, magic, and steel, where warring samurai clans clash for power and prestige, duel for revenge, and fight to save the very soul of the realm of Rokugan, in the universe of Legend of the 5 Rings.

name: Guns of the Old West
creator: Wolf Storm Entertainment
description: Players compete in solo/co-op play or as a team with over 100 campaign paths. Each playthrough is a unique cinematic experience offering endless replayability. Players make strategic decisions and interact with each other to achieve their group and secret individual objectives, some of which involve betrayal, making for an unpredictable gameplay experience.

name: Reforest: Reprint + Old Growth
creator: Firestarter Games
description: Grow a forest from humble herbs to towering trees!

name: Sprites & Sprouts
creator: Open Owl Studios
description: Plant and Tend crops as magical sprites in Mythwind Valley, a cozy game of enchanted farming.

name: Tomb Raider: The Crypt of Chronos
creator: Iconiq Studios
description: An epic Tomb Raider adventure across an action-packed board game. Discover an ancient secret as Lara Croft fights to save time itself!

name: Dicemancy [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Dicemancy is a solo tower defense game where you create broken spell combinations using dice and cards to stop the constant onslaught of monsters!

name: Knight Moves [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: A puzzly solo adventure game with 50+ levels and character progression!

name: Race to Berlin
creator: Portal Games
description: “Race to Berlin” is a wargame depicting the last days of the World War II in Europe. Players represent commanders of the Red Army and the Western Allies, but they also direct the German armies: the Soviet player moves them on the Western Front, the Allied player on the Eastern Front, each trying to slow down their opponent. The goal is to beat your "ally" in a race to Berlin - winner takes all.

name: The battle of the Divas
creator: SaltandPepper
description: In The Battle of the Divas, players take on the roles of Maria Callas and Renata Tebaldi in their fight for operatic supremacy. Throughout the game, each diva will perform great operas, gain fame, and experience key moments of their career in a timeline that will shape their legacy.

name: Lying Pirates - Cities of Greed Expansion + Reprint
creator: Nordic Pirate Games
description: Set sail on an epic pirate adventure with Lying Pirates and its exciting new expansion, Cities of Greed! Bluff, strategize, and outwit your rivals in this fast-paced dice game for 2–6 players. Back the campaign to bring your pirate journey to life and claim your share of the spoils.

name: Trash Rush
creator: Tabula Games
description: Are you skilled enough to join these terrific raccoon street cleaning crews in this family plus game for 1 to 4 players?

name: KILAUEA
creator: Combo Games
description:
In KILAUEA you will represent a Mo'o, the lizard-like spirits of Hawaiian folklore, and you will build tiki columns to worship Pele, the goddess of volcanoes.

Kilauea is a game with very simple rules, but with a scoring system that forces players to always be aware of how the number of tikis of each colour changes in each volcano area, and to manage wisely where and which ones to place in their personal island.

name: Dungeons of Doria - Reprint & Expansion
creator: Xploding 10 Games
description: Dungeons of Doria is a cooperative roguelike loot crawler in which 1-6 players explore mostly random dungeons, where unique monsters and traps lurk after each door. Get the base game in German or English as well as the first expansion.

name: Earth Under Siege: Flashpoint Reprint plus Nemesis Expansion
creator: Dark Horizon Games
description: Earth Under Siege: Flashpoint returns with the Nemesis expansion! Enhance your game with terrifying new versions of classic enemies, or dive into the all-new Nemesis Mode! Earth Under Siege: Flashpoint is a 1-4 player co-op, covert mission game. Use stealth, sabotage, and assassination to overcome an invading alien threat!

name: Work of Heart! pledge manager
creator: Chris "DROMS MEDIA" Eli
description: Welcome to the Work of Heart pledge manager! Where you will be able to confirm your shipping information and get the game if you missed out on our Kickstarter.

name: Diceocracy
creator: All Or None Games
description: Strategy board game about winning the election in a dice filled cyberpunk future!

name: Dawn Of Madness: Complete Collection
creator: Diemension Games
description: Plunge into terrifying other worlds in the story-driven horror experience Dawn of Madness. Delve into eight nightmarish worlds – each one its own deep, engrossing game with unique gameplay, monsters, storybook, and multiple endings. Will you survive the Dawn’s dark depths?

name: DinoGenics: New Arrivals
creator: NinthHaven Games
description:
DinoGenics returns for its third printing with the New Arrivals expansion.

DinoGenics is a thematic worker placement game where 1-5 players compete to build the most successful dinosaur park. DinoGenics features sandbox style park building with over 25 unique dinosaur species and hundreds of ways to design your personal island resort.

name: Tameri
creator: Post Scriptum
description: A classic theme explored from an original angle and with new and unique game mechanics, a worker placement game set on Ancient Egypt: Master the Weather, Grow your Wealth, Rule the Nile Valley!

name: World Order
creator: Hegemonic Project Games
description: Simulate the modern global political system in this area-control game.

name: Delivery Witches
creator: Undigital
description: Hop on a broomstick and take off to deliver parcels  in this 1-4 adorable game

name: Fauna - The Animal Trivia Game
creator: Rathskellers
description:
Easy to learn, hard to master! Fauna is a 2–6 player game about Animals.
Perfect for family game night, with enough strategic layers to satisfy experienced gamers. Guess smart. Bluff bold. Observe closely.

name: Super Pixel Tactics
creator: Level 99 Games
description: The legendary tactical card game returns. Own everything in this upgraded collection, featuring new, previously limited, and exclusive cards! Over 400 playable cards!

name: Cleaning Service (Print & Play)
creator: AmadeusGames
description:
Welcome to a brand-new way to play: Memory & Write.
Cleaning Service is a thrilling solo boardgame that blends the strategic depth of RogueLite with the challenge of Memory & Write.
Step into the shoes of a crime scene cleaner, where your mission is to leave no trace behind. Clear each crime scene carefully while dodging security cameras, avoiding the police, and using your wits to stay ahead.
Each new Run will test your memory, but if you score high enough, you’ll unlock powerful tools to make your job easier. Sharpen your mind and prove you’re the best in the business!

name: The Flames of Fafnir
creator: Lucky Duck Games
description: Push your tactics to the limits in this innovative strategy game driven by physics.

name: Shallow Regrets - A pocket sized game of Deep Regrets
creator: Button Shy Games
description: Haul in otherworldly fish and monstrous creatures to maximize your profit. 2-3 players with free solo expansion. Only $12!

name: Trismegistus: New Special Edition by Board&Dice
creator: Board&Dice
description: With stunning new artwork and streamlined, user-friendly graphic design, the game is now more intuitive without sacrificing its heavy Euro-style strategy.

name: Neo Morphosis Soundtrack & 10 Years of The Order of Vampire Hunters Celebration
creator: Dark Gate Games
description: Dive into the immersive world of Neo Morphosis: Infestation with our captivating soundtrack! Join us in celebrating a decade of thrilling adventures with The Order of Vampire Hunters.

name: Age of Steam Deluxe Exp. Vol. V & VI
creator: Eagle-Gryphon Games
description: 16 Additional Expansion Maps for Age of Steam Deluxe - Art & Graphic Design by Ian O'Toole

name: Cosmic ArenA
creator: RodriGameZ
description: Cosmic Arena est un jeu d'affrontement stratégique 2 joueurs à base de cartes pour des parties d'environ 30 à 40 minutes à partir de 12 ans. Dans ce jeu vous fabriquerez votre système de façon à ce qu'il vous rapporte plus de points que celui de votre adversaire.

name: Dragons of Etchinstone
creator: Chip Theory Games
description: A solo, palm-playable adventure from Joe Klipfel (Gloomhaven: Buttons and Bugs) and Chip Theory Games!

name: Are You More Like... and Go For The Krill
creator: Three Nail Games
description: Every player at the table deserves to be engaged in the fun! Three Nail Games delivers again on two highly interactive games that scale well for all ages and both high and low player counts! Do you know what your opponent is thinking?

name: This War of Mine Second Edition
creator: Awaken Realms
description: Experience the refined version of the acclaimed war-torn world survival game.

name: Fief England - Alliances, Treachery, and Power
creator: Academy Games
description: Fief England is a game of dynastic ambition where players lead noble families in medieval England. Each family is comprised of noble Lords and Ladies that strive to attain Royal and Ecclesiastical titles through intrigue, diplomacy, marriage alliances, betrayals, and war.

name: Solar Titans Definitive Edition
creator: Solsora Games
description: Prepare for fast-paced, strategic capital ship combat. Experience a unique take on deck-building and tableau gameplay as you push your ship to the limit and engage in tense battles where every decision may be your last.

name: HELLDIVERS 2: The Board Game
creator: Steamforged Games
description: Dive into an intergalactic struggle to protect Super Earth and rid the galaxy of alien threats in the name of liberty and democracy.

name: Sqwürmish: Sci-Fi Skirmish Game & Miniatures
creator: creaturecuration
description:
From the co-creator of Vast Grimm comes a stand-alone sci-fi miniatures agnostic skirmish wargame game compatible with Forbidden Psalm set in the Grimm Expanse universe. With incredible miniatures by Malevolent Minis.

Bonus Neon Lords of the Toxic Wasteland content included!

name: Space Gits: A Miniatures Game of Drunk-Ass Space Orcs
creator: Planet Smasher Games
description: From the creator of GASLANDS comes a dexterity-based skirmish game of lootin', shootin' and scootin'.

name: Granfondo - The thrilling racing game
creator: Runner Games
description: Control a team of 3 cyclists, each specialized in climbing, sprinting, and long-distance. Fight for position! Forge daring alliances, seize the perfect moment, and break away to victory. Your next epic racing game awaits! 🚴🏽

name: Secret Recipe
creator: SnowBoardGames
description: Grandma has decided to pass her recipe book on to a worthy successor. Match wits with your family and friends to find out who it is!

name: The Pirate Republic: Africa Gambit
creator: Green Feet Games
description: Pledge Manager For The Pirate Republic: Africa Gambit

name: Fairytale
creator: Smartup Games
description: In the world of Fairytale, brave pets, with the magic of teamwork in their hearts and ready to face any threat, set forth on a perilous journey. Perfect for families and experienced players alike, this dungeon crawler fosters cooperation, wonder, and unforgettable adventures.

name: NEXUS: Arena Combat System (Tariff Survival Campaign)
creator: D-Verse Publishing, LLC
description: A one-time opportunity to grab the NEXUS base game + hardcover Legacy Edition for only $120 — with FREE U.S. shipping. Help us clear inventory, fund surprise tariffs, and keep the chaos where it belongs... in the arena!

name: Escape From Tibbles Tower
creator: Heartborn Studios
description:
Escape From Tibbles Tower is a fast-paced board game for 2-4 players, 30-90 mins, Ages 8+.

You are all Tibbles, the infinite God of time, who also happens to be a moustached tuxedo cat... 

Trapped within the tower by your evil self Diadaxis, and his army of corrupted kittens! You must compete to be the first Tibbles to find the exit and break out of the tower before Diadaxis, or the other players use reality bending powers to make kitty litter of your plans!

name: Rejig
creator: Silverspire Games
description: The ultimate letter-tile game 14 years in the making. Build your own crossword against family and friends as you race to score the most points through word count, round categories, bonus words, donuts, and more! The best strategy can change each round so everyone has a chance against even the most hardcore vocabulary geeks!

name: Escape from Stalingrad Z - Reloaded
creator: Raybox Games
description: Award Winning Escape from Stalingrad Z: Reloaded is a 1 to 3 player solo/coop/versus narrative campaign game of tactical combat set in the horrific zombie plague of World War II.

name: Reichbusters: Reloaded
creator: Monolith Board Games
description: Play as larger-than-life Allied heroes in this cooperative game in intense two-phase missions against a Third Reich aided by the strangest and most dangerous technology. Infiltrate the heart of the danger ... before alarm reinforcements overwhelm you!

name: Trickerion - 10-year Anniversary Edition (Pledge Manager)
creator: Mindclash Games
description: Celebrating 10 years of magic with a brand-new expansion and a stunning edition of all Trickerion-related content.

name: Rome: Fate of an Empire (DELUXE) [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Lead Rome to glory—or obscurity—as you develop and operate your empire! (This is a deluxe edition and reprint of the 2024 hit game.)

name: Paranormal [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Defeat the monsters of the week to gain weapons, allies, and clues so you can hunt down the big bad and save the world!

name: Chivalry is Dead - Race for the Crown
creator: Naughty Jester Games
description: Challenge your friends in this unique Fantasy Chariot Racing Game! Compete as one of seven unique races in this brutal charge for the finish line race game. Whether you employ cunning tactics, set clever traps or launch direct on your adversaries, ensure your triumph in this exhilarating contest where every move counts. Chariots will be destroyed, and debris will be left on the field.

name: Zoo On
creator: Let's Forget the Rules!
description: Choose a pawn companion and cross paths with cute animals. In order to shelter and feed them, you will need to build parks by drawing enclosure, habitat, food and animal cards. Layer and combine your cards to accumulate points and help your pawn companion progress faster throughout his adventure. The best animal combinations will bring you closer to victory.

name: Medieval Trumps
creator: Sources Saga
description: This Print&Play, very easy card game is perfect for a quick medieval-themed duel. Comprising 12 cards, 8 lie or truth tokens, and a set of easy-to-follow rules, it is an affordable choice for casual fun for 2 players anywhere, anytime. With captivating medieval graphics, it offers a taste of strategy and deceit in a compact, low-cost format.

name: G.I. JOE: Operation Cobra
creator: OCGames
description: G.I. JOE: Operation Cobra is a cooperative tactical action game that can also be played solo. Players control a G.I. "Era of Tribes"

You have ten unique tribes to choose from, each with special benefits and drawbacks, different starting conditions.
Additionally, you have several ways to end the game and different game lengths to choose from. Era of Tribes gives a real civ-feeling from around 30 minutes per player.
In the game, you develop your tribe by placing leaders on your personal Tribal Action Board where you choose 1 of 7 different actions in each turn. This guarantees quick actions and a short downtime.

name: Dino Dino
creator: Nathan
description:
In Dino Dino you are a dinosaur caretaker. Build your own Dino farm, collect food and place as many dinosaurs as possible in an ever expanding world! Does your collection ultimately score the most?

Dino Dino is played over several rounds in which each player takes separate turns. During a turn, the player can choose one of the following 2 actions.

Action 1: Place Land Tile
Action 2: Place Dino

Action 1 will be performed the most. During this action, the player takes 1 of the face up land tiles. This is then placed on its existing land. This way, your own park will expand in size. As soon as you place the tile you get food. There are 3 types of food: plants, fish and meat. When the same food icons touch each other you create a chain. This way you get extra food.

If a player has enough food, action 2 can be performed. Every dinosaur has some kind of food that they want to eat, you need a certain amount of this food to be able to place them in your park. The dinosaurs give you points for a certain food type at the end of the game. This depends on the number of food icons surrounding the dinosaur in the park.

The game is over when all the land tiles have been placed. The player with the highest score wins the game.

name: Rex Britannorum
creator: Shakos
description:
In 55 and 54 BC, Julius Caesar landed in the south of the island of Britain, then known as Britannia. This was the first contact between Rome and the various British kingdoms. Numerous kings rallied to Caesar to survive, or to benefit from Rome's protection against the hostility of other British tribes: these were the first client kingdoms. This system would develop over the next century, so that by the time of Claudius' Roman invasion in AD 43, many client kingdoms were already well established.

Among these were the Regnenses, Brigantes and Iceni, who fought mercilessly for power. With Rome's support, they all tried to obtain the title of King of the British, in Latin: REX BRITANNORUM.
