name: Apothecary: Plague Doctors
creator: 1FirstGames
description:
The Black Death is coming! Take on the role of rival apothecary shop owners from the renaissance period in Apothecary: Plague Doctors.

In this 2-4 player card game you’ll draft ingredients and actions to help you complete orders, hinder your opponents, and distract the guards (if you’re planning on selling some poison on the side, of course). The player with the highest combined value of orders at the end of the game wins and just might survive the plague.

name: Eldfall Chronicles: Northern Wind
creator: Freecompany
description: An epic adventure featuring deep tactical combat, dungeon crawl, and premium miniatures. Hunt the haunting and save the Empire!

name: Fabled: The Spirit Lands + Expansion
creator: CrowD Games
description: Build your path in a dynamically changing world. Engine-building strategy game from the studio behind City of the Great Machine.

name: FINAL NINE : A DISC GOLF CARD GAME : REPRINT + EXPANSION
creator: Mnkymnd Games
description: The essential Disc Golf card game is ready for a reprint, now with an Expansion Pack featuring 2 exciting new courses

name: Spooky Double Feature + Dieson Crusoe Reprint [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Two spooky-themed solo games for the price of one!

name: Ascension Legends
creator: Stone Blade Entertainment
description: Ascension returns with an all-new stand-alone set—Ascension Legends—designed for both newcomers and long-time fans of the series. In this acclaimed deckbuilding game, you are one of the legendary warriors of Vigil, capable of protecting your realm from annihilation, but you cannot do it alone. Recruit mighty heroes and wield powerful constructs to aid you in battle against the monsters of Deoful!

name: Ice & Land
creator: AmadeusGames
description:
❄️A Print and Play inspired by the bestseller The Terror by Dan Simmons and based on the book Sea of Catharsis❄️
Players must survive extreme weather and hazards by managing their resources, And all this with a simple pencil.

name: Dinner Party: Dinner with (in)famous people of history
creator: Failure Factory
description: You’re the hosts of a dinner party, and your guests are people of history. Convince characters like Marie Curie, Cleopatra or Gandhi to join your table, use their special abilities and treat them to drinks from the bar. Send Adolf (who came uninvited and insists his invitation “got lost in the mail”) to the table of an opponent to ruin their evening, and make sure to keep your own guests entertained so other players won’t be able to charm them away from you. Only one can have the greatest party ever when the game ends and dinner is served!

name: The Quest Kids: Realms of the Kingdom
creator: Treasure Falls Games
description: The acclaimed fantasy board game for young heroes 5 years old and up returns with a new expansion.

name: Kemet: Rise of the Gods
creator: Matagot
description: Discover a host of new expansions and ways to play for Kemet: Blood and Sand. In this acclaimed strategy boardgame, play as an Egyptian god, lead armies, unlock divine powers and fight your rivals for dominance. From the creators of Cyclades, Inis, Galactic Renaissance and many more.

name: Speakeasy - By Vital Lacerda with Artwork by Ian O'Toole
creator: Eagle-Gryphon Games
description: Take on the role of a savvy Mobster Boss in 1920s Manhattan during Prohibition in this innovative area control game.

name: Love, Career & Magic: A mythical reality TV board game
creator: Pegasus Games
description: A game where fantasy meets reality TV! Can you work together to achieve high ratings or will you be cancelled after season one?

name: Evil:101
creator: Tombs Foundry
description: A competitive and fast-paced game of lies and villainy for 2 to 6 players.

name: Circle The Wagons: Second Shot
creator: Button Shy Games
description: More Circle The Wagons with modes to combine both games. More Lone Cowboy solo cards too! 1-2 players, only $12!

name: Valheim: The Board Game
creator: MOOD Publishing
description: Valheim: The Board Game is a 1-4 player cooperative board game where survival depends on teamwork and strategy. Assemble your band of warriors and venture forth to explore, expand your homestead, gather resources, forge powerful weapons, equip sturdy armor, battle evil creatures, and carve your path towards facing the ultimate evil, the Forsaken. The fate of Valheim lies in your hands!

name: Heroes of Might & Magic III: The Board Game - Stronghold, Conflux & Cove Expansions
creator: Archon Studio
description: Heroes of Might & Magic III: The Board Game is a classic video game adaptation highly rated by fans. This adventure for 1-4 players features gameplay primarily around deck building, exploration, and hero development.

name: Hunted: North Pole (2nd Edition) [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Defeat Jack Frost, rescue Santa, and save Christmas!

name: The Fisherman
creator: Darkkena
description:
Captain "Mako", a veteran of the sea, stood at the helm of his fishing boat, the Invincible, as a storm raged around him. The waves rose like menacing giants, lashing the ship with relentless fury. The wind howled like a hunting wolf, but Mako did not waver. His eyes were fixed on the horizon, where he knew the perfect catch awaited him, hidden in the tumultuous depths...

Welcome to The Fisherman, the board game that puts you in command of a deep-sea fishing boat ready to sail uncharted waters in search of the perfect catch. Choose your ship, your crew, the items to load on board, and prepare the fuel. Are you ready to set sail?

name: Epireia - The Hellenic Hegemony
creator: DTDA Games
description:
Epireia is an elegant strategy board game for 1-4 players that plays in 45-60 minutes.

In Epireia, players step into the sandals of a city Administrator, vying for dominance in the classical Greek era. The game unfolds over three scenarios, weaving a tapestry of strategic possibilities. It takes place during a period of tension and will conclude with a great battle.
Your objective? To lead your city and its league to hegemony by mastering a multifaceted gameplay that spans building, diplomacy, and resource management.

name: Lords of Heaven
creator: PHALANX
description: Take control of Jerusalem and shape the fate of the Middle East as one of the four dominant medieval powers: the Latin Christian Crusaders, the Orthodox Byzantine Empire, the Shia Fatimid Caliphate, or the Sunni Seljuks. Refight and rewrite the history of the first Crusades in epic battles that will define the era!

name: Chang'an - Revised Edition
creator: Pendragon Game Studio srl
description: As an important urbanist, renew the city of Chang'an during the Tang Era in a new engine building and resource management card game!

name: Northwest
creator: Brickhouse Games
description: Northwest is a 2-to-4 player tableau-building game with unique pattern-based scoring and shared movement mechanics. Northwest can be taught in 3 minutes and is made for players of all kinds. This game is crafted from natural wood and recyclable materials, making it perfect for family game nights or gifts

name: Money Maker - The Goldsmiths Tale
creator: Paul Brinkkemper
description: A push-your-luck, auction and engine building game for 2-6 players, about the invention of banking, set in 17th century Amsterdam. Every player plays an enterprising investment banker who has a little money and limitless promises to money. Investments can be made on promised money. But be careful! Credit is due when you least want to. Maybe you can borrow some credit from your competitor? Will you be the richest player in the end?

name: A Nice Cuppa
creator: Button Shy Games
description: When worries become too distracting, soothe them away with a nice relaxing cup of tea. Only $12!

name: DreamEscape
creator: Badcatgames
description: Your dreaming mind has been trapped within a nightmare, shattered into fragments by Great Cthulhu. To escape, wake up and win, you must explore the Dreamlands, uncover and survive many sinister plots and unite your missing fragments once more... or else remain trapped forever in a cage within your own mind!

name: EPOS: A Gentes Game
creator: Spielworxx
description: The Ultimate Campaign Game about Ancient Civilizations & Wonders

name: WARLINE x Dragons War
creator: El Jay Play
description: Design the battlefield. Design your army. Design custom tactics. Craft your own path to victory in this sandbox fantasy warfare game. Now, Warline's critically acclaimed head-to-head "Strategicraft" gameplay is bolstered with the new solo or cooperative army-versus-dragon expansion—Dragons War.

name: Guards of Atlantis II: Tabletop MOBA
creator: Wolffdesigna
description:
Guards of Atlantis II: Tabletop MOBA is back! 
Don't miss the chance to get your copy!

name: 7th Inning Stretch [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Build your team and perfect your starting lineup as you try to win the world championship in this puzzle-y drafting game!

name: Norsemen
creator: Skellig Games
description: Norsemen - Sail the world, settle down and let your tribe prosper. The fascinating new Euro style game in the viking world.

name: Serengeti Sanctuary
creator: Spooky Tower Games
description: Preserve the wilds of Africa and restore life to the animal kingdom! Serengeti Sanctuary - a beautiful game for 2-4 players (with a solo mode) where you draft cards, make sets and compete to expand your wildlife reserve as successfully as possible.  Finalist of the Ravensburger "The Next Big Family Game" Competition.

name: Raven Manor (Edycja Polska)
creator: Bear's Workshop
description:
Imprezowa gra z ukrytymi tożsamościami dla 4-10 graczy w stylu mafii/wilkołaka.
Polska wersja ufundowanej na Kickstarterze gry Raven Manor.

name: The Arena of Baradum
creator: Horned Toad Games
description: The Arena of Baradum is an easy-to-play tactical arena brawler which features amazing art, captivating characters and a gameplay that has players coming back for more. The board game is for 2-6 players, ages 14+, 30-60 min. play time. The game is flexible and offers something for everyone. It has several game modi, amazing miniature models and it provides a classic, straight-forward experience with a modern twist. The rules of the game are easy and accessible, but there’s something for everyone as you can make it as tactically challenging as you’re looking for. It all depends on what kind of board gamer you are!

name: Oganika Arcanum: Hex16
creator: Blood Moon Games Ltd
description: From the taverns and inns of Embra, Oganika Arcanum: Hex16 is a competitive puzzle game from a fantasy culture.  For 1 or 2+ players. Play simply as-is, or integrate into some seriously fun tavern down-time in your own favourite RPG or LARP setting. Who knows, by getting to grips with the tiles, something magical might occur…

name: Runar: The last chance!
creator: Ludus Magnus Studio
description: Guide your Viking Heroes through frozen lands, defeat powerful Enemies and opposing Heroes. The hunt for the Runic Gems has just begun!

name: Beast - Shattered Isles
creator: Studio Midhall
description: The official expansion for the critically acclaimed hidden movement game Beast. Welcome to a dangerous new world, filled with new Beasts, ruins, and brave hunters in search of forgotten knowledge.

name: Fox Experiment- Deluxe Wooden Edition
creator: Pandasaurus Games
description: A brand new edition of the latest board game from Elizabeth Hargrave (Wingspan) where you breed fox pups to pass on desired traits to the next generation! This new 2nd edition removes almost all of the plastic components from the previous edition and replaces them with premium wooden content.

name: Linebacker II
creator: Kevin Talley / Cadet Games
description: A fascinating air campaign simulation!  134 minis including aircraft, SAMs, AAA - 22x34 campaign map - mission planning, event cards, attack wave layouts, SAM engagement board, airbase cards, rulebook, dice, roundels, chips and more!

name: Euthia: Cruel Frost
creator: Steamforged Games
description: The highly-rated fantasy board game, Euthia, returns with its chilling climax, Cruel Frost! Late pledge now open ❄️

name: Bunny Boom
creator: Guime
description: Bunny Boom is a strategic game of bunny infestation! Manage actions, place cards, and pass the bunnies to your opponents to end the game with the fewest bunnies! 🐰💥

name: Firesiege | Siege-themed board game for 1-4 players
creator: Deer Games Studio
description: Defend your citadel, rally your allies, defeat fearsome bosses and break the enemy siege in this epic tower-defense cooperative game!

name: The Cats of Mont Saint Michel
creator: Raybox Games
description: Become a cat swashbuckler during revolutionary France in this exciting solo/co-op campaign game! Back now and get a free exclusive metal coin.

name: Feudum
creator: Odd Bird
description: Game-of-the-year winner, Feudum is back with the 7th anniversary collector's edition featuring an exclusive clockwork behemoth!  Grrrrrrrrrr.

name: Incubo
creator: Mojito Studios
description: Tommy and his cat Alpha fight their fears and nightmares to save their sister, Nina, kidnapped by the night monsters!

name: 20 Strong: Tanglewoods
creator: Chip Theory Games
description: The next three installments in Chip Theory's solo, quick-playing 20 Strong series! Tanglewoods features a brand new universe and art from Manny Trembley (Dice Throne)!

name: Conquest Princess: Fashion is Power
creator: Fight in a Box
description: Transform for Battle | 1-4 Players | Co-op Bag Builder

name: Agape
creator: Creardo
description:
This is your first day at Agape, the Love Agency where you work. The Boss is very demanding, after all, love is not a Game. Will you prove to be the most capable in the art of making love blossom?"
Observe the details, Listen to the customers' requests, Develop your strategy, sharpen your wit but above all: open your mind and heart. 
Are you ready to prove you are the best new recruit of the Agape Love Agency?

name: Survive Alive
creator: Schnarf Games
description: Manage resources, build facilities, scavenge the map and defend the base against the growing hordes of Zeds in order to Survive Alive.

name: Aetherial War Card Game: Chaos and Consequences Core Set
creator: Nathan E Doverspike
description: A Sci-Fi solo/cooperative RPG Card Game, with elements of deck building, tactical combat and a rewarding legacy feature.

name: Dark Blood
creator: Meeple Pug
description: Dark Blood plunges players into the abyss of darkness, where they embody powerful asymmetrical cults striving for dominance over a hapless village.

name: The Cursed Castle [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description:
Take charge of three hunters walking the forgotten hallways of the Cursed Castle in an attempt to purge the ancient evil that dwells within!

Each round, you'll roll, manipulate, and allocate dice to overcome traps, defeat armies of minions, and vanquish deadly overlords. As your party progresses you'll uncover powerful artifacts, learn new skills, and make game-changing combos to delve deeper into the castle to break its evil curse. But beware, building up your heroes is easier than preserving them in this brutal adventure!

name: OH CRAB!
creator: Smart Flamingo
description: Unique crab-themed board game for families and gamers alike! An original combination of mechanics, strategic depth, and interaction!

name: Button Shy Reprint Campaign Summer 2024
creator: Button Shy Games
description: A reprint of some long lost fan favorite Wallet Games: Death Valley (plus a new standalone full wallet expansion, Death Valley: Highs & Lows), Pizza Pizza Yum Yum and Super Slopes. Backers will vote for other games unlocked during the campaign.

name: 18 HEX GAMES Collection VOL.2
creator: LittleHouseBoardGames
description: Six new backpack games for the 18 Hex Games Collection: Aconteceris, Castle Duel, Dinger Fingers Fl1p0, Molecule & The Many Dungeons.

name: Four Forests
creator: Gold Seal Games
description: Cultivate your forest to attract the most prestigious mythical creatures in this clever card game.

name: DC Super Heroes United
creator: CMON
description: The greatest Heroes in the DC universe unite to thwart the Villains' plans in this fast-paced, family-friendly cooperative game with amazing figures!

name: 1980 Sixtina
creator: Looping_Games
description:
1980 Sixtina is a new game of our "1900 series", where we try to put great stories from the 20th century inside small boxes.
The game recreates the restoration of the great Renaissance frescoes of the Sistine Chapel between 1980 and 1994.

name: Jim Henson's Labyrinth: The Board Game - 40th Anniversary Collection
creator: Mantic Games
description:
Will Sarah manage to defeat Jareth and his Labyrinth, or will the Goblin King turn little Toby into a goblin babe? You have thirteen hours to find out!
Relive your favourite movie with the Collector’s edition of Jim Henson’s Labyrinth: The Board Game! New “Humongous” expansion, exclusive miniatures, revised rules, and a unique box to keep your collection!

name: Terrorscape: Putrefied Enmity
creator: Ice Makes
description: Special expansion to one of the most anticipated games, Terrorscape. A one-vs-many hidden movement board game with classic horror movie vibes. Escape for your life, or enjoy your hunt as the killer!

name: Neko Syndicate
creator: Combo Games
description: Sushi smuggling in a 30 min. tableau building game. Become the new Kumicho!

name: All Time Wrestling: Rumble in Abu Dhabi
creator: Cation Arts
description: All Time Wrestling is back, now with: Rumble Matches and New Legends: Sgt Slaughter, JYD, Kamala, Nick Aldis & more!

name: Mythic Battles: Isfet
creator: Monolith Board Games
description:
Explore Ancient Egypt or Norse Myths, commanding gods, monsters and mortals in this 2-4 player adventure game! New content also available for Mythic Battles: Ragnarök and Pantheon
Now with a Solo Mode!

name: Night Express
creator: Spieltrieb
description: 2-6 players start Companies, bid on trains, hire staff & building clever networks of night train routes. Take a ☕, nightshift begins!

name: Bouquet
creator: Rough Draft Games
description: A game of bees, blossoms, and bluffing, Bouquet is a strategic area control game where competition blooms into beauty!

name: Tenby
creator: Cosy Cub Games
description: An action drafting, street building, feature matching card game for 1 - 5 players, set in the beautiful Welsh seaside town of Tenby.

name: Skytear Horde: Campaigns
creator: Skytear Games
description: Stand-alone expansion of the solo & co-op card-battler that gives you the feeling of competitive TCG's. Play 1-off games or try the new mini-campaigns of 4 connected games for a "rogue-like" experience.

name: Waddle Waddle
creator: Brush-Tail Games LLC
description: Compete with with other Penguin Heroes for the coveted title of Top Conservationist as you tag Waddles of penguins and their nests in the Antarctic Region in this game filled with the designer's own beautiful photographs of penguins in the wild. Crowdfunding is complete!  Waddle Waddle is now available at brushtailgames.com

name: Cryptid Cafe: The Chef's Apprentice
creator: Squatchy Games
description: Welcome to Cryptid Cafe: The Chef’s Apprentice! This standalone game is set in the same universe as the popular Cryptid Cafe. This time around, instead of serving customers in the front-of-house, we’ll be venturing into the back-of-house, where players will take command of their cryptid line cook with aspirations of becoming a chef someday. However, before putting on that glorious white chef’s hat, they must first become…The Chef’s Apprentice.

name: Elden Ring: The Board Game - Stretch Pay PM
creator: Steamforged Games
description: Arise, ye Tarnished! Let us walk this new path together...

name: Children of Morta: The Board Game
creator: Roomiz Games
description: A fast-paced, co-op, shared bag-building adventure about a family of guardians standing united against corruption!

name: Final Strike
creator: Looking For Greatness
description: Forge a deck. Steal a kill. Take the glory!

name: HEXplore It: The Mountains of Godai
creator: mjdesigns
description: For too long we have angered the gods and lived our lives with reckless abandon! For those mistakes, the whole of existence is on the brink of collapse. Jaethi, the great plumed serpent of the wind has returned and brought with her countless elemental armies. She is one of the five great Titans and her power has kept the Wellspring flowing since time immemorial. For reasons only known to the gods, she returns to destroy the fabric of our reality, disassembling the Patterns of all things. If she succeeds, our universe will collapse and all that we are will be gone — scoured clean and rebalanced by her wind.

name: Okinawa: The Last Battle of World War II [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: You’re on the island of Okinawa, and this is the last battle of World War II. The fighting is intense; the casualties are high. And now it’s up to you to lead your soldiers to victory using dice to activate and upgrade actions on your rondel as you capture objectives, defeat the enemy, and save the day!

name: Under our Sun
creator: TABLETOPPER GAMES
description: Under our Sun is a fully-cooperative or semi-cooperative exploration board game set in a post-apocalyptic world where life is at the mercy of the sun. One to four (six with expansion) players embark on an adventure, assume the role of survivor, and join forces to reach a common goal. Players beware... everyone might not have the same goal in mind.

name: Renters + Parking Expansion (Print & Play)
creator: Titan Boardgames
description: Renters, is a roll & write boardgame in which we will have to host groups of up to 5 people in our building, according to a roll of the dice. But our building requires repair the elevator, air conditioning and wifi.

name: Propuh
creator: InterHuman games
description:
Every Slavic grandmother's nightmare!

Propuh is a trick-taking survival board game where you face one of the most "terrible" Slavic superstitions! For one and two players!

name: The Adventures of Conan
creator: GF9
description: Join Conan and his allies as they battle across the Hyborian Age, where darkness plagues the land. In this asymmetrical dice game, the legendary barbarian will battle monsters sent by his foes, whilst his allies battle by his side. Can Conan ascend to become King, or will he fall to his enemies foul plots?

name: Masters of the Universe: Battleground
creator: Archon Studio
description: Masters of the Universe: Battleground is a skirmish miniature game for two to four players, where forces of good and evil clash in epic combat. This glorious battle will shake the earth and change the fate of Eternia!

name: Operation Barclay
creator: SaltandPepper
description: Operation Barclay is a two-player game of low/medium complexity about the intelligence war between the Allies and their Abwehr counterparts in the Mediterranean theater in 1942-1943.

name: Plutocracy: Passengers
creator: Doppeldenkspiele
description: A fast-playing pick-up and deliver board game in a rotating universe where space is time is money is power. Expanded by passenger transport, favors and a captivating solo mode.

name: Stupor Mundi
creator: Quined Games
description: Stupor Mundi is a strategic euro-style game for 1 to 4 players by author Nestore Mangone, full of exciting and original mechanisms, with plenty of interaction, solid gameplay and tension.

name: Tabletop Inc.
creator: Cotswold Games
description: Tabletop Inc is a worker placement style game for 1 to 6 players. Take on the role of board game creators competing to build the greatest board games in the world.

name: Thorgal: The card game
creator: Lucrum Studio
description: Thorgal: Card Game, where strategy meets destiny in a thrilling card-based adventure

name: Air Raid 36/46-Expansion: Bombers!
creator: Babek Amelizadeh

name: Backpack Panda

description: Venture into a vibrant bamboo world and brace yourself for betrayal in this 4-8 player social deduction game for panda lovers.

name: The Secrets of Zorro - Cooperative Board Game
creator: Double Combo Games

name: Flick Solitaire Mini Card Decks by Independent Artists
creator: Flick Solitaire
description: Exclusive mini playing cards from the Flick mobile game by artists including Explosm: Cyanide & Happiness and The Awkward Yeti!

name: Dance of Muses - A Charming Pure Strategy Board Game
creator: Space Otter Publishing
description: A competitive 1 to 4 players abstract game where you have to control the value of your dice by making the 9 Muses dance.

name: Agemonia Reprint + New Heroes!
creator: Lautapelit.fi
description: From the publisher of Eclipse, a fully co-operative board game with challenging moral choices, set in an epic campaign for 1-4 players!

name: Timelancers - Time Travel Board Game
creator: Party Tails
description: Become a freelance time-traveler revising history in this sci-fi steampunk board game. Timelancers is a time travel themed set collection board game that utilizes worker movement, resource management, tableau building, contracts, and a modular game board. Players gather resources and travel back through time collecting real historical events to earn victory points and outscore their opponents.

name: The Eternaut - the board game
creator: Pendragon Game Studio srl
description: A 1-5 players survival board game set amidst an alien invasion in the heart of Buenos Aires.

name: Mysticana: A Foundation Deck - from Button Shy Games
creator: Button Shy Games
description:
Mysticana is a Foundation Deck: an 18-card deck that includes multiple core games using just the base cards with even more games added through small expansions. The deck features cards numbered 1-6 across 3 suits (elements) which have a “rock-paper-scissors” hierarchy. While each game might make use of the deck’s design in different ways, the flexible foundation enables new games to fit in seamlessly alongside previous entries.

The base deck includes rules for three core games: Nine Perils, Sorcerers' Showdown, and The Path Ahead. Two additional expansion games, Cave of Djinns and Arcane Artifacts, are available in this campaign. More expansions will come out over the course of a year.

name: Cat Sushi Masters
creator: MDV | Norby
description: An all ages card based game that will turn you into hungry cats ready to dive on tons of...Catilicious sushi! 🐈🍣

name: A.I.Pokalypse - the Auto Battle Card Game
creator: Owly Moly Games
description: Big Game, Small Box! Fast-paced + endless combos. 🌟 Competitive, solo & coop; simultaneous gameplay; 200+ cards. 🤖 Up to 8 players, no downtime! 🦾

name: Mad Match-Up
creator: UNDERTREEGAMES
description: Welcome to Mad Match-Up, Mad Match-Up is a fast-paced card game where players strive to be the first to get rid of all their cards through strategic matching and blocking maneuvers. Set in a jungle theme, the game incorporates elements of pattern recognition and tactical play.

name: Escape Deathrace 2182 "Micro" LS Edition
creator: GoodDays Games
description: A tile placing, race car themed, dungeon-crawl board game for 1 to 4 players set in the cyber-tech, 22nd century.

name: World of Kilforth: The Fantasy Quest Games
creator: Hall or Nothing Productions Ltd
description: Return to the stunning oceans of Kilforth! Missed the Kickstarter? Heed the call, and explore the beautiful southern seas to defend Kilforth from the deadly Ancients...

name: Neon Reign

description: Neon Reign is a fast-paced card game that combines the excitement of arcade-style fighting games with strategic dueling!

name: Steam Power

name: Hunted: Mining Colony 415 (2nd Edition) [Solo Game of the Month]

name: Burn the Witch

name: PLACES-Bid

description: Outwit opponents for the most valuable portfolio of buildings, projects, and tokens through strategic bidding, collecting, and assembling.

Will you strive to unite the fractured kingdom, securing the throne through a combination of conquest and diplomacy? Alternatively, will you succumb to dark covenants, tempted by promises of power that threaten to consume your kingdom?

name: Those Who Dare: Founder's Edition
creator: Friends of the Table
description: The Stone to Space Age RPG. Those Who Dare is an exciting new TTRPG system. Play in any era of human history, or our future, with fast-paced action scenes and rich storytelling mechanics. TWD is the perfect game for roleplayers looking to make their own historic fiction.

name: Corps of Discovery
creator: Jay Cormier

Each shadowy figure uses money, power and influence to steer the course of multiple factions toward their own inscrutable ends. Gray Eminence does not pretend to observe political correctness or historical accuracy but rather aims to induce discussion about the world we live in. We suggest that all events in the game are plausible and event resolution options are within the range of real-world possibilities. We do not, however, pretend that our event resolution options cover all possible eventualities -  If you find that you end up discussing event resolution options we didn’t list, that would count as a success in terms of our game design.

Board&Dice designs, develops, and publishes family and strategy board games.
We aim to make interesting, deep and diverse games, each being a unique experience, and each sporting its own flavor and an engaging theme.

creator: Fantasmagoria Games LLC
description: A competitive, fast paced, strategic deck builder, which combines map construction, hero and area control and unique calendar mechanics.

description: Your actions influence the Bosses' turns. Dice or Cards. Welcome to true Souls-like intensity.

name: Hunted: Wode Ridge 2E [Solo Game of the Month]
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: Take on the role of a group of kids and their newfound alien friend, and explore Wode Ridge looking for evidence of the town’s supernatural happenings. But be wary, the Darkness knows you’re on to it, so it’ll be trying to get you before you get it.

name: Terraforming Mars: The Legacy of Mars
creator: Stronghold Games
description: Terraforming Beyond Mars! Mankind has finally dragged itself out of the hole that is Earth’s gravity well, and now has the entire solar system at its feet. We are now ready to take terraforming – the true legacy of Mars – to new worlds! The Legacy of Mars is a fully replayable campaign.

name: Mïnomancer - The Roll & Write Dungeon Crawler [Dynamic PnP of the Month & Gamebook]
creator: Beaverlicious Games
description: Mïnomancer: Roll Them Bones! is a solitaire Roll & Write game chronicling your invasion into the domain of a rival necromancer.

name: Disfida
creator: giochix
description: Four factions, one battlefield — relive the legendary knight duels of the 16th century!

name: The Quest Kids: Giant Adventure
creator: Treasure Falls Games
description: A life-sized dungeon crawler for 2-5 players ages 5+ (2nd Edition)

name: Hitman: The Board Game
creator: MOOD Publishing
description: A 1-4 player competitive board game where success depends on improvisation, creativity, and surgical precision. Travel the world, infiltrate exotic locations, and eliminate high-profile targets - but this time, you won't be alone. Other agents have also been assigned the contract, and they’ll stop at nothing to sabotage your mission and deliver the killing blow. Guns blazing or silent assassin? The choice is yours...

name: KO
creator: AlienS games
description:
Blood, sweat and tears to get to this moment. The moment for which you have been training and receiving blows all your life. You have engraved in fire all those phrases that your coach has told you so many times and now he is shouting at you again from your corner... A world champion is a boxer who never gives up. Who overcomes himself by getting up when he can't do it anymore and keeps on punching until he wins! It's now or never. It's your moment. It's... Your Fight Of The Century.
FREE EXPANSION: KO LEGENDS... FOR FOLLOWING THE PROYECT
(15€ AT PLEDGE MANAGER)

name: Catacombs - A Catventure Game
creator: Catacombs
description:
Catacombs is a cooperative adventure game featuring dice-rolling mechanics and procedurally generated dungeons, where you play as a hero venturing into the darkness of a catacombs to slay and defeat evil. All characters are cats. 

It’s designed for 1–4 players, with a playtime of around 30 to 120 minutes.

Game will be available in 5 languages - English, Polish, Spanish, German and French.

name: Restart
creator: Teetotum Game Studios
description: Travel back in time to change the course of events and save your future. Build your engine, create card combos and complete pattern missions in this tactical, competitive game.

name: Sudden Conflict
creator: Sudden Conflict Games
description: A multiverse on the edge of annihilation. Sudden Conflict is an aggressive miniatures skirmish game for 2–4 players. Build a team of characters from across multiple colliding realities, master their unique abilities, and fight across battlefields where every decision matters.

name: Zombicide: Dead Men Tales
creator: Fantasy Flight Games
description: Fantasy Zombicide is back, and this time it’s a pirate invasion! Dead Men Tales brings the hugely popular Zombicide gameplay to paradisiacal pirate islands, where gold is plentiful and grom flows freely. Command crews of humans, orcs, elves, and more as you face off against relentless zombie hordes. Fire cannons, swing from ropes, and fight for survival as the undead attack from every direction, including the sea itself! Dive even deeper into the fantasy world with Black Plague Comics Vol. 2 and the Plaguebearer Roleplaying Game for an even more immersive experience. All of this comes to life with the stunning artwork and miniatures you know and love from Zombicide!

name: Gal4Xeon: A 4X roll and write game
creator: Eurydice Games Ltd
description: Conquer the galaxy! Gal4Xeon is a print and play roll and write game where you explore, expand, exploit and exterminate your way to victory. Playable solo and with any number of friends!

name: Tamashii: The Final Amendment
creator: Awaken Realms
description: Tamashii: The Final Amendment is a cooperative adventure experience for 1-4 players set in a unique universe of a post-apocalyptic cyberpunk world ruled by AI.

name: Claustrophobia 1692
creator: Devir
description: Claustrophobia 1692. The legendary dungeon crawl returns—stronger, darker, and more dangerous than ever. Follow this pre-campaign page to be on top of everything related to this phenomenal comeback.

name: Sports Poker
creator: Sports Poker
description: Don't just Watch the Game - Play the Game with Sports Poker!

name: Jersey New Jersey & A Strong War
creator: Form Square Games
description: These are two standalone games, the first uses the 'Limits of Glory' system to examine two different campaigns of the American Revolution. The second is a completely new design covering the entire French and Indian War.

name: SYLT
creator: Björn Burow
description: SYLT is a weather-based deck-building game for 1–4 players, developed by a true North German and his team with a deep love for the island. Roll the dice to determine the island weather, visit places and discover the island, carry out activities to collect island points. But only if the weather cooperates! Become the island champion.

name: Dusk Runners
creator: Dragonmount Press
description: Welcome to Dusk Runners, a cooperative roguelike deckbuilder, set in a torn apart world of years long days and nights ruled by death. Take up the role of Dusk Runners, survivors and explorers who stay a few steps ahead of the night. Gather forgotten technologies so powerful they look like magic, battle monsters in the night to get stronger, make allies or enemies of survivor factions and learn ancient secrets in order to defeat the ultimate threat of the darkness: the Nightstalker.

name: Symphony Of Gods
creator: SOGames
description: This small-scale project, led by an entirely French team, will not be translated into English for this first version. Funding is therefore only available in French

name: Balkanika: Safira's Escape
creator: Running Children
description: "A player-driven, storytelling adventure where every play is an open-ended experience of the world, characters, and its mysteries."

name: Chants for the Old Ones: The Eye of Dagon & New Orders Reckoning
creator: Invedars
description:
This new edition for Chants for the Old Ones brings the cult to a whole new level.
Discover The Eye of Dagon, an expansion filled with Deep Ones, Hybrids, and lurking creatures beneath the reef. Unlock unique powers in The New Orders, where asymmetrical cults pursue their own sinister goals. Experience the fully revised and enhanced Second Edition of the core game—with upgraded components and refined mechanics.

name: Microrama Collection
creator: Juegorama
description:
Microrama Collection is a set of four standalone solo games, each offering a rich thematic experience in a compact box. Whether you're managing a doomed convoy in a post-apocalyptic desert, leading a noble guild through political intrigue, navigating alien corridors in deep space, or fighting for survival in a neon-lit cyberpunk city — each game delivers intense, focused gameplay in just 20–40 minutes.

All games are solo-first, fast to set up, and easy to store.

name: Bantam West (2E + Solo/Co-op)
creator: Bantam Planet
description: Bantam West (2nd Edition) is a competitive open-world role-playing game where you work, fight, build, trade, and burn your way across the Lone Range to become the Most Notorious! With the new Graves of Gold expansion, play with 1 to 5 players and dig into an undiscovered world under the map. Search for relics and riches, but beware of cultists and horrible creatures that lurk below. In a world where the source of gold has been lost to time, will you be the first to rediscover it?

name: Terra Mystica Special Edition
creator: Steamforged Games
description: Gamefound Exclusive! The ultimate edition of one of the highest rated board games of all time — welcome to the award-winning world of Terra Mystica.

name: Puppet Master: Return to Bodega Bay Inn Miniatures Board Game
creator: Dynamite Entertainment
description: Explore the old hotel while avoiding the killer puppets and learn how to defeat them before they resurrect their master and destroy you all.

name: Dungeon  Up + Below & Inferno Expansions (Print & Play)
creator: Titan Boardgames
description:
Dungeon Up is a dungeon crawler game in which you must escape from a dungeon by climbing to the surface. Fight monsters, bosses, and final bosses. Collect gems and treasures to upgrade your hero, activate skills, and use potions, and don't forget to escape with great rewards.

Dungeon Up doesn't come alone; it comes with two expansions, Below and Inferno, which add ghosts, secret chambers and new rooms, curses, new abilities, curses, new enemies, more characters, and a campaign mode.

name: Tower Defense: Heroes of the Wildlands
creator: One Page Creations
description: Welcome to a thrilling tower defense adventure! Draft unique heroes, strategically place them along multiple paths to create powerful ambushes. Unleash mighty spells from your spellbook to turn the tide of battle. With tons of heroes to choose from and multiple maps, every game offers a fresh and unique challenge. Your decision-making is key: while drafting heroes to protect your routes, those not selected will turn against you as enemies, determined to reach and destroy your tower. Adapt your strategy and protect your tower at all costs!

name: Exodus from Reynoldsworld Roll & Write
creator: Eurydice Games Ltd
description: Reynoldsworld is under threat from an encroaching alien armada. Millions of people need to be somewhere else. Fast. You must build an ark and ferry the population and the supplies they need to nearby habitable worlds. Will you be remembered as the saviour of Reynoldsworld? Or will you end up the lead character in an unflattering holodrama? Exodus is a 1-6 player print at home roll & write game in which you design a ship and then brave dangerous space to save a planet full of people!

name: Tavern of Thieves
creator: Hear Me Out Games
description:
Tavern of Thieves is a competitive card game for 3–6 players, where you take on the role of a cunning thief trying to outwit and outmaneuver your rivals to steal the most loot from unsuspecting patrons.

Choose your actions wisely—gain the upper hand, sabotage your opponents, and keep an eye on the rising suspicion in the tavern. One wrong move could blow your cover.

name: Vacations to Greek Islands
creator: Teetotum Game Studios
description: Summer in Greece is full of beach, fun and food experiences. Do you want to live it? Take a three-day vacation to a Greek island and have the time of your life.

name: One Page Naval Battles
creator: One Page Creations
description: One-page, print&play, card driven tactical game with dice about naval battles from world war 2.

name: Paw by Paw
creator: Teetotum Game Studios
description: Your dog is scratching at the front door because it is time for another walk in the park. Try to make it as fun as possible, but also avoid the temptations your dog might encounter.

name: Building Assets for Inkarnate
creator: Benjamin Weisz
description: During this campaign, you can primarily acquire digital assets that can be used with Inkarnate. Of course, these assets can also be used with other map-making programs.

name: F1 Roll & Race + 3 Expansions (Print & Play)
creator: Titan Boardgames
description: Race on the most famous circuits, drive cars with different skills, get upgrades, prevent breakdowns & races in championships. Add more circuits and weather events with the expansions.

name: Leviathan Wilds Second Printing (Plus Deepvale Expansion!)
creator: Moon Crab Games
description: Leviathan Wilds is a solo and co-op, boss-battling board game about climbing and saving massive creatures. Created by former Fantasy Flight Games and Z-Man Games developers.

name: Blast
creator: Urbantek
description: Prepare for an adrenaline-pumping experience as BB Blast brings the heart-pounding intensity of real-world airsoft battles to your tabletop! Get ready for a fast-paced, strategic showdown that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

name: Nova Aetas Renaissance - The Last chance
creator: Ludus Magnus Studio
description: Nova Aetas Renaissance is an atypical dungeon crawler for 1-6 players. 10.000 copies sold, 4 years of development, a non-linear epic campaign with 7 different endings, 46 missions, side quests and hunts, 9 different heroes, dozens of enemies, over 90 amazing miniatures, 3D buildings, and... much more! Explore lands, and cities of Renaissance Italy, evolve your hero, and rewrite history!

name: raiders of the color compass
creator: raidersofthecolorcompass
description: Unique adventure one page Roll and Write (chose&color) puzzle game with cthulhu and lost scape crew rethemes

name: Rocky 'Roid Roll & Write
creator: Eurydice Games Ltd
description:
Rocky 'Roid is an asteroid-mining roll and write game that you can print at home. All you need to play is a player sheet and pen per player and 3 six-sided dice.
In the first half of the game you use the shared dice to survey the belt moving and mining. Once you think you have enough minerals, race home to catch the market at its peak - each time a player sells a mineral the price decreases for everyone else!
Who can earn the most?

name: Temple of Horrors 2.0
creator: giochix
description: A mighty artifact is hidden in a forgotten temple: will you be able to find it by overcoming the pitfalls and monsters that guard it? Temple of Horrors is an innovative dungeon crawler that mixes Euro and American game elements and includes 100+ Adventures!

name: Rise of the Necromancers
creator: Mythic Games
description: Choose your Necromancer, recruit your Apprentice, and venture forth! Raise eternal armies, conquer cities and levy taxes paid in corpses, explore dungeons and claim the title of Headmaster of four great Necromantic Academies. The first player place their last Dominion counter wins!

name: Lone Wolf: Vengeance of the Kai
creator: Holmgard Games
description: Enter the world of Lone Wolf!  Relive the epic saga read by millions, re-imagined as an asymmetrical 2-player strategy game filled with heroic champions, climactic battles, tense trade-offs and dire consequences.  The war for Magnamund begins!

name: The Rise of Nerath: A Mythralis Chronicle
creator: Mythralis
description:
The Rise of Nerath: A Mythralis Chronicle is a 1–6 player cooperative and competitive strategy board game set in a dark, post-cataclysmic fantasy world.
Build your party from unique factions, unlock divine powers, face branching narrative quests, and engage in tactical combat using customizable action cards and powerful miniatures.

Featuring a scenario-driven campaign, deep progression systems, asymmetric abilities, and rich replayability, The Rise of Nerath offers an epic game experience where every decision echoes through the world of Mythralis.

name: HERBAL DIALECT - TAKE YOUR SKILLS TO THE DIRT! - CARD GAME - RELEASE -
creator: Herbal Dialect
description: Herbal Dialect turns Agriculture to a Strategy Card Game best suited for 2-4 Players ages 6+. Try Learning the Basics to Growing Common & Rare Plants, Play Head to Head Games Against Your Friends, Or Challenge Others to Take Their Skills to the Dirt and Grow Their Own Collection Before Their Eyes.

name: Shatterfields
creator: WBS Lighthouse
description: A return to the RTS warfare you loved, reborn on the tabletop. Build your base, command your forces, and dominate the battlefield in a collapsing future.

name: REPLICANTS
creator: REPLICANTS Game
description: REPLICANTS is a confrontation and strategy game in which you play biomechanical creatures, the Replicants, battling each other in an arena.

name: Farwald: Fallen Gods
creator: Luca Amonti
description: A Tactical Dark Fantasy Card Game. Shatter the Essence of the Gods in a high-interaction duel where strategy beats luck. No TCG, No boosters - just pure power.

name: The Realm of Silvanus
creator: The Realm Of Silvanus
description: The Realm of Silvanus is a family fantasy board game where you explore a magical forest, collect powerful creature cards, and build your temple with crystals to claim victory.

name: Altered - Roots of Corruption
creator: Equinox
description: Explore Altered as you’ve never seen it before in Roots of Corruption, a bold and dark new expansion for Altered TCG. Drive back the darkness, accomplish heroic feats and collect exclusive corrupted card treatments.

name: Lords of the South Slavs - Roll & Write
creator: Stoj Games
description: A strategic roll & write set in the medieval Balkans. Expand your city, gain power, and resist the Ottoman threat.

name: Scattered Nexus: Solis War
creator: Slim Studio
description: Stand-alone, Expandable, battle card game. Usually featuring real-world indie comics, but this time we are partnering with our friends at Solis to feature their indie card game in our card game.

name: Goldrush 1850
creator: WaldeGames
description: Players must outsmart opponents and strike it rich by navigating shifting opportunities in a high-stakes race for gold.

name: QuantumZap
creator: CowboyCactusGames
description: A card-based game of bluffing and bidding over 5 rounds, where players develop land and chase riches⚡or ruin 💀.

name: The Malice of Light Adventures
creator: Twin Tale Studios
description: A cooperative roguelike boss-battler by the Sadler Bros. set in The Malice of Light.

name: Crossroads Wargame 'Principalities and Powers'
creator: Akamu Prints
description: A skirmish wargame between disparate forces of mankind, formidable alien species, and mysterious fae creatures. Set untold millennia into the future, when various human empires struggle to cope with the annihilation of Eden.

name: Falcon's Formula Racing - Relaunch
creator: FALCON GAMES
description: Pick your team, qualify for the race, choose your tires, and place your two drivers on the grid. Race to win in an exciting 1–6 player game driven by real motorsport elements.

name: Gdynia 1926
creator: Gdynia1926
description: Gdynia 1926 to kooperacyjna gra planszowa, w której gracze wspólnymi siłami próbują zbudować port i przyległe do niego miasto. Rozwój metropolii jest dynamiczny, w grze znajdziemy liczne ciekawostki historyczne, a sama rozgrywka będzie cieszyła nie tylko dzięki wysokiej grywalności, ale też dopracowanym w szczegółach estetycznym wydaniu.

name: The Stone of Madness - Dicefall
creator: Undigital
description: Step into the monastery like never before. Take on the role of one of five prisoners, each haunted by fear and madness, and work together to outwit the Inquisition, survive your own phobias, and uncover the dark secrets hidden within the walls. Inspired by the acclaimed video game, The Stone of Madness – Dicefall brings the tension, the suspense, and the psychological challenge straight to your tabletop.

name: Stefan Feld City Collection
creator: QueenGames
description: Experience the whole City Collection!

name: Dribble 'n' Dice
creator: Runner Games
description: A fast, tactical football board game driven by dice and strategic choices.

name: soccerone
creator: soccerone-official.com
description:
Gioco dell'anno. Il gioco da tavolo del calcio minuto per minuto. Soccerone è la simulazione di calcio da tavolo ideale per i veri appassionati. Costruisci la tua formazione, gestisci le riserve, usa le tue carte e ottieni la vittoria con strategia, visione e conoscenza del mondo reale.
Caratteristiche principali:
Realismo tattico: formazioni, fuorigioco, calci di punizione.
Gestione tecnica: falli, cartellini gialli, sostituzioni.
Partite da 40 minuti regolabili.
Regole semplici ma approfondite.

Non siamo una casa editrice di giochi da tavolo che si scervella per dare i propri meravigliosi giochi. Amiamo il calcio. E abbiamo trovato il modo per viverlo sul tavolo. Vogliamo avere con noi altri appassionati.


Game of the Year. The minute-by-minute soccer board game. Soccerone is the ideal tabletop soccer simulation for true fans. Build your formation, manage your reserves, use your cards, and achieve victory with strategy, vision, and real-world knowledge. 
Key features:
Tactical realism: formations, offsides, free kicks.
Technical management: fouls, yellow cards, substitutes.
Adjustable 40-minute matches.
Simple yet in-depth rules.

We're not a board game publisher racking our brains to create wonderful games. We love football. And we've found a way to live the soccer on the table. We want other fans to join us.

name: THE FAMILY DECK — Indestructible Mafia-Themed Poker Playing Cards
creator: PaPaGaming
description:
A premium mafia-themed poker playing card deck inspired by classic crime families.
Crafted from an advanced reinforced PET composite, offering superior durability, waterproof protection, and a refined premium feel.
Designed for poker players who demand strength, style, and a bold atmosphere at the table.

name: The Travel Bug Card Game
creator: DominoTracks
description:
Travel delays happen- how you handle them impacts your travel experience. Can you weather the storm to reach your destination?

In The Travel Bug Card Game, players learn to navigate the highs and lows of travel while booking destination experiences. Want to explore the Great Pyramid?- you'll need a passport, visa, two flights, ground transport, and two entry passes! Visiting the Smithsonian in DC- that's just two flights and ground transport. Most destination points wins!

name: Toki & Bloki – A Family Card Game About Emotions & Trust
creator: Markus Goffin
description:
Toki & Bloki is a family-friendly card game that helps children and adults talk about emotions, trust, and the digital world.

Easy to learn, quick to play, and fun for all ages — it feels like stepping into a playful version of the blockchain together.

name: Live or Di(c)e
creator: BromagineBoardgame
description: A fast-paced, high-energy game with zombies and dice. Who will build the safest base? And who will be dragged away by the zombie hordes?

name: Essentia 21
creator: KO_Games
description: 4 potions. 1 dé magique. 21 catalyseurs pour gagner. La soirée commence. ✨

name: Ascendant Blades: Wuxia Skirmish
creator: Prismnrune
description: Enter the world of Ascendant Blades: Wuxia Skirmish, A cinematic wuxia skirmish game with tactical duels, heroic warriors, and fast, high-risk martial arts combat.

name: Gooooal!!!
creator: HenMar Games
description: An exciting, fast-paced football game for 2 to 12 players

name: Strife and Valor
creator: Green Eyed Angel LTD
description: Strife and Valor is a duel format, strategy board game. In the game you have to navigate a chess-like board in order to reach your opponent’s leader and defeat them using an asymmetric deck of cards, units and a leader. Take on the role of a mighty leader and defeat your opponent!

name: Dead Man's Chess - Print & Play STLs
creator: Three Knights Games
description:
Dead Man’s Chess takes the elegance of classic chess and fuses it with asymmetric factions, card-driven abilities, and dynamic board control. This campaign delivers the entire game digitally — no physical manufacturing, no shipping — just instant access to all 3D models and printable components.

Everything you need comes as downloadable files. Print at home. Play on your table. Or bring the assets into your favorite virtual tabletop.

name: Tasuo World: Draconian Rise: V:1: Wyvern Ways
creator: Tasuo Showdown LLC
description: Tasuo World CCG is the game that brings cardboard combat to life! Join the showdown. This set features a thrilling new era for "Wyvern Players" and game-changing support for veteran "Tasuo Warriors". This spectacular set showcases 120 unique cards that focus on the Tale of Wun Lotus, the first dragon sage.

name: Gond Dabar - The Age of War
creator: Pirata Games
description:
The Age of War is a tactical battle game set in the world of Gond Dabar. Choose your faction, build your force, and fight on modular hex battlefields where every turn is about movement, timing, and decisive strikes. Play quick skirmishes or larger battles, and create your own matchups again and again.
To help you learn, the game also includes a first guided campaign designed as a tutorial, with progressive scenarios to practice the rules, master key tactics, and build confidence before jumping into fully custom battles.

name: Light and Darkness
creator: kopergames
description: Assemble your team, sign a contract and embark on a journey full of dangers, random locations and chance encounters. Face the challenges you encounter, fight monsters, acquire treasures, hunt animals, pay for services and trade. Take risks and explore ruins, mines, caves or undergrounds.

name: Helpdesk Hero
creator: Nostra Forja
description: Helpdesk Hero is a humorous card game inspired by our own real-life experiences working in technical support over the years. Players step into the world of IT heroes, dealing with stupid clients, weird tickets, and unexpected events, all while trying to keep productivity high.

name: Pubes
creator: Xeel
description:
Pubes is a card game based on the public (also known as civil) service. 
You are a brave cog in the mighty machine of public service, valiantly tasked with completing projects while fending off bureaucracy, micromanagement, and good old-fashioned sheer bloody-mindedness.
Each project comes with a stack of task cards—some helpful, some downright diabolical—that must be tackled to see the project through. You'll also encounter special cards that let you pull off clever maneuvers, and blocker cards designed to thwart the hopes and dreams of your rivals (or at least slow them down a bit).
But beware: other players are lurking, ever eager to swoop in and bask in the glory of your project’s success. After all, what’s a little backstabbing among civil servants?

The Purrrfect gift for the Pubes in your life.

name: BLOOD AND SKULLS: THE CRUCIBLE
creator: Nocturna
description: A Narrative RPG with Miniatures. Adventures, tactical combat, and moral choices.

name: Joe Ravioli: The Cheesiest ImPASTA  "Underworld Empire"
creator: i-Create
description:
Who is Joe Ravioli?

He’s the Cheesiest imPASTA, a compulsive gambler who owes too much dough to the Mozzarella Family. After betting it all on a losing horse at the Tortellini Racetrack, Joe’s debt has risen faster than yeast in a hot oven. Now the Mozzarella Family has put out a Calzone Contract and sent the Meatball Gang to drag him back “al dente.”

Your mission?
Help Joe stay one step ahead in the Underworld Empire of New York City, using disguises, allies, and pure ravioli luck to survive. Balance risk and reward, gamble for Respect Points (RP), and dodge crises as the Five Boroughs heat up.

Can Joe win back Carmella Cannoli’s heart, pay off his debts, and escape the family stew… or will he end up boiled head-first in tomato sauce?

name: ArtPieces Jigsaw Puzzles
creator: Iconic Creations
description:
ArtPieces is a premiuim jigsaw puzzle series.
Each ArtPieces puzzle is a collaboration with talented artists from around the world.

name: Joust King's Tournament (Collector's Box)
creator: Rogue Pioneer Games
description: A head-to-head sports game where players Joust to become the King's Champion. Included is Joust Cavalry and Chivalry a 2-6 player arena game where players will charge on the battlefield trying to defeat every Knight to be the last Knight standing.

name: Crown and War
creator: DioGames
description: Crown and War is a strategy board game set in the 19th century, a time when powerful European houses clashed for dominance in a rapidly changing world. As the leader of your faction, you'll command epic land and sea battles, forge crucial alliances, and expand your influence across the globe. Will you rise to power, or be outmaneuvered by your rivals? In this competitive game, players vie to conquer new territories, control critical sea routes, develop advanced technologies, and navigate unpredictable global events. With unique faction abilities and streamlined yet immersive combat mechanics, Crown and War delivers an engaging and fun experience, combining deep strategy with exciting gameplay in every decision you make.

name: Wizard Bar Fight
creator: EvilWizardGaming
description: Wizard Bar Fight is a multiplayer card game where you and your friends duke it out to see who's the top dog. A quick fire wizarding brawl. The card game to end all barfights. Sling spells, objects and in a pinch just cast fist!

name: Kingdoms of Arkanis
creator: ALANS_GAMES
description: The realm shall not fall to chaos — a new king must rise through battle. Let the Brawl of the Clans begin.

name: Erra - Resistance
creator: OakGames
description: Welcome to the World of Erra!

name: Save Us All
creator: SKGD-Création
description: Save Us All will immerse you in the heart of a small South Korean town ravaged by a mysterious epidemic.

name: Return of the Living Dead's Zombie Punk Panic
creator: Evil Genius Games
description:
In Zombie Punk Panic, you and your punk rock friends are partying in the graveyard when zombies start to pour out of the ground. You and your friends have until daylight to get out of the graveyard alive.  Enjoy this dynamic dice roller, boss battler game from Evil Genius Games. 

Outrun the Dead. Cause Mayhem. Survive.

name: Sepulchre -- A Grave Game
creator: Raven Portents
description:
Cemeteries are competitive spaces, and Sepulchre is the game that proves it.
Start with a skull and embark on the quest to build skeletons in your grave. The first player to fill their grave wins, but victory is far from guaranteed.
Sepulchre is a modular card-based board game for 2 to 4 players. Keeping a tight balance of strategy and the luck of the draw, Sepulchre is a highly competitive game that encourages aggressive tactics where the tides of fortune can turn dramatically. 
Sepulchre – A Grave Game awaits your table.

name: Fanorona-Tsivy from Solid Hardwood
creator: Archaic Games
description: Fanorona-Tsivy is the most common version of Fanorona, a traditional two-player strategy board game native to Madagascar, dating back to the 17th century. Played with 22 pieces each, it involves capturing opponent's pieces by moving either toward or away from them. The game is played on a unique board of intersecting lines with 45 points, where players must make a capture if possible.

name: The Pawn's Gambit: A chess card game
creator: David Melo
description: It’s chess with a twist of cards! Same classic objective:  Win the game by checkmating all rivals or being the last player with a surviving king. Playable with up to 6 players for a chaotic, strategic showdown!

name: VANEA: Guardians of the Eldertree
creator: Forgotten Tales
description:
Welcome to VANEA. A mystical and fairytale world. This game takes place in the ElderForest. You are a Guardian of the ElderTree and must defend it against scary monsters, bosses and the spreading darkmoon rot.

Explore the ElderForest. Collect 6 different elemental orbs to master all of these elementals. Find magical orbs to learn new abilities and collect ore to craft powerful and legendary equipment. Hunt these monsters and also get your powerful elemental companion.

name: Get F***d in the Wild West
creator: Deadwood Games
description: Get ready to saddle up and screw over your friends—Get F***d in the Wild West is a fast, filthy 4X game where backstabbing equals bragging rights. Your objective is to gain Pioneer Points, or have the last Pioneer standing.

name: Elemental Dominion
creator: Norlys Tabletop Studio
description: Elemental Dominion is a party card game where you will try to summon all warriors of your element to beat your opponents and beat the game

name: Mission Amazonia
creator: Verein Spielen & Lernen
description: Ihr seid ein brasilianisches Team von Regenwald-Beschützer:innen. Von eurem Hauptquartier aus startet ihr Missionen nördlich und südlich des Amazonas, um illegale Abholzung, Wilderei und Flussvergiftung einzudämmen. Es beginnt ein Wettlauf gegen die Zeit: Könnt ihr als Team eure Fähigkeiten und Mittel so einsetzen, dass Artensterben und Abholzung gestoppt werden?

name: Saving the City
creator: Darkkena
description:
The city's development plan has failed. The state of some neighboring areas has become unacceptable, and public discontent is at an all-time high. To address the problem, the city administration has devised a solution.
Take on the task of transforming the degraded outskirts into a magnificent urban park. Create the ideal space that satisfies your sponsors, residents, and the administration. Plan your strategy carefully and hire the most suitable workers before others do. Build the structures that best fit your vision and leave your mark on history... by saving the city

name: Regents - A Tile-Based TableTop Journeys Original
creator: TableTop Journeys
description: Regents is a fast-paced Victorian tile-laying game where players claim power through cities, markets, and forests — each choice shaping your path to dominance in under 90 minutes.

name: Los Banditos: The Train Heist Card Game
creator: SeriouslyBoardGames
description:
Ever wanted to play as a Bandit in the Wild West? 

Los Banditos is the ultimate fast-paced, Train Heist Card Game that combines western movies, old trains and card games! For 2 to 4 players, Ages 8 and up, this game is great screen-free fun!

Outsmart, Outplay and Outgun your Rivals to be the Winner!

name: Joust: The King's Tournament
creator: Rogue Pioneer Games
description: A head-to-head sports game where players Joust to become the King's Champion. Included is Joust Cavalry and Chivalry a 2-6 player arena game where players will charge on the battlefield trying to defeat every Knight to be the last Knight standing.

name: Alice's Wonderous Adventures
creator: MACDesign
description:
An enchanting board game where Alice races through numbers, reflections, and strategy — making maths fun for families, classrooms, and game nights alike, 
offering quick, clever gameplay that supports KS2 learning and family fun alike.

name: Articulate Earth
creator: Warbler Warlock Games
description: Articulate Earth plunges you into a race against time and treacherous terrain. As a daring explorer, you'll navigate a dynamic board game representing the Earth, collecting rare crystals crucial for powering your expedition. But beware! Monsters and traps lie in wait, ready to thwart your progress. With a limited fuel supply, strategic planning is key. Can you outsmart your rivals, gather Earths rare crystals, and conquer the challenges of Articulate Earth?

name: Conquest For The Capital
creator: MountainSoul Gaming
description: Immerse yourself in an iconic, brutal and fast fantasy wargame where 4 asymmetric factions battle to claim the capital.

name: SkIIkS
creator: SkIIkS
description: SkIIkS is a fun and immersive game that takes players into the world of skiing and mountain adventures. With its wintry atmosphere, it offers a true breath of fresh air by blending strategy and conviviality. A playful way to bring the spirit of ski holidays home.

name: A-Mazing Game of Gears 'N Guffaws
creator: MiniBadWolf Games
description:
Plot, pivot, and politely betray your friends in a semi-hidden role game of gears and guffaws.
Build the maze, bluff your loyalty, and let the chaos spin in your favor.

name: Drink card game - get wasted with your friends!
creator: KingofCups
description: Sorry, but there will not be sophisticated marketing and telling you what a wonderful project it is, because it is up to you. This is a simple card game that brings fun when you are at home or in bar.

name: Bloodwork
creator: I Demo Games
description: Bloodwork is a dark fantasy RPG board game for 1-4 players, featuring deep character customization, unique enemy mechanics, and a richly rewarding campaign with high replayability.

name: Akhedena  - Destiny of The Throne
creator: Akhedena
description: Strategy Board Game

name: Transecopia
creator: JGHansen
description: Transecopia is a hidden dice-placement game with simultaneous turns and objective win conditions.

name: Sternbilder | Constellations – A Quartet Game About the Stars
creator: logopilot.de
description: Constellations is a beautifully redesigned quartet game based on a turn-of-the-century German original. Featuring 12 constellations of the southern hemisphere across 48 cards, the game is easy to learn, fun to play, and a playful introduction to astronomy. Includes a fold-out reference sheet. 100% Made in Germany.

name: Oriental mythic creatures dice series 1：Four Celestial Guardians Dice
creator: paladician
description: Suitable for any ttrpg game with Oriental flavors

name: Clash of Scales & Fire: 3D Printable Dragon Chess Set (STL)
creator: Epic Printables
description: Summon the Ultimate Clash—Download Exquisite 3D STL Files and Forge Your Chessboard into a Dragon-Fueled Battlefield.

name: Super Team
creator: Roomiz Games
description: Control unique teams and captains, using powerful cards and strategic resource management in this fast-paced, tactical football game!

name: Epic Battle Chess
creator: Epic Battle Chess
description:
Epic Battle Chess is grand strategy game set in a medieval realm of kings and castles. Lead your army on a dynamic hexagonal board, blending chess’s core with bold innovations: four unique victory paths, a fog of war, units with special abilities, and thrilling castle sieges. 
Crafted with precise attention to detail, Epic Battle Chess delivers balanced, ever-evolving gameplay that keeps every match exciting. Join us to bring this grand strategy adventure to life.

name: Falcon's Formula Racing
creator: FALCON GAMES
description: Pick your team, qualify for the race, choose your tires, and place your two drivers on the grid. Race to win in an exciting 1–6 player game driven by real motorsport elements.

name: Third Date - The Dating Game That's Better Than Actual Dating
creator: ThirdDate
description:
Third Date gives you hypothetical "third date" scenarios and lets you decide whether it's a pro, con, neutral, or dealbreaker. 
And since everyone's a winner, you won't feel like a loser, like when your date asks you to split the bill 50/50!

name: Sthenos
creator: PCP
description: Holy wars in the fantasy land of Luthasun

name: Dog-In-Show: Party Game & Deluxe Reprint
creator: Mindo Games
description: A strategic and fun board game where players breed, train, and show dogs to win trophies. For families, dog lovers, and party gamers alike.

name: Pixie Trails
creator: Mystic Circus
description: In Pixie Trails, you play as a Pixie foraging for snacks, collecting feathers, building friendships and playing with charms.

name: DiceCulus
creator: EfficiencyCreative
description:
DiceCulus is a board game built around a flexible core system that turns arithmetic into an engaging adventure.
Players roll dice, solve expressions, and make strategic decisions to reach various targets — all while building math confidence. The game starts from a solid core mechanic, and players can add or combine micro-mechanics to create deeper, more complex, challenging, and asymmetric gameplay.

name: Whiff: A Survival Card Game
creator: Galloping Goat
description: Survive by minimizing your exposure to other people's nauseating odors while trying to get everyone else to fully experience your own personally expelled perfumes. Each player has two turns to play either offensive or defensive cards during a round. Whiffs are handed out at the end of each round based on the interacting play of all the cards placed down. The last one in the game wins.

name: METUS | 2nd Edition
creator: Aerobellum Games
description:
Both a highly condensed grand strategy game for 2 players and a solo COIN-style game. 

The 2nd Edition of this game adds a HUGE new amount of content, maps and ideas bringing the game fully to life.

name: Space Missions: Operation Paperclip
creator: tiros-games
description: As the head of a space agency, you have an ambitious goal: a manned moon landing. Planning ahead is just as important for success as the right amount of risk-taking. The expansion adds even more excitement to the thrilling space race game. It gives you the opportunity to recruit new experts and constantly adapt your team to the current requirements.

name: Far Far Out
creator: Studio Infinitus
description: Far Far Out is a space exploration game where you can win in three different ways. You will discover planets, asteroids and star systems. Your spaceship and your crewmembers go on a Cosmic Odyssey where no one has ever gone before. Encounter strange lifeforms on planets, dig for items on asteroids or find quests that help you achieve your goal in this competitive galactic journey. During the game you might help or frustrate other players in your hunt for reputation, wealth and exploration. Gather more and more dice while moving your 3d ships through up to 10 different star systems and increase your chances at winning encounters with strange beings or players on one of the more than 30 planets, asteroids and anomalies.

name: PARADISE - A Wastepunk Boardgame
creator: Mindwork Games
description: Desperate warbands clash in a harsh wasteland, battling fiercely for survival in this brand new skirmish game by Mindwork!

name: SOUL TOKEN
creator: MileStone Studio
description:
Hell has come upon the earth, the kingdom of men is in ruins.
Devouring their souls, Demons bend the vault
of human beings now abandoned in a world on fire.
You will have the will to rebel and participate 
at the Demon Game?

name: Sky Empire
creator: Greymarsh Games
description: Take part in this epic steam-punk 4X adventure to find the crystals and stop the invasion!

name: Simorgh Sanctuary
creator: Simorgh
description: Simorgh Sanctuary is an adventure card game inspired by Persian mythology. In this game, players take on the role of ancient heroes in an epic battle against the devil and his minions of darkness. Using cards and D20 dice, the fate of the players is determined, and only wisdom, courage, and a little luck can win this battle.

name: Hooked On Sport Fishing Board Game
creator: Tuna Master
description:
Hooked on Sport Fishing Board Game!
We’ve heard from fans around the world who are eager to dive in, and we’re just as excited to make that happen soon. But for now, our crowdfunding campaign is limited to U.S. backers only. This helps us manage shipping, logistics, and fulfillment while keeping costs down and quality high. Hang tight, international anglers we’re working on it!  We know the thrill of the catch doesn’t stop at the shoreline, and now it doesn’t have to. The Hooked on Sport Fishing Board Game. Will bringing all the action of sport fishing right to your table. Whether you're a veteran angler or just love a good game night, you're going to want to reel this one in. Based on the popular Hooked on Sport Fishing mobile app, this board game brings the excitement of casting, reeling, and out fishing your friends on game night.

name: Space Craft Board Game - Limited Edition
creator: Imperial Publishing
description:
At the scrap yard on the outskirts of the city, four eccentric scientists rummage through piles of useless trash. They are competing to see who is the best rocket designer. The task is not easy, and the materials are limited. Which eccentric researcher will be the first to fly into space in his innovative rocket?

Space Craft is a family game in which 2 to 4 players build crazy rockets. The game is for players aged 10+ and will take around 15min per player.

During their turn, players will move their pawns on the scrapyard board to collect scrap tiles. Later, they will use those tiles to craft rocket pieces. By collecting specific rocket elements, players will fulfill contracts and those will grant them additional points by the end of the game.

The game ends after one player completes the rocket. The winner is the player with the most points.

name: AstroNavigators (relaunch)
creator: Armillary Games
description: Chart your course to the Moon! A thrilling space race and asymmetric worker placement board game where you explore the stars, gather knowledge, and embark on a daring journey to the lunar surface. Plan your observations, navigate the cosmos, and conquer the challenges of space exploration in this unique blend of strategy and celestial adventure.

name: Space Qubes
creator: Kagu Spiele
description: Find spare parts to repair your stranded spaceship, while defending against aliens.

name: Imperial Twing - The Dragon's Demand
creator: Emperor Claudius
description:
CAMPAIGN RESTARTED: please join us at Imperial Twing: Dragons and Languages for the same great content at reduced prices, and with additional language versions added.

https://gamefound.com/en/projects/imperial-games/twing-lang

name: Need To Win
creator: MAgames
description: An exciting game of car races on cards. Challenge the opponents, play in collaborative, use bonus cards and win plus challenges you can. Dynamic, strategic and fun!

name: Space Station
creator: Morrigan Games
description:
A survival game in space:

Help a station crew overcome the challenges inherent in space exploration. React effectively to hazards, manage damage as quickly as possible and monitor your environment and the consequences of your actions thanks to your precious SMARTBOY!

name: BONESWAY: Luminis Refuge
creator: Red Kingdom Games
description: BONESWAY: Luminis Refuge is an American-style board game, offering the perfect blend of gamebook and strategy. In this dystopian future, only an outstanding combination of wits and skill will ensure your survival. Join the Bones' Way!

name: Oniréa
creator: YooGeek
description: (For now, this game will only be produced in French. Here is the link:  https://gamefound.com/fr/projects/yoogeek/onirea) Play the role of the last Mages in a fantasy and steampunk universe. Cooperate to strategically explore the world's lands and advance your heroes to defeat enemies in tactical card battles. Onirea is 1 of the top 5 Expert prototypes on the 2023 French scene (ProtoGônes).

name: Party Beast 7 Game Collection
creator: Lawrence Lyle
description: Partybeast is the ultimate party game collection. In the box, you'll find 400 cards, 7 games, and a rare wooden collectable (hopefully rare). Packed with replay value, fun, and surprising twists.

name: Diceculus: The Fun & Challenging Math Game
creator: EfficiencyCreative
description: Mathematics has countless numbers, and we can combine them in endless ways to achieve the desired result. So why not use dice to explore the possibilities and build a winning strategy while having fun learning? 🎲✨

name: Claws and Guns
creator: Carlos Jimenez
description:
"Hola señor, ¿qué le trae por La Zanahoria Verde? ¿Las conejas o quizás los conejos? ¿Puede que la carne morada? ¿Cómo dice? Oooh, así que viene a aprender a jugar; entonces pida su copa preferida, acomódese y sea bienvenido a Claws and Guns."

Claws and Guns es un juego de escaramuzas táctico y frenético de miniaturas para 2 jugadores, donde lideraras una banda de animales antropomórficos y competirás con tu rival por conseguir la mejor puntuación.

name: Lord of Conspiracy LIGHT AND DARKNESS
creator: kopergames
description: Embark on a journey full of dangers, random locations, random encounters, watch out for ambushes, face monsters, hunt animals, pay for services and trade. Enter the darkness and explore ruins, caves or underground. Keep your team in mind and meet their basic needs.

name: Weltraumpioniere
creator: LarsKrachen
description: Inspiriert durch Science Fiction Filme wie „Der Marsianer“, „Interstellar“ und „AD Astra“ oder Serien wie „The Expanse“ habe ich dieses Kartenspiel für 2 bis 6 Spieler ab 12 Jahren entwickelt. Das schnelle Spiel basiert auf einfachen, leicht erlernbaren Regeln. Jeder Spieler muss auf dem Mars oder einem anderen Himmelskörper aus unterschiedlichen Modulkarten eine Kolonie gründen und am Leben halten. Dabei müssen die Spieler ihre Ressourcen so effizient wie möglich managen, da diese extrem begrenzt sind und durch verschiedene Ereignisse bedroht werden.

name: Eden The New World
creator: Happy Together Games
description: Dive into Eden The New World, a miniatures game where survival and strategy clash in a post-apocalyptic world. Available as STL files to print or as a ready-to-play physical box, choose your way to play and shape your own adventure.

name: IM A MILLIONAIR£! GAM£ UK ONLY
creator: Lucrative Creations
description: UK ONLY - Live like a MILLIONAIR£! & see if you can be the first to double your money.    A life filled with amazing holidays, fancy cars, big houses, maybe even a yacht, why not?   A Fun way to teach kids more about money. This RPG could actually become REALITY.

name: The Voynich board game CODEX.
creator: Björn Burow
description: The Voynich game CODEX is a unique board game with strategic elements for two to four players, in which the aim is to decipher medieval writings and drawings and thus solve one of the greatest mysteries in history.

name: Gothic: A Shadow's Quest
creator: THQ Nordic
description:
Immerse yourself in the epic world of one of the most influential RPGs of all time - Gothic.
