In this newly designed board game, slip into the role of a “Shadow”, an aspiring member of the Old Camp who wants to make a name for himself in the Colony. Risky tasks and deadly opponents await you in the dangerous Valley of Mines. Alone or cooperatively with up to three other players - and an optional Game Master – fight against aggressive scavengers, sneaky minecrawlers, cruel hordes of orcs, and other bloodthirsty creatures. Explore, complete quests, and develop your character; master swordplay, unleash magical powers, or wield a bow to defeat enemies from afar. The choice is yours!

name: Dominus Rex
creator: Kingklavvier
description: Medieval Europe is engulfed in feudal war. Will you have what it takes to become the King of Kings?

name: Texas Chainsaw Massacre - The Escape Game
creator: Why Not AI
description: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre - The Escape Game is a cooperative board game for 1 to 5 players, immersing participants in the terrifying atmosphere of the cult 1974 film, on the occasion of its 50th anniversary. In two 90-minute sessions, players, who embody the heroes of the film (Kirk, Jerry, Sally, Franklin and Pam), must solve puzzles and survive attacks from the Sawyer family. The game includes all kinds of puzzles scattered across different double-sided boards, some of which require the use of a UV lamp (included in the box). Designed by screenwriter Fabien Clavel and illustrated by Will Argunas, this game faithfully recreates the atmosphere of the original film. Will you finish the game alive?

name: Lunar Wars
creator: Telesis Games
description:
Telesis Games presents Lunar Wars, a fast-paced tabletop skirmish game set in the near future. Command one of four unique factions in the battle for the Moon. Outmaneuver rivals, secure resources, and claim victory in the race for lunar supremacy.

Recruit from detailed 45mm miniatures sculpted by legends like Bob Naismith. Use tactical units, Lunar Mecha, and drones to conquer key objectives and convert resources into Victory Points. As commander, influence the war’s outcome by manipulating the Council of Lunar Nations through bribes, deception, or assassination. Beware of unpredictable events like meteor strikes and solar flares that can disrupt even the best strategies.

With a rich lore, stunning miniatures, and easy-to-learn rules, Lunar Wars offers you and your gaming buddies hours of exciting sci-fi action on the tabletop.

name: The Green Conquest - Strategic Steampunk Boardgame
creator: Steamortal games
description: In The Green Conquest, each player embodies a clan leader of Dreamare Island. Your goal is to collect the four resources on the board: a Trimétium-charged mushroom, an underground deposit, a mutant flower, and a Trimétium crystal. The first player to collect all four resources wins the game. Beware, however: Dreamare Island is inhabited by dangerous mutant creatures... And the other players won't hesitate to charge you with their combat vehicles to destroy you and eliminate you from the game!

name: Synthetic Sins - A Solo Cyberpunk Noir Stealth/Action Thriller
creator: Galvanize
description: Step into the neon-soaked shadows of future Ceylon as Garrett Takao, a fixer framed for a crime you didn’t commit. Outsmart relentless enemies, uncover a gripping conspiracy, and fight to clear your name across 25+ high-stakes missions in this solo stealth/action board game.

name: HONEY SCOUTS - Bee the Champion!
creator: MOZAIC GAMES
description: Lead your honey bee team in this buzzing game of tile-laying and trick-taking strategy—outsmart rivals, poach their bees, and win the Honeyscout Tournament by building the biggest swarm!

name: Saturday Wars Collectible Card Game
creator: Resurrection Games
description: Saturday Wars Collectible Card Game (CCG) is a fast-paced collectible card game based on the fascinating world of Saturday AM’s most iconic titles. Select protagonists as the story plays out in front of you. Plot Twists and Story Arcs keep the story interesting. Straightforward gameplay with open deck-building gives a challenge to new and experienced gamers alike in under 25 minutes.

name: Chronicles of Paldon
creator: Triturus Games
description: Step into the steampunk world of Paldon, a city thrown into chaos after a catastrophic event destroyed all advanced machinery. As an inventor, you’ll compete for renown by gathering skills and materials, rebuilding vital machinery, and supporting the city’s most influential factions.

name: Hamburger Hill
creator: Kevin Talley / Cadet Games
description: Turn-based tabletop hex-and-counter contest based on the historic battle for Hill 937 in the A-Shau valley of Vietnam, May 10-20, 1969.

name: Brewthulus Tavern - Party game
creator: Gjallarhorn Games
description:
Invite your friends to a fun-filled game night in Brewthulu's Tavern!
Whether you’re drinking or staying sober, Brewthulu’s Tavern is a fantasy-inspired party card game where chaos, luck, and strategy collide— and anyone can join the madness!
With or without drinks, Brewthulu’s Tavern promises unforgettable fun for all!

name: Wind in the sails: The Rise of Ancient Empires
creator: Krzysztof Butor
description:
Dynamic game for 2-4 players with 5 playable factions and 7 unique scenarios, with many boosting or game changeing events which creates each play involving and unique.
Wind in the sails will push you into development  of your economy and  flexible choice of strategy.

name: Nebula Drifters: The Lost Voyage
creator: Last Line Studio
description: Stranded on a vast alien world, rally your team to survive, explore, and thrive in Nebula Drifters: The Lost Voyage. Each decision shapes your journey as you uncover ancient secrets, conquer challenges, and transform from castaways to pioneers.

name: Suros: The Other Dimension
creator: Ursaco Games
description: A mysterious Ichor has infected the world of Suros, changing the alien life into mutant beasts. Take control of 3 players to investigate into the Ichor, kill the mutants and discover what secrets they hold.

name: Smol Batl
creator: Dice the Lion
description: A fun, quick, strategic, goblin-themed game for 2 players (with an expansion for up to 4 players) where dice and your tactics rule everything. Easy to learn, hard to master!

name: BEAT: Party Game Card
creator: Monkey Republic Games
description: BEAT is the game of daring questions where answering isn’t enough… you have to stay cool! Designed to challenge your nerves and honesty

name: Rust & Rebellion
creator: Aether & Alloy Games
description: Rust & Rebellion is a steampunk-themed apocalyptic survival game. The combination of unique apocalypses and crises make for thousands of playthrough combinations of survival conditions.

name: Barbarity
creator: Henge Games Ltd
description: In Barbarity each player takes the part of a mighty barbarian warrior, embarking on adventures to win glory, plunder, land,  the allegiance of mighty comrades, and the loyalty of fierce beasts. Naturally the path to such treasures will be fraught with blood, sweat, and all manner of fluids, so sharpen your axes and polish your knuckles, it’s about to get medieval.

name: Shattered Lands Deluxe
creator: Czacha Games
description: A fast-paced true-3D skirmish game. Form a team and run, jump, push, cast spells, claim lands, and use unique abilities to defeat opponent heroes.

name: Turret Dice: The Defenders
creator: Lampstand Games
description: Turret Dice: The Defenders is a Cooperative, Dice Placement, Tower Defense with a side of Tableau Building for 1-4 Players. You are tasked with defending your colony from a randomized swarm of meteors with crazy traits and abilities that threatens to obliterate everything. Customize and upgrade your own unique array of turrets and dice mitigating towers as you play, and save your home from the onslaught!

name: Beast Slayers
creator: Capricorn Games
description:
Welcome to the Kingdom of Ain!
Beast Slayers is a competitive or cooperative Strategic fantasy Card and Dice Game that will pit Beast Slayers against each other or together as a team for fame and Glory. Each player will embody a Monster Hunter who will need to take on contracts, track down monsters and slay them in order to gain gold and reputation. But your travels will not be without danger and the land of Ain has many hidden surprises for whoever steps down the wrong path. In the end, players will need to gather reputation to succeed and become the most renowned Beast Slayers in the Kingdom.

name: 1811: Albuera Second Edition
creator: Tactical Workshop
description: This famous Napoleonic battle is depicted in lavish historical details using the second edition of the innovative "Fix Bayonets!" tactical system. This is a hexagons & counters, battalion-level, combat simulation.

name: Pixels and Polygons
creator: BD Games
description: Create your video game masterpiece.

name: A Few Good Knights
creator: AllNightGames
description: A Few Good Knights is a press your luck/strategic dice mitigation game for 2-4 players set in a medieval fantasy setting.

name: MEMES & DREAMS Fun Card Game (Crazy Effects) Party Hard Insane Challenges
creator: LUCKY_NOOB
description:
MEMES & DREAMS is a fun silly little game that will have you and your friends and family going crazy!


Currently there are over 420 cards you can buy with more on the way!

5 Chaos Decks (269+ unique cards each with a very wide walking range of memes, Easter eggs and effects)

1 Star Deck (54 unique cards inspired by all Starcraft memes)

1 Dungeon Deck (54 unique cards inspired by role playing memes from games like Dungeons and Dragons)

1 Blank Deck (54 unique cards with blank space so you can make up your own effects)

name: Battleground of the Eons
creator: Conundrum Games
description:
In Battleground of the Eons, 2 to 4 players will use skill and timing to eliminate their opponents in a crucible of combat. Each player will control a single faction of characters with unique abilities and play styles. The players will navigate their faction's characters in an attempt to gain enough Renown for victory, thus proving their faction's supremacy over all others.

There are 2 distinct game modes - Duel Mode (2 players) or Domination Mode, where up to 4 players can compete in a free-for-all or teamplay.

name: The Depth of Abyss
creator: QuasarGames
description: In Abyss, you face a universe ruled by a mind-controlling force. Lead your race to freedom or risk eternal enslavement. Strategy and courage are key to changing the fate of the galaxy.

name: BattleWheels
creator: MTB
description:
BattleWheels is a tabletop strategy game between two or more competing armies. The aim is to destroy 
the opposing army’s command pieces. The game can be printed on any FDM 3D printer.

name: Phidippides 490BC
creator: DZomb
description:
5 minutes for gaming ?
In this one player game (8+), you will try to match the feat of Phidippides by covering the 40 km that separate Marathon from Athens. 
Grab a pen, 3 six-sided dice, a meeple and a marker (or 4D6) and RUN !!!

name: Of Popes & Plagues
creator: Hillary's Toy Box
description: The Cards and Dice Game of Popes, Plagues & Pestilence in the Middle Ages.  He, or she, who dies last wins!!!   Gamefound Campaign exclusive Translation to French, German and Spanish.

name: Kur-Nu-Gi
creator: REDIMP GAMES
description: Turn back from the Path of the Dead and escape to the World of the Living.

name: Legend of Gonia : Spirit Showdown
creator: Kézart
description: 1v1 strategy game where possibilities are endless. The blend of strategy, magic and tactics ensures an epic duel. Use the synergy between power of cards and warriors to dominate the battlefield and become the Master of Gonia.

name: Below: The temple of Cthulhu
creator: Ex Regnum Publishing
description: Below is a board game recommended for ages 8 and up, for 1 to 6 players, with an approximate duration of 45 minutes. It was created by Amador Díaz and illustrated by Tabaré Santellán. The game is inspired by H.P. Lovecraft's story, The Temple.

name: GODS HEIST
creator: Triton Noir
description:
Join the Ultimate Ancient Gods Heist Adventure!
Unleash your strategic genius in an innovative co-op board game that blends ancient mythology with thrilling heist action. 

With high-quality miniatures and immersive gameplay, Gods Heist promises epic adventures and high replayability.

name: Tattoopedia: Questions and Answers - a board game
creator: RadekFiksa
description: This is a completely unique knowledge game that contains 5 circuits: Europe, Asia, Africa. America and Oceania. 500 questions and 1500 possible answers.

name: Pitch Out: Aim, Flick, Win - Now Free to Play!
creator: jocus
description: Unleash your flicking skills in Pitch Out, the fast-paced dexterity game where strategy meets precision. Perfect for quick duels or epic tournaments!

name: STARLOCK
creator: Den of Imagination
description: You find yourself on a desolate and treacherous world, marooned and fighting for your life in the grim reality of alien incarceration. Your ultimate goal is clear - survive. Yet, achieving this feat demands cunning strategy, resourcefulness, and the ambition to outlast your rivals.

name: Inheritance
creator: Knumble Games
description: You now have the keys to the city. It is time to make your mark. Bend culture to your will, engage with criminal enterprises and hire the right people to completely take over it all.

name: The Plague Throne
creator: Team Drews Basement LLC
description: The Plague Throne is a Chibi dungeon delving game that brings the excitement and feel of Super Dungeon (TM) to a whole new level.  The Plague throne can be your starting point, or it can grow your existing Super Dungeon (TM) collection and it's replay-ability to endless fun.  With the WOSDEC (TM) Ruleset you can explore dungeons, fight iconic bosses and baddies, level your heroes, form guilds, craft unique gear, raid massive dungeons, quest, and grow a world by yourself, with your friends, or with an entire gaming community.  The keys to endless adventuring in a Chibi Fantasy world is in your hands; excitement and adventure await!

name: Night Parade: A Yokai Cleansing Word Game
creator: IndianWolf Studios LLC
description:
A word-building game about clever word choice, dice management, and set collection.
It’s Obon at the Onsen!
You are a new-hire for a yokai bathhouse.
Your assignment: to cleanse yokai.
Greet your guests, manage your tub, build clever words, and become Employee of the Year!

name: CastleScape - 2nd Edition, Gates and Guilds Expansion, and Deluxe Components!
creator: Praetorian Board Games
description: CastleScape: Gates and Guilds expands the world of CastleScape, by calling guild masters to leverage their guilds' specific strengths in building the grandest castle for the King with a new castle "Gate" structure.  Will your guild claim the most renown in kingdom?

name: Theocratia
creator: Mojito Studios
description: In Theocratia, the new "T- game" by Tascini & Marinangeli, illustrated by Andrew Bosley, 2 to 4 players manipulate the development of 4 civilizations that inhabit a remote island.

name: Planet of the Apes - The Miniatures Board Game
creator: Z or Alive
description: Planet of the Apes is a cooperative scenario-based board game set between the second and third films of the Caesar trilogy. Players lead groups of apes blending into the wild against heavily armed human squads.

name: ZeroDay.exe
creator: Pudkat Games
description: The A.i. bots have taken over Shijima and it is up to your renegade crew of scavengers to fight through their defenses and reclaim the city! Choose from 6 unique characters in this cyberpunk-style, cooperative, rogue-like, deck-building dungeon crawler for 1-4 players!

name: Drunken Dwarves
creator: Emperoll
description:
Drunken Dwarves: the ultimate tavern brawl simulator! It is an party card game for 2-4 players. 
It's got all the essentials for a top-notch bar scuffle: frosty brews, flying fists, and a complete lack of rules. Plus, a merry band of inebriated dwarves to really get the party started!

name: StarDriven: Gateway
creator: Rock Manor Games
description: Stardriven: Gateway is a game for 1 to 4 players that plays about 30min/player. It can be played competitive or cooperative depending on which Episode is selected during set up.  It's the first game in our new Sci-Fi universe where players choose a unique faction and then assign crew cards to stations on their ship to explore the sector and complete missions.

name: Escape from Site 19 coming soon in Polish!
creator: Escape from Site 19
description: EFS19 takes place in the SCP Universe, but you don’t have to be an SCP fan to love this game. EFS19’s ominous atmosphere and challenging tasks will appeal to all extreme board game lovers, fans of horror, and anyone brave enough to embrace the unknown.

name: Power City Arena
creator: Theta World
description: Power City Arena is an  epic confrontation boardgame in which you'll control a team of superheroes. Defeat other players by using your amazing superpowers in very dynamic fights!

name: The Way
creator: Endorphin games
description: Will you follow the honorable path of the samurai, find tranquility in a Zen garden, or embrace the grace of a geisha? For the daring, the shadows offer stealth and cunning. Master skills and acquire symbols as each turn presents new challenges. The Way awaits—will you emerge victorious?

name: Custom Football
creator: AvengerGames
description:
CUSTOM FOOTBALL The Board Game. Here you can customise your favorite teams.
Paint the jerseys and the club logo in your favorite color, and road to win the Legendary League or just hop in a quick match against AI or your friends.

name: Cosmic Conquest
creator: Rising Empire Studios
description:
Cosmic Conquest is a fast-paced 2-6 player dice rolling game filled with combat and strategy. It features a unique combat system using a mixture of dice, cards, and abilities. Players will assemble a team of three Contenders to fight for galactic supremacy!    

With incredible art, repeatable gameplay, and collectible miniatures, players will not want to miss out on the fun!

name: Scarce
creator: Todys Games
description: Scarce offers versatile gameplay, allowing you to engage either cooperatively or competitively, where collaboration is key to city repair, or competitively, where captains vie against each other to claim the title of the most successful.

name: Suros The Board Game
creator: Ursaco Games
description: In Suros The Board Game You take control of 3 scientists that don't mind getting their hands dirty. These scientists all have a similar problem, mutated monsters have shown up on their planet and are wreaking havoc!

name: Ogrefish
creator: Daywalker Syndicate
description: Ogrefish is a Competitive “take that” dice & card game. Come take part in a fantasy fishing tournament where bringing in the fish is only half the battle. Players take turns trying to fish up and then defeat monsters in combat in order to win trophies, get 4 trophies and you win.

name: Moon Death + Dragons
creator: Sulphurous Games
description: Raise your tankard and join the spirited atmosphere of the tavern with Moon, Death and Dragons. Add a dash of excitement to your ale-filled evenings with this collection of dice games! Roll four custom dice, weave the threads of fate and let the dice decide your fortune in this sociable tavern adventure.

name: The Art of War: Card Game
creator: Brightdawn Entertainment
description: The Art of War: Card Game is a tactical non-collectible card game with well-thought-out rules and fantasy themed style inspired by the beta version of Gwent. Build your own deck, play with up to four friends, lead your empire to glory and master The Art of War!

name: Paw War
creator: Starmetal Studio
description: A battle that’s been raging since the beginning of time; Cats vs Dogs. Fight it out in this 1 vs 1 Card game that uses strategy and resourcefulness to defeat your opponent.

name: Dr. Leichenberg's Apothecary of Remedies
creator: Harrumph Games
description:
Guten Tag! My name is Dr. Leichenberg and this is my Apothecary of Remedies!
I have selected you, along with a few other apprentices to join me in an exciting new era of medical treatments. You will use a combination of state of the art medicine along with a few experimental treatments to help me figure out a cure for our patient. If it works, hazaa! We will be written about for eons to come. If we fail, no matter, this is the 1800s and anything goes!
Will you join me as we make history in the medical field?

*Dr. Leichenberg is not a real doctor and any medical claims and treatments should be considered with caution.

name: Goblin Plunder
creator: Grej Ink
description: Goblin Plunder for dragon treasure! Print and Play Card Game: A set collecting card game for 2-4 players - Enter the dragon's cave, steal treasure, but beware: the dragon can win!

name: 1793: Patriots &Traitors (ESP)
creator: Headquarter Games
description:
1793: Patriots & Traitors recrea el caos que desgarró Francia en los años 1792-1794 como nunca antes se había hecho.

Un juego de 1 a 5 jugadores y 120+ minutos de duración.

name: Magic Fox Hunt
creator: Break Geek
description:
While searching for spell components, an evil Witch has captured you and your fellow Wizards and turned you into foxes! You managed to escape while the Witch was deliberating what to do with you, but she can't be far behind!

Welcome to the Magic Fox Hunt. In this one-vs-all game, one player will be selected to play as the Witch, and the rest of the players will play as multiple Wizards (turned into Foxes) hiding behind cover, moving through the valley attempting to escape the Witch.

Crowdfunding Launch on June 20th. Subscribe for updates! Play Magic Fox Hunt for free here: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3214751884

name: The Last Zombie
creator: Rock Solid Games
description: Introducing "The Last Zombie," the official licensed board game of the bestselling novel, "The Zombie" by Mort Carver. Step into the remnants of a world overrun by chaos, where you are the last of your kind. In this strategic survival game, navigate a devastated landscape, avoid capture, and seek out the last beacon of hope for zombies. Can you alter your fate and secure a future for the undead?

name: Fantasy Adventure Game LIGHT AND DARKNESS
creator: kopergames
description:
Embark on a journey full of dangers, random locations, random encounters, watch out for traps, hunt animals, heal the sick, pay for services, trade. 
Enter the darkness and explore ruins, caves, or undergrounds. 
Keep your team in mind and meet their basic needs of thirst, craving, and sleep.

name: Prison - Can you escape?
creator: IOCUS Games
description: Prison is a strategy board game where the goal is to devise an escape plan to break out of prison. Throughout the game, players will face setbacks in their plans. There are 6 characters with different attributes that can lead to various strategies. Cards and action spaces can influence strategies at any point during the game.

name: Tales of Realms and Ruins
creator: Fantazem Games Ltd
description: Tales of Realms and Ruins is a competitive midweight board game for 2-4 players. Use mechanics such as deck building, area control, asymmetric hero progression and semi-cooperative decision-making to become the next ruler of the Realms.

name: Shrinkopolis
creator: Most Points Win
description: Welcome to Shrinkopolis! Mankind has solved most of its problems by shrinking the whole population, but now a giant living room full of new daring challenges and dangers stands before you. Build your city using a new unique take on tile placement, befriend animals to help you, and make the most joyous city!

name: Maleficarum
creator: Paul Bamberger
description: Unmask dark powers plaguing a village in this print & play witchhunting mystery-deduction-roleplaying game for 5-7 players. Will you find the witch or witcher in your midst?

name: CyberQuest. The Game of Cyberpunk Adventures
creator: Infinity Darkness Games
description:
You are in the year 2081. The Black Chip agency, formed by members who participated in the Second Corporate Conflict on both sides, try to avoid a third conflict between Nakaware and Biosync.
Max, an employee at Nakaware, discovers a confidential file that could spark a war. He contacts his sister Raven and meets her in an old warehouse, away from Neon City, to explain her what he is up to.

Cyberquest is a narrative cyberpunk adventure game for 1 to 5 players. You play in 3 different phases: Mission phase, chase phase and den phase.

Mission Phase: Advance with your runner through a dungeon crawler-style scenario in which anything can happen in every room.

Chase Phase: Scape the site driving your car to den. A mini-game that you draw event cards and wich objetive is finish the route.

Den Phase: Heal your wounds, upgrade your cyberware, get jobs and repair your car. A little maintenance to prepare you for the next mission.

name: Eye of Zamrock: Invasion
creator: Infinite Galaxy
description:
Eye of Zamrock: Invasion is a competitive, epic fantasy board game with elements of strategy, adventure, city building and resource management.

To win, your Kingdom must balance the pursuit of personal ambition against the need to cooperate with other players to achieve a common goal – fighting off the demon invasion!

name: Astrum
creator: Cosmodrome Games
description: A game of stars and constellations. Play as court astronomers and explore constellations by arranging beautiful tiles on your board to create your own Star Chart!

name: Sunday League Football
creator: Sunday League Games
description: Step onto the pitch and experience the thrill of Sunday League Football, a board game that captures all the heart-stopping drama and tension of the Beautiful Game.

name: Magical Cards
creator: IN ALTUM
description: Next-gen tactical smart card game

name: The 7 Seas (campaign postponed)
creator: Critical Hut
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in the world of The 7 Seas. Explore, trade, fight, and try to become a legend!

name: Oghmu - Age of Discordance (canceled)
creator: Aethernest Studios
description:
Choose Your faction and lead them to victory to decide the fate of the Galactic Nest.

Oghmu - Age of Discordance is a fast-paced, dice-driven skirmish game of strategy and luck, that simulates the unpredictability and fluctuation of thrilling and heroic combat.

name: Planetary Peril
creator: Tommy
description: Space themed multiplayer dice-combat and resource management board game involving both strategy and luck.

name: Ocean Slayers: The Bermuda Chronicles
creator: Wandr Games
description: A strategic board game set in the isles of Bermuda, where you are a captain looking for eternal glory by embarking on epic explorations and mythical battles. Explore the ocean, expand your fleet, hunt ancient monsters, battle rival captains, build and grow your economy and face the mythical Kraken.

name: Train Rush
creator: MTE GAMES
description: Participate in the race as a descendant of one of the four factions. Trade, exchange, and transport resources. Fight and develop your influence in countries. Be the faction that benefits the most, has the greatest impact on economic growth, dominates the market, and ultimately wins. Will it be you? Will you succeed where others have failed?

name: Blight Seas Fleet
creator: Shrike Studio
description: Blight Seas Fleet is a naval skirmish game set in a post-apocalyptic, dark fantasy world with technology broadly comparable to the turn of the century. Great fleets of pre-dreadnought battleships and their supporting vessels slug it out for control of the world’s dwindling resources, chief among which are the materials necessary for the manufacture of Reagent. Only this esoteric substance allows the newly established field of Corpse Engineering to maintain forces capable of sustaining the war effort.

name: SWAMP card game
creator: SWAMP
description: This card game provides a unique gameplay experience, enriched by a rich and complex narrative. The game offers more than just card play; it's a portal to an expansive, carefully crafted universe. Set in a futuristic, knightly realm transformed by war, this world is teeming with fearsome monsters and enigmatic artifacts, inviting players to explore its complexities and mysteries.

name: Stone Of Destiny
creator: Game Out Of Line
description: You are a noble in a fantasy world, competing against other nobles just like you to prove you are favored by destiny and deserve to rule.

name: Cookie Champion by Louis & Stefan Malz
creator: Eagle-Gryphon Games
description: A cookie baking competition medium-weight strategy game by Louis and Stefan Malz of Rococo Deluxe fame!

name: Draconicus - The Fantasy Boardgame
creator: The Yellow Hand
description:
Gain control of the Land. Vanquish your Foes. Complete your Quest.
Draconicus is an exciting, fast-paced fantasy boardgame of quests, strategy and adventure for 1-5 players ages 12 and up. It is also a tabletop role-playing game with a rich and exciting new setting, which can be integrated with the boardgame for a more fun, extended gaming experience.

name: Doom Guard
creator: PinnacleEntertainmentGroup
description:
Earth's superheroes and villains must unite to defeat the minions of Cthulhu!
Cooperative board game for 1-5 players.

name: Carolingi
creator: Sea Cove Games GbR
description:
In Carolingi, the players assume the roles of the grandchildren of Charlemagne; they are the "Carolingi". 
The game includes a competitive version and a semi-cooperative version.

name: Triple Barrel Shotgun
creator: Triple Barrel
description: Play this fast-paced game of luck, skill, and strategy, mixed with poker, zombies, and brains! Made for the whole family!

name: Hi! We are moving! Take care and eat healthy!
creator: Neuronkraft
description: We continue our food fight adventure on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/neuronkraftyesplease/mind-your-own-plate/

name: Sea Beasts
creator: littlest lantern
description: As a Viking warrior, you and your partner must transport precious cargo for a grand reward. Slay your way through beast-infested waters, vanquish the horrors of the deep, deliver your cargo, and prove your legacy! Will your blood rage and partnership be enough to survive?

name: WARTBURG & Paris 1879
creator: Butterfly Games
description:
Step into a captivating world of crime and mystery with "Wartburg"! This thrilling crime investigation board game transports you to the grandeur of Wartburg Castle, where you assume the role of a celebrated detective. You can tackle the challenges solo or in cooperative mode, catering to players of all preferences.

"Paris 1879" whisks you away to the Belle Époque in the City of Light, where you embody a seasoned detective in pursuit of answers in the world of art and intrigue. This investigative game presents the challenge of solving the theft of precious artworks in 1879 Paris.

name: Astronavigators
creator: Armillary Games
description: AstroNavigators is a strategic game where you use a real star map linking your position on Earth to the stars. Gain information of the planetary motions in the Solar System and travel around the world to complete quests and hidden agendas until you are ready to prove that you are the best astronavigator from the Earth to the Moon.

name: Golen Bay
creator: Golen Games
description:
Golen Bay is a pirate-themed board game where players use their characters' abilities to steal bombs and blow up treasure chests. 
Players compete to be the first to blow up all the treasure chests, making use of each character's unique skills and abilities.

name: Dragon Dice - Dracolem
creator: SFR, Inc
description: Dracolem is a new species for Dragon Dice! Built by the Gnomes, they are mechanical golems created in the image of the Dragonkin. Made of Gold, Silver, and Bronze and gaining toughness from the elemental equipment they carry. Expand your forces with new strategies that the Dracolem bring to the game!

name: Breaking Moon - Survivors of the apocalypse
creator: Strange Games
description: Breaking Moon is a non confrontational yet competitive board game where 2-5 players collaborate to construct a space station, battling the effects of a shattered moon and rising seas. Rescue survivors, trade or gather resources, develop technologies, and work together to ensure humanity's survival.

name: Fantasy Farfadet Quest
creator: Ghan Factory
description:
Fantasy Farfadet Quest is an asymmetrical boardgame including awesome miniatures. 
Easy to understand game rules are designed for play between parents and children in a funny and enchanting world.

name: Storm Cat 9
creator: Storm Cat 9
description:
It's the PURRfect weather for a storm, the Skyzone is being covered in colorful Cloud Cats. You have the power to TRANSTORM them into chaotic Storm Cats and battle! 

Throw down Treats and Toy cards to gain life and attack opposing Kits. Create Cat Spots and use Cat Control cards to help your cat clan or mess with your opponents' plans. 

It's raining cats and cats, pick a color out of the STORM CAT 9 and enter the Skyzone!

Storm Cat 9 was created from the love of cats, art and card games.

STORM CAT 9: combining cats, colors and chaotic storm powers! Be the first to own the complete base set!

TCG (Trading Card Game) + CCG (Collectible CAT Game)

FOLLOW STORM CAT 9 on Instagram & Facebook!

name: Square & Compass
creator: AaAa Studios
description: Welcome to the world of Square & Compass! A construction resource management game where your successes can have you the most popular architect in town, or left penniless at the drafting table. Will you become the world's most accomplished architect?

name: Guns 'N Bosses
creator: Bataru Studio
description: Guns 'N Bosses is a cooperative shooter-looter with some rogue-lite mechanics to rediscover video game vibes around the table.

name: Rolling Zombies
creator: Tarrasque Games
description: Rolling Zombies is a post-apocalyptic dice rolling, area control game for 2-5 players, where the living dead roam the wasteland, and five factions battle for survival. Scavenge,  Explore and Fight in this competitive 4x game.

name: Tomes of Arkham
creator: Marti
description: Tomes of Arkham is a set collecting card game set in the dark world of H. P. Lovecraft. Amass the greatest collection of Tomes on Earth!

name: Crystalline Wars
creator: Fyndoria.Games
description: Embark on a magical journey with Crystalline Wars - a thrilling card game that transports you into a realm of wizardry and elemental crystals. Carefully fuse your elemental crystals, unleash spellbinding abilities, and outmaneuver your opponents in this battle of wits and strategy. With each turn, the stakes rise, the battles intensify, and the game takes unexpected twists and turns. Will you emerge as the most powerful wizard?

name: Mind Expedition - Print and Play
creator: SEGO Sebastian Puszkiewicz
description: Welcome to the crowdfunding action of the English and Polish version of the Mind Expedition role-playing board game! The game is set in a fantasy world. The gameplay system is similar to games based on RPG and Dungeons in a nutshell, which allows you to play the game with simple rules that do not require the player to study for a long time. Have you ever wanted to play an adventure on your own terms, but you didn't have many hours for a gameplay? Now you and your friends can start your own dream game, that gives you all the RPG experience, but it won't take you the whole afternoon.

name: The Wilderness
creator: Boardgame Adventures
description: The Wilderness is a cooperative adventure experience for 1-6 players. Set in a beautiful dystopic world where nature has reclaimed the cities. The Survivors will have to fight a giant Beast while avoiding a horde of wolves to create a safe haven amidst this chaos.

name: Mind Expedition
creator: SEGO Sebastian Puszkiewicz
description: Welcome to the crowdfunding action of the English and Polish version of the Mind Expedition role-playing board game! The game is set in a fantasy world. The gameplay system is similar to games based on RPG and Dungeons in a nutshell, which allows you to play the game with simple rules that do not require the player to study for a long time. Have you ever wanted to play an adventure on your own terms, but you didn't have many hours for a gameplay? Now you and your friends can start your own dream game, that gives you all the RPG experience, but it won't take you the whole afternoon.

name: Mighty Gnomes
creator: The Wood Games
description: Use a tile in two clever ways to build your prosperous gnome kingdom!

name: Space Racers
creator: Irreducible Games
description: A fast-paced chase through outer space! Space Racers brings the tactile fun of movement templates to a fast and simple game that can be enjoyed with almost anyone.

name: Good Cop Bad Cop 4th Edition and the Zombies Expansion
creator: Pull the Pin Games
description: The classic social deduction game has been perfected in this 4th Edition. The Zombies expansion gives eliminated players a new win condition to keep them in the game.

name: Tales are Real: Legacy
creator: Richard Heinrich
description: An expandable fantasy duel card game with easy to learn rules, intuitive game mechanics and strategic depth - for beginners and experts.

name: Phantom Division
creator: Phantom Horizon
description: Phantom Division is a fully co-operative tactical dexterity game set in a sci-fi world of impending danger. The game features the adventures of members of the elite Phantom Division defense force united to protect a remote colony world against an implacable enemy.

name: Classic Rally
creator: Filipe J F Freitas
description:
The thrills of classic car rallying, from preparing the car and logistics, to the days on the road competing and assisting the car, in order to try to get it to the finish quicker than the others.
Manage your team and race your classic car in a road map created by all the players.

name: Paragons: Age of Champions
creator: Authocracy Studios
description: Paragons: Age of Champions is an all-in-one high-fantasy deck-builder for 2-3 players featuring over 100 unique cards designed by a single artist. Re-launching 2023.

name: Find the Fun
creator: Gabe-Barrett
description: A game, a book, and an online course about game design! You'll learn how to get an idea out of your head and onto a table and how to go from prototype to published game.

name: Tectonia (relaunch)
creator: Hagen Behr
description: Tectonia is an area control boardgame on an ever changing map. Lead your tribe and fight for key areas on the map or defeat the other tribes.

name: The Battle of Mardavhain
creator: Davarim Games
description: Once, at the dawn of time, all the creatures lived peacefully side by side. This was Mardavhain. Then one day, an invisible evil force emerged from the depths and poisoned the hearts of those who harbored even the slightest trace of malevolence. The once peaceful creatures turned against each other and chaos descended upon the land. What will be your fate? Will you become a victim of evil or can you defend what is yours?

name: SkinQuest
creator: Rad Beans Gaming
description: SkinQuest is a thrilling board game that pits players against each other and ghouls in a battle for Plasma Coins and a chance to escape Limbo. With random encounters, challenging Boss Ghouls, and a constantly-moving Skin Suit, every game is a unique and exciting experience. Roll the dice, draw a card, and try to outsmart your opponents in this ghoulishly cute and fun game of strategy and luck.

name: Blank Me, Senpai!
creator: Cel Shaded Games
description: Magical Girls! Tsunderes! Giant Mechas! It's the fill-in-the-blank card party game that puts an anime season in a box.

name: Shuffle Kerfuffle: Push Your Luck and Shuffle The Deck!
creator: Nomich Games
description: Shuffle Kerfuffle is a fun, simple, push-your-luck style party game for 2-7 players. Take risks and shuffle the deck!

name: Caged In: MMA Card Combat
creator: Foam Hammer Games
description: Caged In is a fast-paced 2 player fighting game that has players squaring off in MMA combat. Fighters will choose from four unique styles and try to knock each other out, submit each other, or impress the judges for a decision. Caged In is perfect for those who like games that are simple to learn and hard to master. The strategy comes from managing your hand and trying to exploit your opponent's weaknesses. The game features a unique hexagonal box design, dual layered player and game boards with damage cubes that sink into the board and custom designed 3D miniatures. Designed and produced by Foam Hammer Games, the makers of Book It! The Pro Wrestling Promoter Card Game.

name: Star Colonies - card game
creator: DaviesDesignGames
description:
In Star Colonies you play an intrepid pioneer from an over-populated Earth, contracted to explore and colonise habitable exo-worlds. 
Players command the first scoutships with new hyper-drive technology and may install this on all new ships you buy to your fleet.

The game consists of Deckbuilding, and control of (attacking/defending) star systems you or other players have explored. The game is highly interactive, and is equally fun to play with 2, 3 or 4 players with a duration of anything from 30 to 90 minutes.

name: Flutter
creator: Phase Shift Games
description: Prepare to set your hearts a Flutter! Flutter is a vibrant tile-laying strategy game for 2 to 5 players. Proudly partnered with Save Our Monarchs foundation!

name: Tartarus - The New Souls
creator: PlanetStudio
description: 2 NEW SOULS joined the LONGO ITINERE ... the Card Retro Dungeon Crawler is coming back more DEVILISH than ever !!

name: Falconry
creator: Jared
description: Use strategy and misdirection to be the first noble to stake out an area for your birds of prey, winning both honor and land.

name: Tiny Ninjas: Tournament
creator: Tiny Ninjas
description: Challenging dexterity mini games for 1-4+ players that play inside the box. Ultimately portable. Endlessly replayable. All four Tiny Ninjas games are available during this campaign.

name: Whelps to Wyrms: Resurrection Project
creator: Three Knights Games
description: Whelps to Wyrms is an action-based tile exploration game where each player plays the role of a recently hatched Dragon Whelp. Grow in size and survive not only your fellow Whelps, but Dragon Slayers as well.

name: ZARATO
creator: ZARATO GAMES
description: A fierce Physical Trading Card Game steeped in ZARATO Mythos, with the incredible and unique additional Phone Core mechanism & virtual Battlefield!

name: PRISON(ERS)
creator: Grzegorz "Iwano" Iwańczyk
description: "PRISON(ERS)" is a deductive and strategic game, with elements of cooperation,  based on a theme related to the prison industry. Prisoners versus the prison defense system, two opposing camps fighting for completely different goals. Some for freedom, others for the prestige of the facility! Who will win this battle? Take sides and outsmart your opponent!

name: Statera
creator: FATboardgames
description: Become a leader of a Statera nation or a powerful god, fight for territory, balance your believers, gather souls, and experience all of Statera's stories.

name: Luxury Island
creator: Tamás Kurali
description: A competitive Print&Play game for 2-4 people, featuring territory control, resource collection and building.

name: Enemy at the Gates
creator: Emperoll
description: Defend the stronghold against the enemy army at the gates with the power of magic!

name: Bestiary of Sigillum: Collector's Edition
creator: CrowD Games
description: Bestiary of Sigillum: Collector's Edition is a fantasy MOBA game. Take on the role of summoners in the Kingdom of Two Castles, choose and summon your force of otherworldly heroes to fight the opponent's heroes and destroy their castle to win the struggle for the throne!

name: No Such Thing As A Free Sandwich
creator: AvianRampage Productions
description: No Such Thing as a Free Sandwich is an irreverent mint tin card game that challenges players to make the best (and worst) sandwiches using wacky ingredients. Great for parties and funerals!

name: Legendary Tea Farmer
creator: teafarmergame
description: Legendary Tea Farmer is a social game where you develop your tea estate and build reputation to become the most legendary tea farmer in the region. As you strive for greatness, you also compete with other farmers and need to see through their strategies to get to the finish line first.

name: Die-namo
creator: INEVITABLE IDEAS
description: Die-namo is a quick, fun push-your-luck card n' dice game in which players bet to collect the most cards of a color or number for the highest score at the end of the game.

name: Artisans
creator: V-Games
description: Artisans is a fast and exciting but challenging family card game for 2 to 4 players which lasts 30 to 45 minutes. Players are trying to develop their skills in the use of seven different materials: clay, metal, wood, stone, gold, glass and textiles in such a way so that their level of expertise in these materials grants them the necessary skills to craft beautiful Art objects.

name: GRIM DARK DUNGEON MASTER:  CATACOMBS OF THE NECROMANCER
creator: Grim Dark Games, LLC
description: Grim Dark Dungeon Master: Catacombs of the Necromancer is an epic 2 to 4-player "competitive dungeon-building game".™  You play as either the Grim Dark Dungeon Master or one of the heroes.  Which will you serve - the dark or the light?

name: Biergarten Second Edition
creator: Blue Wing Games
description: A light tile-laying game where players compete to create the most beautiful Biergartens before Oktoberfest! Prost!

name: Nexus:Scrapyard
creator: PawnJoker Games
description: You and up to three friends take turns as entrepreneurs looking for affordable CivShips to purchase from Syd's Scrapyard. Each turn you take actions to customize the available CivShips and hire a crew to ensure you can buy the best CivShips in the scrapyard, Or sabotage your friends.

name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance - The Board Game
creator: Boardcubator
description: A revolutionary app-driven cooperative living RPG game for 1-4 players, that lets you explore the authentic historical world of Kingdom Come: Deliverance, with a captivating story, voice acting and a unique socially immersive experience.

name: 18Namibia
creator: Marflow Games
description: 18Namibia is based on ‘1895 Namibia’, which was designed for three players only. In order to expand the game for four players, a sixth Railway Corporation and two Mining Corporations introduced in 18Namibia. A 2-player variant has also been added.

name: Inferno: Card Game
creator: shiftylads
description:
An Anti Pick-up Styled Survival Strategy Card Game.
For 3-8 Players. Average Playtime 40 minutes.

name: Forest Trails
creator: Kevin Watch - Brain Escape Games
description: As forest developer, your role is to improve the visitor experience and increase the number of people coming to enjoy the forest. Design interesting forest trails, carry out visitor surveys,  build new facilities and attract as many visitors as you can. A vibrant, puzzle/strategy,  roll and write game for anyone who loves engine building gameplay, route planning and optimisation.

name: Pandemonium Estate
creator: Winter Moon Games
description: Pandemonium Estate is an Otherworldly Adventure Board Game that takes place in an interdimensional mansion that exists between world and time. Play through one of three full-length, replayable, thematic Storyline modes as one of eight unique characters that was pulled into the mansion against their will. Each Storyline has its own rules, components, and goals. Complete various objectives to earn the most Essence (victory points) and return to your home world.

name: Temple of Horrors
creator: giochix
description: A mighty artifact is hidden in a forgotten temple: will you be able to find it by overcoming the pitfalls and monsters that guard it? Temple of Horrors is an innovative dungeon crawler that mixes Euro and American game elements and which includes 100+ Adventures!

name: Hans Christian Andersen Fairy Tales - A family game collection
creator: Sidekick Games
description: Six unique family games inspired by Hans Christian Andersen's famous fairy tales. Published and designed by award winning designers Asger Harding Granerud & Daniel Skjold Pedersen.

name: Tectonia
creator: Hagen Behr
description: Tectonia is a wargame on a continously changing boardgame map. Lead your tribe to victory by reaching victory conditions or defeating the other tribes.

name: Invasion Cards
creator: Lawrence Lyle
description:
The mysterious Gnome Lands!
Battle against each other for the planet Earth!
Humor and absurdity accompany the whole re-written history of humans and the universe of Gnomes!
Solve mysteries, discover the hidden meaning of cards and unlock new content by just discovering secrets!

name: IMMUNIZATION The Game
creator: IMMUNITARIUM
description: Immunization is a modern board game for 1-4 players to understand how vaccines are developed to fight diseases. You are a Pharmaceutical Leader developing the next generation of best-in-class vaccines to protect populations against life-threatening diseases and fast-spreading outbreaks.

name: Planting Evidence
creator: Tin Robot Games
description:
Planting Evidence is a card game for 2-4 players that pits you against your criminal friends. Framing someone for murder has never been so fun!
Each round, players must choose between planting incriminating evidence on their fellow criminals or using similar evidence to build up their alibis.
Build sets of cards to assemble fingerprints from partials, reconstruct DNA, build a car license plate profile, or submit weapons for review.
Be careful not to trigger the end of the game unless you have the least evidence against you, or you lose!

2-4 Players | Ages 14+ | 40-80 MIN

name: Amygdala (cancelled)
creator: Game Brewer
description: In the abstract strategy game Amygdala, players vie for control of different regions, each associated with an emotion. They must collect and store emotional resources in their memory bank which they will use to unlock emotions from their mind, then place these emotion tiles on the main game board.

name: Enigma: Crime Scene "Chicago & Sicily"
creator: Butterfly Games
description: Enigma: Crime Scene is a cooperative, competitive and replayable criminal investigation game.

name: SA-RÊ
creator: Nostromo-Editions
description: Sa-Re is a strategy game for 2 to 4 players with a clever mix of resource management and push-your-luck mechanisms, for a unique gaming experience.

name: Euthia: Torment of Resurrection & Fierce Powers
creator: Diea Games
description: Euthia: Torment of Resurrection is an open-world sandbox RPG strategy for 1-4 players. Embark on an epic adventure through one of the infinitely replayable scenarios. Fight monsters, liberate settlements, gather resources, level up and gain powerful abilities. Become a legend!

name: MOOGH
creator: Nuts! Publishing
description: MOOGH is a 1 to 4-player semi cooperative programming game where tribes of cavemen are joining forces to defeat big beasts. They will fight together in order to decide who should lead the new combined tribes. By hunting Big Beasts, they will win savage points. At the end of the game, if the cavemen win, the team with most savage points may then claim the leadership of the tribe. If the cavemen don’t meet the winning conditions before the end of the game, all the tribes will lose the game.

name: HYDRORACERS - the Schneider Trophy Epic
creator: PLATYPUS GAME
description:
Hydroracers retraces the great epic of the Schneider Trophy of the 1920s in an incredible seaplane race.
Campaign launch on April 21st 2022

name: Space Lion
creator: SolisGameStudio
description:
There are alien armies on all fronts!  Take command of one of four asymmetric armies in a huge battle and deploy your units strategically and carefully.  You can't possibly win all the fights on the battlefield. Choose which battles to resolve in which order but weigh in on how it may affect your units and other battles. 

Complexity: Medium / Players: 2 - 4 / Time: 30 - 60 mins

name: Spring and Autumn: Story of China
creator: Mr. B. Games
description: Welcome to Spring and Autumn: Story of China! - a 4x game for 1-5 players set in ancient china, based off of the award winning Hellenica system... but in less time!

name: Crossroads Inn: The Board Game
creator: Klabater
description: Folks! We keep playing games about dungeons and dragons, warriors and princesses, but what about the innkeepers, eh? Of course, every good story starts in an inn, but have you ever wondered what adventures happen in the back room? Innkeepers can be heroes too!

name: PACHAMAMA
creator: SitDown
description: The Earth Goddess Pachamama constantly guides the Quechua farmers, by specifying the distribution of crops to be planted, according to her own logic, of course. No one would dare transgress the rules dictated by Pachamama!

name: Taverns & Dragons (Canceled)
creator: Lord Raccoon Games
description: Gather magic mushrooms and dragon eggs in the cursed forests to prepare a feast fit for the king! 🔥 Taverns & Dragons is a dice placement and worker movement game for 2-5 players.

name: Goldenstar: The Galactic Tournament
creator: Gindi
description: Enter the Tournament in this Asymmetric, Deck Building Board Game where Challengers fight on Arenas around the galaxy for eternal glory and fame!
